q:
Read the following testimonial written by an economics professor for an applicant seeking a tenure-track university post:

*"To the Search Committee: Dr. Arisov was invariably punctual to staff meetings, and his office was always impeccably tidy. Sincerely, Prof. Vance."*

In Gricean pragmatic theory, what conversational implicature is generated by this letter, and through which communicative mechanism?
opts: The writer flouts the Maxim of Quantity by withholding relevant information regarding scholarship and teaching, thereby implicating that the candidate is academically mediocre.
The writer violates the Maxim of Quality by deliberately forging false factual claims regarding the applicant’s punctuality.
The writer flouts the Maxim of Manner by drafting an excessively ambiguous and verbose document.
The writer opts out of the Cooperative Principle by refusing to participate in the employment process.
explanation: By providing conspicuously scant, superficial details (punctuality and tidy office) when extensive scholarly evaluation is required, the writer flouts the Maxim of Quantity, deliberately generating the implicature that the candidate lacks genuine academic distinction.
mnemonic: Flouting Quantity: Withholding expected substantive data generates a damming implicature.

q:
Read the pharmaceutical report statement:

*"In the initial Phase II clinical trials, some of the oncology patients exhibited severe nausea."*

What scalar implicature is pragmatic listeners warranted in drawing from this utterance under the Maxim of Quantity?
opts: Every single oncology patient without exception exhibited nausea.
Not all of the oncology patients exhibited severe nausea.
The oncology trial was an unmitigated clinical catastrophe.
The pharmaceutical compound is proven to be completely non-toxic.
explanation: On the quantitative scale <all, most, many, some>, asserting the weaker scalar value 'some' implicates that the speaker was not in an epistemic position to assert the stronger value 'all', generating the scalar implicature: 'some, but not all'.
mnemonic: Scalar Implicature: Choosing 'some' implicates 'not all' under Quantity.

q: Dilnoza o'quvchilarga "Shahrimizga kelgan xorijiy sayyohlar uchun bir kunlik eng qulay marshrutni rejalashtirish" mavzusida TBLT (Task-Based Language Teaching) darsini o'tmoqda. J. Willis modeli bo'yicha u 'Pre-task' (Topshiriqdan oldingi) bosqichida qaysi pedagogik harakatni amalga oshirishi metodik jihatdan eng to'g'ri sanaladi?
opts: Mavzuni kiritish, o'quvchilarda mavzuga oid bilimlarni faollashtirish va vazifa talablarini tushuntirish, zarur hollarda o'xshash topshiriqning namunaviy audio/video yozuvini ko'rsatish
O'quvchilarga kerak bo'ladigan barcha yangi grammatik qoidalar va so'zlarni oldindan doskaga yozib, ularni mexanik mashqlar orqali yodlatish
O'quvchilarni darhol guruhlarga bo'lib, ulardan hech qanday ko'rsatmasiz mustaqil ravishda yakuniy hisobotni yozishni talab qilish
Topshiriq bajarib bo'linganidan so'ng o'quvchilar yo'l qo'ygan barcha nutqiy xatolarni doskada tahlil qilib berish
explanation: Jane Willis TBLT modelida Pre-task bosqichining asosiy maqsadi — o'quvchilarni vazifaga tayyorlash, mavzuga oid konseptual va lug'aviy bilimlarni (schemata) faollashtirish hamda topshiriq maqsadini aniq tushuntirishdir. Bu bosqichda grammatikani mexanik o'rgatish TBLT tamoyillariga zid.
mnemonic: Pre-task = Schemata faollashtirish + Maqsad va namunani ko'rsatish.

q: Jamshid o'z darsida TBLT Task Cycle (Topshiriq sikli) bosqichini tashkil etmoqda. O'quvchilar guruhda muammoni hal qilishdi va endi o'z natijalarini butun sinfga og'zaki taqdimot qilishlari kerak. Taqdimotdan oldingi 'Planning' (Rejalashtirish) bosqichida o'qituvchining asosiy roli nimadan iborat bo'lishi kerak?
opts: Sinfdagi barcha o'quvchilarni to'xtatib, frontal usulda taqdimot uchun yagona majburiy matn shablonini diktovka qilish
O'quvchilarga hisobot matnini tuzish va nutqni sayqallashda maslahatchi (language advisor) sifatida yordam berish hamda aniqlik (accuracy) ustida ishlashlariga ko'maklashish
O'quvchilarning har bir grammatik xatosini darhol to'xtatib tuzatish va baho qo'yish
Jarayonga umuman aralashmasdan, keyingi dars materiallarini tayyorlash bilan mashg'ul bo'lish
explanation: Task Cycle ichidagi Planning bosqichida o'quvchilar erkin muloqotdan (fluency) o'z nutqini rasmiy taqdimotga moslashtirish (accuracy) tomon harakat qiladilar. O'qituvchi bu paytda maslahatchi bo'lib, til birliklarini to'g'ri tanlashga ko'maklashadi.
mnemonic: Planning bosqichi = Maslahatchi o'qituvchi + Aniqlik (accuracy) va tuzilishga tayyorgarlik.

q: Metodbirlashma yig'ilishida Nilufar an'anaviy PPP (Presentation, Practice, Production) modeli bilan TBLT o'rtasidagi farqni tushuntirib bermoqchi. Quyidagi tahlillardan qaysi biri TBLT ning mohiyatini eng to'g'ri va ilmiy ifodalaydi?
opts: TBLT modelida o'quvchilar hech qachon guruhda ishlamaydi, PPPda esa doimo juftlikda ishlanadi
PPP faqat muloqotga qaratilgan, TBLT esa faqat qat'iy grammatik qoidalarni yodlatishga xizmat qiladi
PPP til shaklini oldindan belgilab, uni mashq qildirsa, TBLTda muloqot birlamchi bo'lib, til vositalari (language focus) topshiriq ehtiyojidan kelib chiqqan holda dars oxirida tahlil qilinadi
PPPda xatolar tuzatilmaydi, TBLTda esa o'qituvchi har bir noto'g'ri aytilgan so'z uchun darhol jarima qo'llaydi
explanation: PPP sintetik model bo'lib, til birliklari bo'laklarga ajratilib o'rgatiladi (Form -> Meaning -> Use). TBLT esa analitik yondashuv bo'lib, muloqot jarayonida yuzaga chiqqan til bo'shliqlari 'Language Focus' bosqichida tahlil qilinadi.
mnemonic: PPP = Avval qoida, keyin muloqot; TBLT = Avval muloqot va vazifa, keyin til tahlili.

q: Farhod o'quv dasturiga TBLT topshiriqlarini kiritishda Nunan tasnifiga ko'ra 'Real-world (target) task' va 'Pedagogical task' farqini tahlil qilmoqda. Quyidagilardan qaysi biri 'Pedagogical task' (pedagogik topshiriq) hisoblanadi?
opts: Xorijiy mehmonxona resepsheniga qo'ng'iroq qilib, xona bron qilish bo'yicha real suhbat qurish
O'quvchining internet orqali real aviakompaniya saytidan Toshkent-London reysiga chipta band qilishi
O'quvchining haqiqiy xalqaro do'konga buyurtma berish uchun rasmiy elektron xat jo'natishi
O'quvchilarning ikkita bir-biridan farqli rasmlar orasidagi 7 ta farqni bir-biriga ko'rsatmasdan, faqat savol-javob orqali topishi (Spot the differences)
explanation: Pedagogik topshiriq (Pedagogical task) real hayotda aynan uchramasa-da, real muloqot ko'nikmalarini (savol berish, taqqoslash, tushuntirish) sinf xonasida shakllantirish uchun maxsus loyihalashtirilgan sun'iy o'quv vazifasidir.
mnemonic: Pedagogical task = Sinf ichidagi maxsus muloqot mashqi; Target task = Real hayotiy amaliyot.

q: Jasur sinfda TBLT ning 'Jigsaw' (mozaika) turidagi topshirig'ini qo'lladi. Har bir guruh a'zosiga umumiy hikoyaning faqat bittadan parchasi berildi. Ular bir-birlarining qog'oziga qaramasdan butun voqeani tiklashlari kerak. Ushbu topshiriqning kommunikativ qiymati nimada?
opts: O'quvchilarga matnni mustaqil tarjima qilish qulay bo'ladi
Haqiqiy axborot almashinuvi (Information gap) va o'zaro ikki tomonlama bog'liqlikni (Two-way task) vujudga keltiradi
O'qituvchiga darsda dam olish imkoniyatini yaratadi
O'quvchilar orasida raqobatni kuchaytirib, ularni bir-biri bilan gaplashmaslikka undaydi
explanation: Jigsaw topshiriqlari 'two-way information gap' yaratadi: hech bir o'quvchi to'liq ma'lumotga ega emas, yakuniy natijaga faqat faol muloqot va barcha a'zolar o'z qismini og'zaki yetkazishi orqaligina erishiladi.
mnemonic: Jigsaw Task = 2 tomonlama axborot bo'shlig'i (Two-way info gap) va muqarrar hamkorlik.

opts: 1) Kutilayotgan o'rganish natijalarini aniqlash; 2) Natijaga erishilganini tasdiqlovchi baholash dalillarini belgilash; 3) O'quv tajribalari va dars mashg'ulotlarini rejalashtirish.
1) Darslikdagi matn va mashqlarni tanlash; 2) Dars rejasi va taqdimot tayyorlash; 3) Chorak oxirida summativ nazorat testini tuzish.
1) Baholash mezonlarini ishlab chiqish; 2) Mashg'ulot metodlarini tanlash; 3) Dars oxirida kutilayotgan natijani shakllantirish.
1) O'quvchilarning qiziqishlarini so'rovnoma orqali o'rganish; 2) Dars jadvalini moslashtirish; 3) Mavzular ketma-ketligini belgilash.
explanation: Backward Design (Teskari dizayn) uchta qat'iy bosqichdan iborat: 1-bosqich: Ko'zlangan yakuniy natijani belgilash (Identify desired results); 2-bosqich: Natijani baholash dalillarini aniqlash (Determine acceptable evidence); 3-bosqich: O'qitish va o'rganish faoliyatlarini loyihalash (Plan learning experiences and instruction).
mnemonic: Teskari dizayn qoidasi: Natija -> Baholash dalili -> Dars faoliyati.

q: O'qituvchi o'z dars rejasiga quyidagi maqsadni kiritdi: "O'quvchilar ekologik muammolar haqidagi yangi leksikani chuqur tushunib oladilar va tabiatni sevadilar". Professional kasbiy standart talablariga ko'ra, ushbu o'quv maqsadining asosiy metodik kamchiligi nimada?
opts: Mavzu maktab darslik dasturida ko'zda tutilgan ekologiya bo'limiga mutlaqo to'g'ri kelmaydi.
Maqsad noaniq va subyektiv fe'llar bilan ifodalangan bo'lib, uning o'zlashtirilganlik darajasini bevosita o'lchash va obyektiv baholash imkonsiz.
Dars maqsadi o'quvchi shaxsiga emas, balki faqat darslik muallifining qarashlariga yo'naltirilgan.
Maqsadda grammatik qoidalarni tahlil qilish talabi kiritilmagan.

explanation: The text highlights the Orwellian paradox: 'nothing was illegal, since there were no longer any laws—but if detected it was reasonably certain that it would be punished by death'.
q:
Read the passage:
"Winston kept his back turned toward the telescreen; though as he well knew, even a back can be revealing. He laid the nib on the page, conscious that his heart was hammering against his ribs like a trapped bird. The diary was a heavy, quarto-sized book with cream-laid paper, yellowed by age. To write in it was not strictly illegal—nothing was illegal, since there were no longer any laws—but if detected it was reasonably certain that it would be punished by death, or at least twenty-five years in a forced-labor camp. He dipped the pen and then hesitated. A tremor had gone through his bowels. To mark the paper was the decisive act."

What paradox regarding totalitarian law is articulated in the excerpt?

Writing diaries is mandated by the state, but citizens are forbidden from purchasing pens.
The telescreen records sound only when citizens speak directly into the microphone.
Labor camps are used exclusively for educating government administrative officials.

q: Dilnoza o'quvchilarga "Shahrimizga kelgan xorijiy sayyohlar uchun bir kunlik eng qulay marshrutni rejalashtirish" mavzusida TBLT (Task-Based Language Teaching) darsini o'tmoqda. J. Willis modeli bo'yicha u 'Pre-task' (Topshiriqdan oldingi) bosqichida qaysi pedagogik harakatni amalga oshirishi metodik jihatdan eng to'g'ri sanaladi?
opts: Mavzuni kiritish, o'quvchilarda mavzuga oid bilimlarni faollashtirish va vazifa talablarini tushuntirish, zarur hollarda o'xshash topshiriqning namunaviy audio/video yozuvini ko'rsatish
O'quvchilarga kerak bo'ladigan barcha yangi grammatik qoidalar va so'zlarni oldindan doskaga yozib, ularni mexanik mashqlar orqali yodlatish
O'quvchilarni darhol guruhlarga bo'lib, ulardan hech qanday ko'rsatmasiz mustaqil ravishda yakuniy hisobotni yozishni talab qilish
Topshiriq bajarib bo'linganidan so'ng o'quvchilar yo'l qo'ygan barcha nutqiy xatolarni doskada tahlil qilib berish
explanation: Jane Willis TBLT modelida Pre-task bosqichining asosiy maqsadi — o'quvchilarni vazifaga tayyorlash, mavzuga oid konseptual va lug'aviy bilimlarni (schemata) faollashtirish hamda topshiriq maqsadini aniq tushuntirishdir. Bu bosqichda grammatikani mexanik o'rgatish TBLT tamoyillariga zid.
mnemonic: Pre-task = Schemata faollashtirish + Maqsad va namunani ko'rsatish.

q: Jamshid o'z darsida TBLT Task Cycle (Topshiriq sikli) bosqichini tashkil etmoqda. O'quvchilar guruhda muammoni hal qilishdi va endi o'z natijalarini butun sinfga og'zaki taqdimot qilishlari kerak. Taqdimotdan oldingi 'Planning' (Rejalashtirish) bosqichida o'qituvchining asosiy roli nimadan iborat bo'lishi kerak?
opts: Sinfdagi barcha o'quvchilarni to'xtatib, frontal usulda taqdimot uchun yagona majburiy matn shablonini diktovka qilish
O'quvchilarga hisobot matnini tuzish va nutqni sayqallashda maslahatchi (language advisor) sifatida yordam berish hamda aniqlik (accuracy) ustida ishlashlariga ko'maklashish
O'quvchilarning har bir grammatik xatosini darhol to'xtatib tuzatish va baho qo'yish
Jarayonga umuman aralashmasdan, keyingi dars materiallarini tayyorlash bilan mashg'ul bo'lish
explanation: Task Cycle ichidagi Planning bosqichida o'quvchilar erkin muloqotdan (fluency) o'z nutqini rasmiy taqdimotga moslashtirish (accuracy) tomon harakat qiladilar. O'qituvchi bu paytda maslahatchi bo'lib, til birliklarini to'g'ri tanlashga ko'maklashadi.
mnemonic: Planning bosqichi = Maslahatchi o'qituvchi + Aniqlik (accuracy) va tuzilishga tayyorgarlik.

q: Metodbirlashma yig'ilishida Nilufar an'anaviy PPP (Presentation, Practice, Production) modeli bilan TBLT o'rtasidagi farqni tushuntirib bermoqchi. Quyidagi tahlillardan qaysi biri TBLT ning mohiyatini eng to'g'ri va ilmiy ifodalaydi?
opts: TBLT modelida o'quvchilar hech qachon guruhda ishlamaydi, PPPda esa doimo juftlikda ishlanadi
PPP faqat muloqotga qaratilgan, TBLT esa faqat qat'iy grammatik qoidalarni yodlatishga xizmat qiladi
PPP til shaklini oldindan belgilab, uni mashq qildirsa, TBLTda muloqot birlamchi bo'lib, til vositalari (language focus) topshiriq ehtiyojidan kelib chiqqan holda dars oxirida tahlil qilinadi
PPPda xatolar tuzatilmaydi, TBLTda esa o'qituvchi har bir noto'g'ri aytilgan so'z uchun darhol jarima qo'llaydi
explanation: PPP sintetik model bo'lib, til birliklari bo'laklarga ajratilib o'rgatiladi (Form -> Meaning -> Use). TBLT esa analitik yondashuv bo'lib, muloqot jarayonida yuzaga chiqqan til bo'shliqlari 'Language Focus' bosqichida tahlil qilinadi.
mnemonic: PPP = Avval qoida, keyin muloqot; TBLT = Avval muloqot va vazifa, keyin til tahlili.

q: Robert Gagne tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan "9 ta ta'limiy hodisa" modeliga binoan, darsning eng birinchi bosqichida o'qituvchi qaysi didaktik harakatni amalga oshirishi shart?
opts: O'quvchilarga darhol 10 savolli mustaqil yozma ish tarqatib, baholashni boshlash.

Darslikdagi qoidani ovoz chiqarib o'qishni buyurish va konspekt qildirish.
Uyga vazifani daftarlarga yozdirish va keyingi haftadagi nazorat ishini e'lon qilish.
explanation: Gagne modelining 1-hodisasi "Gain attention" (Diqqatni jalb qilish)dir. O'quvchilarning idrok kanallari ochilmasdan turib maqsadni e'lon qilish yoki yangi material berish samarasiz bo'ladi.
mnemonic: Gagne 1-qadam: Diqqatni jalb qil (Gain Attention) -> keyin maqsadni tushuntir.

q: Farhod o'quv dasturiga TBLT topshiriqlarini kiritishda Nunan tasnifiga ko'ra 'Real-world (target) task' va 'Pedagogical task' farqini tahlil qilmoqda. Quyidagilardan qaysi biri 'Pedagogical task' (pedagogik topshiriq) hisoblanadi?

O'quvchining internet orqali real aviakompaniya saytidan Toshkent-London reysiga chipta band qilishi

mnemonic: Pedagogical task = Sinf ichidagi maxsus muloqot mashqi; Target task = Real hayotiy amaliyot.

q: Malika TBLT darsida 'Language Focus' (Tahlil va amaliyot) bosqichini o'tkazmoqda. O'quvchilar topshiriqni bajarib, hisobot berib bo'lishdi. Bu bosqichda o'qituvchining eng maqbul vazifasi nima?
opts: Topshiriq jarayonida o'quvchilar ishlatgan yoki qiynalgan aniq til tuzilmalari, ifodalar va xatoliklarni matn va audio kontekstida tahlil qilish hamda amaliyotda mustahkamlash
Yangi boshqa bir grammatik mavzuni noldan tushuntirib, uyga 50 ta mashq berish

q: Bobur TBLT darsida 'Decision-making task' (qaror qabul qilish topshirig'i) o'tkazmoqda. 4 nafar nomzoddan faqat bittasini kosmik ekspeditsiyaga tanlab olish kerak. Bunday topshiriq o'quvchilarda qaysi kognitiv va muloqot ko'nikmalarini faollashtiradi?
opts: Qoidalarni qat'iy yodlash va intonatsiyasiz o'qish
Matndan raqamlarni mexanik qidirib topish
Lug'atdan yangi so'zlarning sinonimlarini ko'chirish
Bahslashish, dalillar keltirish (justification), taqqoslash va kelishuvga erishish (negotiation of meaning)
explanation: Decision-making topshiriqlari Bloom taksonomiyasining Baholash (Evaluation) va Tahlil (Analysis) darajalarini ishga soladi. O'quvchilar o'z pozitsiyasini himoya qiladi va ma'noni muzokara qiladi (negotiation of meaning).

q: Umida o'quvchilarga "Shahrimizga kelgan xorijiy sayyohlar uchun bir kunlik eng qulay marshrutni rejalashtirish" mavzusida TBLT (Task-Based Language Teaching) darsini o'tmoqda. J. Willis modeli bo'yicha u 'Pre-task' (Topshiriqdan oldingi) bosqichida qaysi pedagogik harakatni amalga oshirishi metodik jihatdan eng to'g'ri sanaladi?
opts: Mavzuni kiritish, o'quvchilarda mavzuga oid bilimlarni faollashtirish va vazifa talablarini tushuntirish, zarur hollarda o'xshash topshiriqning namunaviy audio/video yozuvini ko'rsatish
O'quvchilarga kerak bo'ladigan barcha yangi grammatik qoidalar va so'zlarni oldindan doskaga yozib, ularni mexanik mashqlar orqali yodlatish
O'quvchilarni darhol guruhlarga bo'lib, ulardan hech qanday ko'rsatmasiz mustaqil ravishda yakuniy hisobotni yozishni talab qilish
Topshiriq bajarib bo'linganidan so'ng o'quvchilar yo'l qo'ygan barcha nutqiy xatolarni doskada tahlil qilib berish
explanation: Jane Willis TBLT modelida Pre-task bosqichining asosiy maqsadi — o'quvchilarni vazifaga tayyorlash, mavzuga oid konseptual va lug'aviy bilimlarni (schemata) faollashtirish hamda topshiriq maqsadini aniq tushuntirishdir. Bu bosqichda grammatikani mexanik o'rgatish TBLT tamoyillariga zid.
mnemonic: Pre-task = Schemata faollashtirish + Maqsad va namunani ko'rsatish.

q: Otabek o'z darsida TBLT Task Cycle (Topshiriq sikli) bosqichini tashkil etmoqda. O'quvchilar guruhda muammoni hal qilishdi va endi o'z natijalarini butun sinfga og'zaki taqdimot qilishlari kerak. Taqdimotdan oldingi 'Planning' (Rejalashtirish) bosqichida o'qituvchining asosiy roli nimadan iborat bo'lishi kerak?
opts: Sinfdagi barcha o'quvchilarni to'xtatib, frontal usulda taqdimot uchun yagona majburiy matn shablonini diktovka qilish
O'quvchilarga hisobot matnini tuzish va nutqni sayqallashda maslahatchi (language advisor) sifatida yordam berish hamda aniqlik (accuracy) ustida ishlashlariga ko'maklashish
O'quvchilarning har bir grammatik xatosini darhol to'xtatib tuzatish va baho qo'yish
Jarayonga umuman aralashmasdan, keyingi dars materiallarini tayyorlash bilan mashg'ul bo'lish
explanation: Task Cycle ichidagi Planning bosqichida o'quvchilar erkin muloqotdan (fluency) o'z nutqini rasmiy taqdimotga moslashtirish (accuracy) tomon harakat qiladilar. O'qituvchi bu paytda maslahatchi bo'lib, til birliklarini to'g'ri tanlashga ko'maklashadi.
mnemonic: Planning bosqichi = Maslahatchi o'qituvchi + Aniqlik (accuracy) va tuzilishga tayyorgarlik.

q: Ingliz tili o'qituvchisi geografiya o'qituvchisi bilan hamkorlikda "Global iqlim o'zgarishi va Orol dengizi fojiasi" mavzusida integratsiyalashgan dars loyihalashtirdi. Unda til o'rganish fanning mazmuni (geografiya) bilan uzviy integratsiya qilindi. Ushbu yondashuv zamonaviy ta'limda nima deb ataladi?
opts: Audio-Lingual Method — dialoglarni mexanik yod olish va takrorlash.
Grammar-Translation Method — grammatik-tarjima usuli orqali matnni so'zma-so'z o'girish.
CLIL (Content and Language Integrated Learning) — fan va tilni integratsiyalashgan holda o'qitish.
Suggestopedia — musiqiy ohang ostida relaksatsiya holatida yodlash.
explanation: CLIL yondashuvida ikkinchi til mustaqil fan sifatida emas, balki boshqa bir fan (geografiya, biologiya, tarix) mazmunini o'rganish vositasi sifatida qo'llaniladi va o'quvchida ham fan mazmuni, ham til kompetentsiyasi bir vaqtda rivojlanadi.
mnemonic: CLIL = Fan mazmuni (Content) + Til (Language) integratsiyasi.

q: Metodbirlashma yig'ilishida Zarina an'anaviy PPP (Presentation, Practice, Production) modeli bilan TBLT o'rtasidagi farqni tushuntirib bermoqchi. Quyidagi tahlillardan qaysi biri TBLT ning mohiyatini eng to'g'ri va ilmiy ifodalaydi?
opts: TBLT modelida o'quvchilar hech qachon guruhda ishlamaydi, PPPda esa doimo juftlikda ishlanadi
PPP faqat muloqotga qaratilgan, TBLT esa faqat qat'iy grammatik qoidalarni yodlatishga xizmat qiladi
PPP til shaklini oldindan belgilab, uni mashq qildirsa, TBLTda muloqot birlamchi bo'lib, til vositalari (language focus) topshiriq ehtiyojidan kelib chiqqan holda dars oxirida tahlil qilinadi
PPPda xatolar tuzatilmaydi, TBLTda esa o'qituvchi har bir noto'g'ri aytilgan so'z uchun darhol jarima qo'llaydi
explanation: PPP sintetik model bo'lib, til birliklari bo'laklarga ajratilib o'rgatiladi (Form -> Meaning -> Use). TBLT esa analitik yondashuv bo'lib, muloqot jarayonida yuzaga chiqqan til bo'shliqlari 'Language Focus' bosqichida tahlil qilinadi.
mnemonic: PPP = Avval qoida, keyin muloqot; TBLT = Avval muloqot va vazifa, keyin til tahlili.

q: Sherzod o'quv dasturiga TBLT topshiriqlarini kiritishda Nunan tasnifiga ko'ra 'Real-world (target) task' va 'Pedagogical task' farqini tahlil qilmoqda. Quyidagilardan qaysi biri 'Pedagogical task' (pedagogik topshiriq) hisoblanadi?

O'quvchining haqiqiy xalqaro do'konga buyurtma berish uchun rasmiy elektron xat jo'natishi

q: Sardor sinfda TBLT ning 'Jigsaw' (mozaika) turidagi topshirig'ini qo'lladi. Har bir guruh a'zosiga umumiy hikoyaning faqat bittadan parchasi berildi. Ular bir-birlarining qog'oziga qaramasdan butun voqeani tiklashlari kerak. Ushbu topshiriqning kommunikativ qiymati nimada?

Haqiqiy axborot almashinuvi (Information gap) va o'zaro ikki tomonlama bog'liqlikni (Two-way task) vujudga keltiradi
O'qituvchiga darsda dam olish imkoniyatini yaratadi
O'quvchilar orasida raqobatni kuchaytirib, ularni bir-biri bilan gaplashmaslikka undaydi
explanation: Jigsaw topshiriqlari 'two-way information gap' yaratadi: hech bir o'quvchi to'liq ma'lumotga ega emas, yakuniy natijaga faqat faol muloqot va barcha a'zolar o'z qismini og'zaki yetkazishi orqaligina erishiladi.
mnemonic: Jigsaw Task = 2 tomonlama axborot bo'shlig'i (Two-way info gap) va muqarrar hamkorlik.

q: O'qituvchi o'quvchilarga murakkab analitik hisobot yozishni topshirishdan oldin: 1) tayyor namunani tahlil qildirdi; 2) jumlalarni bog'lovchi tayyor qoliplar (sentence starters) berdi; 3) guruhda birgalikda reja tuzdirdi; 4) shundan keyingina mustaqil yozishga o'tdi. Ushbu metodik qo'llab-quvvatlash tizimi qanday nomlanadi?
opts: Summativ nazorat — o'quvchining yakuniy xatolarini hisobga oluvchi qat'iy tekshiruv.
Avtoritar yo'naltirish — o'quvchining erkin fikrlashini qat'iy cheklovchi tsenzura mexanizmi.

mnemonic: Skaffolding = Vaqtinchalik pedagogik ko'mak (zina); mustaqil bo'lgach olib tashlanadi.

q: Madina 9-sinf o'quvchilariga 'Past Perfect vs Past Simple' mavzusini o'tishda Test-Teach-Test (TTT) modelini tanladi. Ushbu metodik tanlovning eng asosiy pedagogik maqsadi va afzalligi nimada?
opts: Dastlabki 'Test' orqali o'quvchilar mavzuni qanchalik bilishini diagnostika qilish va faqat ular qiynalayotgan jihatlariga qaratilgan maqsadli dars ('Teach') o'tish
Dars boshidayoq o'quvchilarga qoniqarsiz baho qo'yish orqali ularni darsda qattiq intizom saqlashga majburlash
O'qituvchining darsga tayyorgarlik ko'rmasdan, butun 45 daqiqani faqat mustaqil test yechishga ajratishi
O'quvchilarga yangi mavzuni tushuntirmasdan, ularni nazorat imtihoniga tayyorlash
explanation: Test-Teach-Test (TTT) modeli o'quvchilarning mavjud bilim darajasini oldindan aniqlash (diagnostika) imkonini beradi. Natijada o'qituvchi o'quvchilar allaqachon biladigan qoidalarni qayta tushuntirib vaqt yo'qotmaydi, balki aniqlangan bo'shliqlar (gaps) ustida ishlaydi.
mnemonic: TTT = Test (Diagnostika) -> Teach (Bo'shliqni to'ldirish) -> Test (Mustahkamlash).

q: Rustam Jeremy Harmerning 'ESA' (Engage, Study, Activate) konsepsiyasiga tayanib dars o'tmoqda. U quyidagi ketma-ketlikni qo'lladi: Qiziqtirish (Engage) -> Erkin faoliyat (Activate) -> Grammatik tahlil (Study) -> Yangi muloqot (Activate) -> Yana tahlil (Study). Ushbu dars modeli Harmer tasnifiga ko'ra qaysi dars tuzilishiga kiradi?
opts: Straight Arrows (To'g'ri o'qlar) an'anaviy dars modeli
Patchwork (Yamoqli/Murakkab uyg'unlashgan) dars modeli
Boomerang (Qaytuvchi bumerang) dars modeli
Audio-Lingual mexanik dars modeli
explanation: Harmer ESA tizimida 3 xil modelni ajratadi: 1) Straight Arrows (E -> S -> A); 2) Boomerang (E -> A -> S -> A); 3) Patchwork (E -> A -> S -> A -> S -> A kabi bir nechta bosqichlar erkin va uyg'un ravishda almashib keladi).
mnemonic: Patchwork ESA = Bir necha bor E, S, A elementlarining erkin almashinib takrorlanishi.

q: Feruza PPP modelida dars o'tdi: yangi strukturani tushuntirdi (Presentation), bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish mashqlarini bajartirdi (Practice). Ammo 'Production' bosqichida o'quvchilarga 'Do'stingiz bilan dam olish kunlari haqida suhbatlashing' deganida, sinfda jimlik hukm surdi va faoliyat samarasiz yakunlandi. Ushbu uzilishning eng ehtimoliy metodik sababi nima?
opts: O'qituvchining doskaga dars mavzusini o'zbek tilida yozib qo'ymaganligi
O'quvchilarga grammatik qoidani yodlash uchun kamida 20 daqiqa yozma diktant berilmaganligi

Controlled Practice (boshqariladigan mashq)dan Free Production (erkin muloqot)ga o'tishda yetarli oraliq ko'prik (scaffolding va less-controlled practice) ta'minlanmaganligi hamda muloqot uchun aniq vazifa va sabab (communicative purpose) berilmaganligi
O'quvchilar darslikdagi matnni uch marta ovoz chiqarib xor bo'lib o'qimagani
explanation: Qat'iy boshqariladigan mashqlardan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri erkin ishlab chiqarishga o'tish kognitiv yuklamani keskin oshiradi. O'quvchilarga oraliq yarim-erkin (semi-controlled) mashqlar, tayanch frazalar (sentence starters) va muloqot uchun aniq maqsad (communicative goal) kerak.
mnemonic: Practice -> Production sakrashi uchun bosqichma-bosqich Scaffolding va Muloqot Maqsadi zarur.

q: Alisher darsni qiziqarli rasm namoyishi bilan boshladi (Engage), so'ngra darhol o'quvchilarga suratdagi voqea bo'yicha hikoya to'qish topshirig'ini berdi (Activate). O'quvchilar hikoya tuzishda qiyinchilikka duch kelgach, Alisher aynan ular qiynalgan grammatik vositalarni tushuntirib berdi (Study) va qaytadan hikoyani takomillashtirishni so'radi (Activate). Bu qaysi dars tuzilishi?
opts: Dogme Unplugged modeli
Straight Arrows modeli (E -> S -> A)
Grammar-Translation modeli

q: Otabek Jeremy Harmerning 'ESA' (Engage, Study, Activate) konsepsiyasiga tayanib dars o'tmoqda. U quyidagi ketma-ketlikni qo'lladi: Qiziqtirish (Engage) -> Erkin faoliyat (Activate) -> Grammatik tahlil (Study) -> Yangi muloqot (Activate) -> Yana tahlil (Study). opts: Straight Arrows (To'g'ri o'qlar) an'anaviy dars modeli

Boomerang (Qaytuvchi bumerang) dars modeli
Audio-Lingual mexanik dars modeli
explanation: Harmer ESA tizimida 3 xil modelni ajratadi: 1) Straight Arrows (E -> S -> A); 2) Boomerang (E -> A -> S -> A); 3) Patchwork (E -> A -> S -> A -> S -> A kabi bir nechta bosqichlar erkin va uyg'un ravishda almashib keladi).
mnemonic: Patchwork ESA = Bir necha bor E, S, A elementlarining erkin almashinib takrorlanishi.

q: Zarina PPP modelida dars o'tdi: yangi strukturani tushuntirdi (Presentation), bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish mashqlarini bajartirdi (Practice). Ammo 'Production' bosqichida o'quvchilarga 'Do'stingiz bilan dam olish kunlari haqida suhbatlashing' deganida, sinfda jimlik hukm surdi va faoliyat samarasiz yakunlandi. Ushbu uzilishning eng ehtimoliy metodik sababi nima?
opts: O'qituvchining doskaga dars mavzusini o'zbek tilida yozib qo'ymaganligi
O'quvchilarga grammatik qoidani yodlash uchun kamida 20 daqiqa yozma diktant berilmaganligi

O'quvchilar darslikdagi matnni uch marta ovoz chiqarib xor bo'lib o'qimagani
explanation: Qat'iy boshqariladigan mashqlardan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri erkin ishlab chiqarishga o'tish kognitiv yuklamani keskin oshiradi. O'quvchilarga oraliq yarim-erkin (semi-controlled) mashqlar, tayanch frazalar (sentence starters) va muloqot uchun aniq maqsad (communicative goal) kerak.

q: Sherzod darsni qiziqarli rasm namoyishi bilan boshladi (Engage), so'ngra darhol o'quvchilarga suratdagi voqea bo'yicha hikoya to'qish topshirig'ini berdi (Activate). O'quvchilar hikoya tuzishda qiyinchilikka duch kelgach, Sherzod aynan ular qiynalgan grammatik vositalarni tushuntirib berdi (Study) va qaytadan hikoyani takomillashtirishni so'radi (Activate). Bu qaysi dars tuzilishi?
opts: Dogme Unplugged modeli
Straight Arrows modeli (E -> S -> A)
Grammar-Translation modeli
Boomerang (Bumerang) modeli (E -> A -> S -> A)

mnemonic: Boomerang = E -> A -> S -> A (Faoliyat orqali ehtiyojni aniqlab, keyin o'rgatish).

mnemonic: Practice ierarxiyasi: Controlled -> Meaningful -> Communicative.

q: O'qituvchi sinfdagi o'quvchilarning tayyorgarlik darajasi turlicha ekanligini hisobga olib, matn tahlili uchun 3 bosqichli topshiriq ishlab chiqdi: 1-daraja — matndan asosiy faktlarni ajratish; 2-daraja — muallif nuqtayi nazarini tahlil qilish; 3-daraja — matndagi g'oyaga asoslanib muqobil yechim taklif etish. O'quvchilarni tabaqalarga ajratib, past o'zlashtiruvchilarni darsdan chetlatish strategiyasi.

q:
Read the passage:
"Dual-process cognitive architectures partition human reasoning into two discrete operational modalities: System 1 and System 2. System 1 operates automatically, rapidly, and unconsciously, relying on associative memory and evolutionary heuristics to navigate daily tasks with minimal metabolic expenditure. Conversely, System 2 is deliberate, analytical, and cognitively effortful, governing formal logic, statistical deduction, and the suppression of visceral impulses. q:
Read the passage:
"Winston kept his back turned toward the telescreen; though as he well knew, even a back can be revealing. He laid the nib on the page, conscious that his heart was hammering against his ribs like a trapped bird. The diary was a heavy, quarto-sized book with cream-laid paper, yellowed by age. To write in it was not strictly illegal—nothing was illegal, since there were no longer any laws—but if detected it was reasonably certain that it would be punished by death, or at least twenty-five years in a forced-labor camp. He dipped the pen and then hesitated. A tremor had gone through his bowels. To mark the paper was the decisive act."

The phrase "nothing was illegal, since there were no longer any laws" exemplifies which rhetorical device?
opts: Oxymoron describing peaceful battlefield truces between warring empires.
Metaphor comparing state edicts to architectural monuments.
Hyperbole that exaggerates the freedom enjoyed by working-class citizens.
Irony that exposes the insidious nature of arbitrary totalitarian power.
explanation: It is chilling political irony: the absence of formal laws does not mean liberty; it means the state exercises absolute, arbitrary terror without legal boundaries.

q: Jamshid Jeremy Harmerning 'ESA' (Engage, Study, Activate) konsepsiyasiga tayanib dars o'tmoqda. U quyidagi ketma-ketlikni qo'lladi: Qiziqtirish (Engage) -> Erkin faoliyat (Activate) -> Grammatik tahlil (Study) -> Yangi muloqot (Activate) -> Yana tahlil (Study). Ushbu dars modeli Harmer tasnifiga ko'ra qaysi dars tuzilishiga kiradi?
opts: Straight Arrows (To'g'ri o'qlar) an'anaviy dars modeli
Patchwork (Yamoqli/Murakkab uyg'unlashgan) dars modeli
Boomerang (Qaytuvchi bumerang) dars modeli
Audio-Lingual mexanik dars modeli
explanation: Harmer ESA tizimida 3 xil modelni ajratadi: 1) Straight Arrows (E -> S -> A); 2) Boomerang (E -> A -> S -> A); 3) Patchwork (E -> A -> S -> A -> S -> A kabi bir nechta bosqichlar erkin va uyg'un ravishda almashib keladi).

q: An'anaviy PPP (Presentation - Practice - Production) modeli bilan zamonaviy TBLT (Task-Based Language Teaching) modeli o'rtasidagi dars tuzilmasining tub farqi nimada?
opts: Ikkala model bir xil bo'lib, faqat nomlanishida Britaniya va Amerika imlosi farqlanadi.
PPP modeli faqat tinglab tushunishni o'rgatadi; TBLT esa faqat fonetik talaffuzni shakllantiradi.
PPP modeli o'quvchilar markaziga qurilgan; TBLT esa o'qituvchining qat'iy diktati ostida kechadi.

PPP modelida dars til birligini (qoidani) tushuntirishdan amaliyotga qarab boradi; TBLT modelida esa dars markazida real kommunikativ vazifa turadi va til birliklari vazifani bajarish ehtiyojidan kelib chiqib o'rganiladi.
explanation: PPP — deduktiv, strukturaviy model (avval forma o'rgatiladi, keyin qo'llaniladi). TBLT — kommunikativ model: dars maqsadi aniq real vazifani (masalan: sayohat marshrutini tuzish) hal qilish bo'lib, til ushbu vazifa vositasi sifatida o'zlashtiriladi.
mnemonic: PPP = Qoidadan amaliyotga; TBLT = Kommunikativ vazifadan tilga.

Recognizing a close friend's familiar facial features in a crowded supermarket.

Reading a simple traffic billboard written in one's native mother tongue.
mnemonic: Application: System 2 = deliberate, analytical, high-effort auditing.

q: Umida ingliz tili darsida o'quvchisi Shahzodning inglizcha suhbat paytida ma'lum bir so'zni (masalan, 'corkscrew' - po'kakochqich) unutib qo'yganida, dovdirab qolmasdan: "It's a metal tool you use to open a bottle of wine" deb tushuntirib ketganini kuzatdi. Canale va Swain modeli bo'yicha Shahzod qaysi kompetentsiyani namoyish etdi?
opts: Strategik kompetentsiya (Strategic competence) — muloqotdagi uzilishlarni parafraza va aylanma ifodalar orqali bartaraf etish qobiliyati
Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical competence) — so'zlarning morfemik tuzilishini tahlil qilish
Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya (Sociolinguistic competence) — rasmiy va norasmiy uslubni farqlash
Diskursiv kompetentsiya (Discourse competence) — murakkab matnlar orasida bog'lovchilarni qo'llash
explanation: Canale & Swain (1980) modelida Strategik kompetentsiya muloqot jarayonidagi to'siqlar yoki so'z esdan chiqqanda parafraza (circumlocution), imo-ishora yoki muqobil so'zlar orqali muloqotni saqlab qolish mahoratidir.
mnemonic: Strategik kompetentsiya = So'z topilmaganda parafraza orqali muloqotni qutqarish.

q: Otabek o'quvchilarga xalqaro konferensiyada nufuzli professorga murojaat qilish odobini o'rgatmoqda. Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya (Sociolinguistic / Pragmatic competence)

explanation: Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya til birliklarini ijtimoiy-madaniy vaziyatga, so'zlovchilarning maqomi (register, politeness) va muloqot muhitiga mos ravishda to'g'ri tanlash va qo'llash qobiliyatidir.
mnemonic: Sotsiolingvistik = Vaziyat, maqom va madaniy me'yorga mos muloqot (Register & Politeness).

q: Zarina haqiqiy kommunikativ mashg'ulot (CLT activity) loyihalashtirmoqchi. Morrow va Johnson tamoyillariga ko'ra, mashg'ulot chinakam kommunikativ bo'lishi uchun unda qaysi uchta asosiy xususiyat mujassam bo'lishi shart?
opts: So'zma-so'z tarjima (Translation), matnni ifodali o'qish (Loud reading) va yozma diktant (Dictation)
Mexanik takrorlash (Drilling), qat'iy nazorat (Tight control) va grammatik tahlil (Grammar analysis)
Axborot bo'shlig'i (Information gap), tanlov erkinligi (Choice) va natijaviy qayta aloqa (Feedback / Communicative purpose)
O'qituvchining uzluksiz ma'ruzasi (High TTT), jimjitlik (Silence) va individual test (Testing)
explanation: Kommunikativ metodikaning 3 oltin tamoyili: 1) Information gap (bir o'quvchi bilgan narsani ikkinchisi bilmaydi); 2) Choice (o'quvchi qanday til vositalarini tanlashda erkin); 3) Feedback (muloqot maqsadi amalga oshgan-oshmaganligini anglash).

q:
Read the following dialogue between two football fans after their team loses a match:

*Fan A:* "I cannot believe the referee made that controversial penalty call!"
*Fan B:* "Well, business is business, and football is football."

How does Fan B’s tautological statement generate meaning in pragmatic discourse?
opts: By violating the Maxim of Quality, Fan B denies that football is an athletic sport.
By uttering a literal tautology containing zero new empirical information, Fan B flouts the Maxim of Quantity to implicate stoic acceptance of unavoidable realities.
By flouting the Maxim of Manner, Fan B attempts to speak in rhyming iambic pentameter.
By violating the Maxim of Relation, Fan B changes the subject to commercial corporate accounting.
explanation: A tautology ('football is football') is literally uninformative (flouting Quantity: provide informative data), forcing the hearer to infer a pragmatic implicature: that football inherently involves unpredictable flaws that must be philosophically accepted.
mnemonic: Tautology Implicature: Zero literal information forces an implicature of resignation.

q:
Read the following exchange:

*Speaker A:* "Are you coming to Sarah’s birthday banquet tonight?"
*Speaker B:* "My child has a fever of forty degrees."

What type of conversational implicature does Speaker B produce?
opts: A conventional implicature: it is hardwired into the lexical semantics of the conjunction "and".
A generalized conversational implicature: it arises automatically from the sentence structure without requiring any contextual knowledge.
A particularized conversational implicature: its inferential calculation depends strictly on the specific local situational context of the question.
A semantic presupposition: it logically entails that children are forbidden from attending banquets.
explanation: A 'particularized' conversational implicature requires knowledge of the specific context (a child's fever prevents attending a party). A 'generalized' implicature arises independently of specific context (like 'a car' implicating not the speaker's own car).
mnemonic: Particularized Implicature: Dependent on the unique local situational context.

q:

What conventional implicature is carried by the coordinating conjunction *but* in this utterance?
opts: The speaker does not know the truth value of her profession.
All investment bankers are convicted criminal embezzlers.
She has resigned from her position at the investment bank.
There is an inherent contrast or unexpected clash between being an investment banker and being honest.
explanation: 'Conventional implicatures' are not calculated via the Cooperative Principle maxims; they are attached conventionally to specific lexical words (like 'but', 'even', 'yet', 'therefore'). 'But' conventionally implicates an unexpected contrast between the conjoined propositions.
mnemonic: Conventional Implicature: Attached directly to specific words ('but', 'even', 'yet').

"The abyssal plains of the Clarion-Clipperton Zone in the central Pacific host vast fields of polymetallic nodules—mineral concretions rich in nickel, cobalt, and rare earth elements critical for the global green energy transition. However, these nodule fields constitute the fragile structural foundation for specialized benthic ecosystems. Growing at the glacial pace of a few millimeters per million years, the nodules provide hard substrate for sessile sponges, xenophyophores, and octocorals in an otherwise sediment-dominated desert. Heavy industrial dredging would obliterate these biogenic habitats, generating suspended sediment plumes that asphyxiate filter-feeders across thousands of square kilometers of the water column."

q:

How is this utterance interpreted under Gricean pragmatics?
opts: The speaker violates the Maxim of Quality to commit criminal fraud regarding paper mass.
The speaker flouts the Maxim of Quality through obvious hyperbole to emphasize the overwhelming psychological burden of his marking workload.
The speaker flouts the Maxim of Relation by discussing geological mountain formations.

explanation: Hyperbole flouts the Maxim of Quality ('do not say what is false') by stating an impossibility that neither speaker nor listener takes literally, conveying the emotional magnitude of the burden.
mnemonic: Hyperbolic Flouting: Wild physical exaggeration signals subjective magnitude.

"The abyssal plains of the Clarion-Clipperton Zone in the central Pacific host vast fields of polymetallic nodules—mineral concretions rich in nickel, cobalt, and rare earth elements critical for the global green energy transition. However, these nodule fields constitute the fragile structural foundation for specialized benthic ecosystems. Growing at the glacial pace of a few millimeters per million years, the nodules provide hard substrate for sessile sponges, xenophyophores, and octocorals in an otherwise sediment-dominated desert. Heavy industrial dredging would obliterate these biogenic habitats, generating suspended sediment plumes that asphyxiate filter-feeders across thousands of square kilometers of the water column."

Why are polymetallic nodule ecosystems considered particularly vulnerable to irreversible destruction?
mnemonic: Irreversibility: Million-year formation timescale means recovery is impossible.

q: Malika o'quvchilarda Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical / Linguistic competence)ni shakllantirishda an'anaviy yondashuvdan ko'ra zamonaviy CLT yondashuvini qo'llamoqda. Zamonaviy CLT da grammatika qanday o'rgatiladi?
opts: Qoidalarni shunchaki yodlash emas, balki til tuzilmalarini ma'no va muloqot ehtiyojlariga xizmat qiluvchi dinamik vosita sifatida kontekstda o'rganish (Grammaring / Form-Meaning-Use)
Faqat o'zbek tiliga tarjima qilish va yozma formulalarni yoddan so'rash
Grammatikani umuman o'rgatmaslik va e'tibordan chetda qoldirish
O'quvchilarga faqat qiyin istisno qoidalarni diktovka qilish
explanation: Diane Larsen-Freeman ta'riflaganidek, grammatika passiv bilim emas, balki faol 'grammaring' ko'nikmasidir. CLT da grammatika muloqot kontekstida, shakl (Form), ma'no (Meaning) va qo'llanish (Use) birligida o'zlashtiriladi.
mnemonic: Grammaring = Grammatika muloqot vositasi sifatida (Form, Meaning, Use).

q: Jasur darsda o'quvchilarni 'Role-play' (rol ijro etish) va 'Simulation' (simulyatsiya) faoliyatlariga jalb qildi. O'quvchilar aeroportda yo'qolgan yukni topish bo'yicha xodim bilan muzokara olib borishdi. Bunday mashg'ulotning eng katta kommunikativ ustunligi nima?
opts: Faqat qat'iy yozilgan ssenariyni so'zma-so'z xato qilmasdan yoddan aytish
O'quvchilarni real hayotiy ijtimoiy rollarga tayyorlash, emotsional xavfsiz muhitda muloqot tajribasini sinab ko'rish imkoniyati
O'qituvchining barcha o'quvchilar ustidan qat'iy nazoratini saqlab qolishi
Dars vaqtini tejash va yozma mashqlardan qochish
explanation: Rolli o'yinlar va simulyatsiyalar o'quvchilarga sinfdan tashqaridagi real vaziyatlarni modellashtirish, ijtimoiy-lingvistik rollarni o'zlashtirish va kutilmagan muloqot to'siqlarini yengish imkonini beradi.
mnemonic: Role-play & Simulation = Real hayotiy rollarni sinfda xavfsiz mashq qilish.

q: Shahnoza o'z sinfida 'Information-gap activity' o'tkazmoqda. O'quvchi A da ma'lumotlar jadvalining bir qismi bor, O'quvchi B da esa ikkinchi qismi. Ular bir-birlarining varaqlariga qaramasdan savol-javob orqali bo'shliqlarni to'ldirishadi. Nima uchun bu topshiriq an'anaviy savol-javobdan ustun?
opts: Chunki bu usulda o'quvchilar yozish ko'nikmasini umuman ishlatmaydi
Chunki o'qituvchi o'quvchilarning nima gaplashayotganini tushunmaydi
Chunki javob oldindan ma'lum emas; savol beruvchi ma'lumotga haqiqiy ehtiyoj sezadi, bu esa muloqotni sun'iylikdan xalos etadi
Chunki darsda shovqin bo'lmaydi va hamma alohida ishlaydi
explanation: Display question (javobi o'qituvchiga ma'lum savol)dan farqli ravishda, Information-gap mashg'ulotlarida Genuine/Referential questions (haqiqiy ma'lumot talab qiluvchi savollar) ishlatiladi, bu esa autentik muloqotni keltirib chiqaradi.
mnemonic: Information gap = Haqiqiy ma'lumotga ehtiyoj (Referential questions).

q: Bobur CLT darsida o'quvchilarning nutqiy xatolariga munosabat bildirish tamoyillarini belgilamoqda. Fluency (nutq ravonligi) bosqichida o'qituvchining eng to'g'ri pedagogik pozitsiyasi qanday bo'lishi kerak?
opts: Xato qilgan o'quvchiga darhol past baho qo'yish
Har bir fonetik yoki grammatik xato sodir bo'lishi bilanoq o'quvchi gapini to'xtatib, unga 5 marta to'g'ri shaklini takrorlatish
O'quvchilarning barcha xatolarini e'tiborsiz qoldirish va hech qachon xatolar ustida ishlamaslik

Muloqot oqimini to'xtatmaslik, xatolarni darhol tuzatmasdan daftarga qayd qilib borish va faoliyat yakunida butun sinf bilan birgalikda anonim tarzda kechiktirilgan qayta aloqa (delayed feedback) berish
explanation: CLT da ravonlik (fluency) bosqichida muloqot jasorati va ma'no uzatish birlamchi bo'lib, o'qituvchi oraliqqa suqulib kirmaydi (non-intrusive monitoring). Kechiktirilgan qayta aloqa (delayed feedback) muloqot oqimini buzmaydi.
mnemonic: Fluency paytida = Interruption yo'q -> Delayed Feedback dars oxirida.

q: Umida ingliz tili darsida o'quvchisi Shahzodning inglizcha suhbat paytida ma'lum bir so'zni (masalan, 'corkscrew' - po'kakochqich) unutib qo'yganida, dovdirab qolmasdan: "It's a metal tool you use to open a bottle of wine" deb tushuntirib ketganini kuzatdi. Canale va Swain modeli bo'yicha Shahzod qaysi kompetentsiyani namoyish etdi?
opts: Strategik kompetentsiya (Strategic competence) — muloqotdagi uzilishlarni parafraza va aylanma ifodalar orqali bartaraf etish qobiliyati
Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical competence) — so'zlarning morfemik tuzilishini tahlil qilish
Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya (Sociolinguistic competence) — rasmiy va norasmiy uslubni farqlash
Diskursiv kompetentsiya (Discourse competence) — murakkab matnlar orasida bog'lovchilarni qo'llash
explanation: Canale & Swain (1980) modelida Strategik kompetentsiya muloqot jarayonidagi to'siqlar yoki so'z esdan chiqqanda parafraza (circumlocution), imo-ishora yoki muqobil so'zlar orqali muloqotni saqlab qolish mahoratidir.
mnemonic: Strategik kompetentsiya = So'z topilmaganda parafraza orqali muloqotni qutqarish.

q:

"A recent survey of 1,200 high school students revealed that 68% prefer digital textbooks, 22% still favor printed books, and 10% are indifferent. Teachers reported that digital formats enable quicker updates of content."
Match the percentages with the corresponding groups:
1. Students preferring printed books
2. Students preferring digital textbooks
3. Students indifferent to format
A. 68% – 1, 22% – 2, 10% – 3
B. 22% – 1, 68% – 2, 10% – 3
C. 10% – 1, 68% – 2, 22% – 3
D. 68% – 3, 22% – 1, 10% – 2
explanation: The passage states 68% prefer digital textbooks (group 2), 22% prefer printed books (group 1), and 10% are indifferent (group 3). Option B reflects this correct mapping. The other options misplace the percentages.

q: Otabek o'quvchilarga xalqaro konferensiyada nufuzli professorga murojaat qilish odobini o'rgatmoqda. O'quvchi professorga "Hey mate, give me your slides!" deb murojaat qilganda, o'qituvchi buni uslubiy xato deb tuzatdi. Tilning vaziyatga, ijtimoiy maqomga va madaniy kontekstga mos kelishini ta'minlovchi kompetentsiya qaysi?
opts: Tashkiliy-sintaktik kompetentsiya (Organizational competence)
Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya (Sociolinguistic / Pragmatic competence)
Fonologik kompetentsiya (Phonological competence)
Leksik-mexanik kompetentsiya (Lexical mechanical competence)
explanation: Sotsiolingvistik kompetentsiya til birliklarini ijtimoiy-madaniy vaziyatga, so'zlovchilarning maqomi (register, politeness) va muloqot muhitiga mos ravishda to'g'ri tanlash va qo'llash qobiliyatidir.
mnemonic: Sotsiolingvistik = Vaziyat, maqom va madaniy me'yorga mos muloqot (Register & Politeness).

q: Zarina haqiqiy kommunikativ mashg'ulot (CLT activity) loyihalashtirmoqchi. Morrow va Johnson tamoyillariga ko'ra, mashg'ulot chinakam kommunikativ bo'lishi uchun unda qaysi uchta asosiy xususiyat mujassam bo'lishi shart?
opts: So'zma-so'z tarjima (Translation), matnni ifodali o'qish (Loud reading) va yozma diktant (Dictation)
Mexanik takrorlash (Drilling), qat'iy nazorat (Tight control) va grammatik tahlil (Grammar analysis)
Axborot bo'shlig'i (Information gap), tanlov erkinligi (Choice) va natijaviy qayta aloqa (Feedback / Communicative purpose)
O'qituvchining uzluksiz ma'ruzasi (High TTT), jimjitlik (Silence) va individual test (Testing)
explanation: Kommunikativ metodikaning 3 oltin tamoyili: 1) Information gap (bir o'quvchi bilgan narsani ikkinchisi bilmaydi); 2) Choice (o'quvchi qanday til vositalarini tanlashda erkin); 3) Feedback (muloqot maqsadi amalga oshgan-oshmaganligini anglash).
mnemonic: CLT Uchligi = Information Gap + Choice + Communicative Feedback.

q: Sherzod 11-sinf o'quvchisining inshosini tekshirar ekan, har bir gap alohida olinganda grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri tuzilgan bo'lsa-da, gaplar o'rtasida mantiqiy bog'liqlik (coherence) va bog'lovchi vositalar (cohesion) yetishmayotganini ko'rdi. O'quvchida qaysi kommunikativ kompetentsiya turi yetarlicha rivojlanmagan?
opts: Fonetik kompetentsiya (Phonetic competence)
Grammatik kompetentsiya (Grammatical competence)
Strategik kompetentsiya (Strategic competence)
Diskursiv kompetentsiya (Discourse competence)
explanation: Diskursiv kompetentsiya — alohida gaplarni yaxlit, mantiqiy va mazmunan bog'langan (coherent & cohesive) og'zaki yoki yozma matn holiga keltirish qobiliyatidir.
mnemonic: Diskursiv kompetentsiya = Gaplarni yaxlit va mantiqiy matnga aylantirish (Cohesion & Coherence).

q: Dars rejasida fanlararo bog'lanishlarni to'g'ri rejalashtirish o'quvchida qanday fundamental kompetensiyani shakllantirishga xizmat qiladi?
opts: Darsliklar sonini qisqartirish orqali maktab xarajatlarini tejashni.
Boshqa fanlar o'qituvchilarining dars soatlarini qisqartirib, faqat bitta fanni o'rganish istagini.
O'quvchilarni barcha fanlardan bir xil vaqtda respublika olimpiadasiga tayyorlashni.
Dunyoning yaxlit ilmiy manzarasini anglash, bilimlarni fragmentar (bo'laklangan) emas, balki o'zaro tizimli aloqadorlikda ko'ra bilish qobiliyatini.
explanation: Fanlararo integratsiya bilimlarning sun'iy chegaralarini yo'qotadi, o'quvchida voqelikni yaxlit tizim sifatida ko'rish va turli fanlarda o'rganilgan printsiplarni real hayotiy muammolarni yechishda kompleks qo'llash ko'nikmasini shakllantiradi.
mnemonic: Fanlararo aloqa = Yaxlit tizimli dunyoqarash (Holistic worldview).

q:
A passenger who has just survived a catastrophic plane crash that severed both wings and destroyed the engines steps onto the tarmac and remarks:

*"Well, that was not the smoothest flight I have ever experienced."*

What pragmatic figure is utilized here, and which maxim does it flout?
opts: Tautology: it flouts the Maxim of Manner by repeating identical grammatical predicates.
Hyperbole: it flouts the Maxim of Quantity by exaggerating the smoothness of the landing.
Litotes (ironic understatement): it flouts the Maxim of Quality to generate an implicature of extreme peril through a negated contrary.
Metaphor: it violates the Maxim of Relation by describing flight aviation mechanics.
explanation: Litotes (understatement by denying the contrary: 'not the smoothest') flouts the Maxim of Quality to produce a wry, darkly humorous implicature regarding how terrifying the flight was.
mnemonic: Litotes Flouting: Understating a catastrophe through negation flouts Quality.

The bustling seaside entertainment symbolizes the narrator’s vibrant entrepreneurial future.

q:
Read the passage:
"It is sometimes said that a butler of the first rank must inhabit his professional role as an actor inhabits a dramatic character. Looking back upon those crucial days in the summer of 1935, I can say with modesty that I never allowed my exterior composure to falter, even when Miss Kenton stood before me in the pantry, weeping bitterly after her engagement was announced. One must not indulge in sentimental trivialities when great international affairs are being adjudicated under one's master's roof. Yet, sitting here on this seaside pier as the evening lights flicker on the water, a strange fatigue overcomes me. One cannot help wondering: in suppressing one's private heart in the name of duty, did one merely waste one's life in the service of a hollow illusion?"

What thematic contrast is established by the setting on the "seaside pier as evening lights flicker"?
options: The saltwater ocean represents the geographic distance separating Britain from colonial outposts.
The bustling seaside entertainment symbolizes the narrator’s vibrant entrepreneurial future.
The twilight of the day mirrors the twilight of the narrator’s aging life and the collapse of his grand illusions.
The electric pier lights indicate that industrial modernization has eradicated poverty.

q:

mnemonic: Metaphor as Quality Flouting: Literal biological falsehood triggers trait mapping.

q:
Read the meteorological advisory:

*"It is possible that torrential flash floods will strike the valley tonight."*

Under the modal scale <certain, probable, possible>, what does this advisory pragmatically implicate?
opts: It is not certain that flash floods will strike the valley tonight.
Flash floods are guaranteed to submerge the entire valley beyond all doubt.
Meteorological radars have failed and cannot detect any moisture.
The atmospheric moisture has completely dissipated into desert air.
explanation: Choosing the lowest scalar item 'possible' generates the upper-bounded scalar implicature 'possible, but not certain'.
mnemonic: Scalar Modals: 'Possible' scalar implicates 'not certain / not guaranteed'.

q:
Two parents are sitting in the parlor with their four-year-old child. One parent says to the other:

*"I believe it is time to transport our small dependent to the S-L-E-E-P chamber."*

Why did the speaker spell out the word and use clinical jargon, and which maxim is flouted?
opts: The speaker violates the Maxim of Quality because the child is actually twenty-five years old.
The speaker flouts the Maxim of Manner (avoid obscurity) to generate an implicature for the adult while intentionally preventing the child from decoding the message.
The speaker opts out of the Cooperative Principle because spelling is illegal in domestic settings.
The speaker infringes the Maxim of Relation by discussing chamber architecture.
explanation: Spelling out words or using obscure jargon in front of eavesdroppers flouts Manner ('be clear and avoid obscurity') with the deliberate pragmatic purpose of communicating with one hearer while keeping another in the dark.
mnemonic: Manner Flouting (Spelling): Deliberate obscurity to exclude a third-party hearer.

q: Dars rejasida "dars maromi" (Pacing) tushunchasi nimani anglatadi va u nima uchun o'ta muhim?

mnemonic: Dars maromi (Pacing) = Didaktik tezlik va faoliyatlar almashinuv balansi.

q: Jasur CLIL darsida baholash tizimini ishlab chiqmoqda. CLIL metodikasida o'quvchilarning natijalarini baholashda qaysi oltin tamoyilga qat'iy amal qilinishi kerak?
opts: Har qanday kichik imlo xatosi uchun o'quvchining fan bo'yicha to'plagan barcha ballari nolga tenglashtirilishi shart

Baholashda fan mazmuni (content) va til ko'nikmalari (language) alohida mezonlar asosida differentsial baholanishi lozim; o'quvchining ilmiy g'oyasi to'g'ri bo'lsa, kichik grammatik xatolar uchun fan bahosi pasaytirilmasligi kerak
CLIL darslarida faqat grammatika baholanadi, fan mazmuni umuman hisobga olinmaydi
Faqat darsda eng baland ovozda gapirgan o'quvchilargagina a'lo baho qo'yiladi
explanation: CLIL baholashida fan mazmuni va til alohida baholanishi shart. Agar o'quvchi ilmiy g'oyani to'g'ri tushungan va ifodalay olgan bo'lsa, til xatolari fan mazmunini bilish darajasiga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmasligi kerak.
mnemonic: CLIL Baholash = Fan mazmuni va Til alohida mezonlar bilan baholanadi.

q: Shahnoza 'Hard CLIL' va 'Soft CLIL' yondashuvlarini solishtirmoqda. Agar maktabda geografiya fani to'liq ingliz tilida geografiya o'qituvchisi tomonidan o'tilsa va asosiy maqsad fan dasturini o'zlashtirish bo'lsa, bu qaysi modelga kiradi?
opts: Direct Translation Method
Soft CLIL (Yumshoq CLIL) — ingliz tili darsi ichida kichik fanga oid mavzu kiritiladi
Hard CLIL (Qattiq/Chuqurlashtirilgan CLIL) — fanning o'zi xorijiy tilda o'qitiladi va dars jadvalida fan sifatida turadi
Grammar Immersion
explanation: Hard CLIL da fanning o'zi (masalan, fizika yoki biologiya) to'liq xorijiy tilda fan o'qituvchisi tomonidan o'qitiladi. Soft CLIL da esa ingliz tili darsiga fanga oid kichik mavzu integratsiya qilinadi.
mnemonic: Hard CLIL = Fan darsining o'zi L2 da; Soft CLIL = Til darsiga fan mavzusini olib kirish.

q: Bobur CLIL darsida Bloom taksonomiyasining HOTS (Higher Order Thinking Skills — Yuqori darajadagi fikrlash ko'nikmalari) bosqichini faollashtirmoqchi. Quyidagi topshiriqlardan qaysi biri aynan HOTS darajasiga tegishli?
opts: O'qituvchi o'qib bergan sanalarni daftarga qayd etish
Darslikdagi hayvonlar nomlarini alifbo tartibida yozib chiqish
Berilgan 5 ta ta'rifni o'zbek tiliga lug'atdan qarab tarjima qilish
Ekologik ma'lumotlarni tahlil qilish, muqobil energiya manbalarining samaradorligini baholash va maktab uchun yangi 'yashil reja' loyihasini yaratish

mnemonic: HOTS = Tahlil (Analyze) + Baholash (Evaluate) + Yaratish (Create).

Baholashda fan mazmuni (content) va til ko'nikmalari (language) alohida mezonlar asosida differentsial baholanishi lozim; o'quvchining ilmiy g'oyasi to'g'ri bo'lsa, kichik grammatik xatolar uchun fan bahosi pasaytirilmasligi kerak
CLIL darslarida faqat grammatika baholanadi, fan mazmuni umuman hisobga olinmaydi
Faqat darsda eng baland ovozda gapirgan o'quvchilargagina a'lo baho qo'yiladi
explanation: CLIL baholashida fan mazmuni va til alohida baholanishi shart. Agar o'quvchi ilmiy g'oyani to'g'ri tushungan va ifodalay olgan bo'lsa, til xatolari fan mazmunini bilish darajasiga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmasligi kerak.
mnemonic: CLIL Baholash = Fan mazmuni va Til alohida mezonlar bilan baholanadi.

q: Gulbahor 'Hard CLIL' va 'Soft CLIL' yondashuvlarini solishtirmoqda. Agar maktabda geografiya fani to'liq ingliz tilida geografiya o'qituvchisi tomonidan o'tilsa va asosiy maqsad fan dasturini o'zlashtirish bo'lsa, bu qaysi modelga kiradi?
opts: Direct Translation Method
Soft CLIL (Yumshoq CLIL) — ingliz tili darsi ichida kichik fanga oid mavzu kiritiladi
Hard CLIL (Qattiq/Chuqurlashtirilgan CLIL) — fanning o'zi xorijiy tilda o'qitiladi va dars jadvalida fan sifatida turadi
Grammar Immersion
explanation: Hard CLIL da fanning o'zi (masalan, fizika yoki biologiya) to'liq xorijiy tilda fan o'qituvchisi tomonidan o'qitiladi. Soft CLIL da esa ingliz tili darsiga fanga oid kichik mavzu integratsiya qilinadi.
mnemonic: Hard CLIL = Fan darsining o'zi L2 da; Soft CLIL = Til darsiga fan mavzusini olib kirish.

q: Azamat CLIL darsida Bloom taksonomiyasining HOTS (Higher Order Thinking Skills — Yuqori darajadagi fikrlash ko'nikmalari) bosqichini faollashtirmoqchi. Quyidagi topshiriqlardan qaysi biri aynan HOTS darajasiga tegishli?
opts: O'qituvchi o'qib bergan sanalarni daftarga qayd etish
Darslikdagi hayvonlar nomlarini alifbo tartibida yozib chiqish
Berilgan 5 ta ta'rifni o'zbek tiliga lug'atdan qarab tarjima qilish
Ekologik ma'lumotlarni tahlil qilish, muqobil energiya manbalarining samaradorligini baholash va maktab uchun yangi 'yashil reja' loyihasini yaratish
explanation: HOTS (Bloom: Tahlil, Baholash, Yaratish) murakkab kognitiv jarayonlarni o'z ichiga oladi: ma'lumotni tanqidiy baholash, taqqoslash va yangi yechim/loyiha ishlab chiqish.
mnemonic: HOTS = Tahlil (Analyze) + Baholash (Evaluate) + Yaratish (Create).

q: Madina biologiya fani bilan integratsiyalashgan 'Ecosystems and Food Webs' mavzusida CLIL darsini rejalashtirmoqda. Do Coyle tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan '4Cs Framework' konsepsiyasiga binoan, ushbu dars rejasida qaysi to'rtta komponent muvozanatli aks etishi shart?
opts: Content (Fan mazmuni), Communication (Til va muloqot), Cognition (Fikrlash va aqliy jarayonlar), Culture/Community (Madaniyat va dunyoqarash)
Curriculum (Dastur), Control (Nazorat), Correction (Xatolarni tuzatish), Calculation (Baholash)
Conjugation (Tuslanish), Comprehension (Tushunish), Calculation (Hisoblash), Competence (Kompetentsiya)
Cohesion (Bog'liqlik), Coherence (Mantiqiylik), Context (Kontekst), Chunking (Bo'laklash)
explanation: Do Coyle'ning 4Cs modeli CLIL ning nazariy asosidir: Content (fanga oid bilim), Communication (tilni o'rganish va til orqali muloqot), Cognition (Bloom bo'yicha quyi va yuqori darajadagi fikrlash), Culture (madaniyatlararo xabardorlik va o'zlikni anglash).
mnemonic: CLIL 4Cs = Content + Communication + Cognition + Culture.

q: Rustam o'z sinfidagi o'quvchilar tanaffusda ingliz tilida kundalik mavzularda juda ravon va erkin suhbatlashishini (masalan, futbol, ob-havo), biroq CLIL darsida tarixiy manbalarni tahlil qilish va ilmiy xulosa yozishda jiddiy qiynalayotganini kuzatdi. Jim Cummins nazariyasiga ko'ra, bu holat qanday tushuntiriladi?
opts: O'quvchilarda CALP yuqori darajada, lekin BICS umuman mavjud emas
O'quvchilarda BICS (Basic Interpersonal Communicative Skills) yaxshi shakllangan, biroq CALP (Cognitive Academic Language Proficiency) hali yetarli darajada rivojlanmagan
O'quvchilar ikkinchi tilni o'rganishda 'Silent period' (jimlik davri) bosqichida turibdi
O'quvchilarda fonologik eshitish qobiliyati to'liq yo'qolgan
explanation: Jim Cummins nazariyasiga binoan, BICS (kundalik norasmiy muloqot tili) 1-2 yilda shakllanadi, ammo CALP (akademik va ilmiy tafakkur tili) chuqur shakllanishi uchun 5-7 yil talab etiladi. CLIL aynan CALP ni rivojlantirishga xizmat qiladi.
mnemonic: BICS = Oshxona/Ko'cha muloqoti (1-2 yil); CALP = Ilmiy/Akademik til (5-7 yil).

q: Feruza CLIL darsida o'quvchilar uchun til vositalarini tanlashda Do Coyle'ning 'Language Triptych' (Til triptixi) modelidan foydalanmoqda. Ushbu modelga ko'ra 'Language FOR learning' tushunchasi nimani anglatadi?
opts: O'quvchilar topshiriq bajarish davomida kutilmaganda ehtiyoj sezadigan yangi so'zlar
Fanning asosiy lug'at boyligi va atamalari (masalan: fotosintez, xlorofill)
O'quvchilarga dars jarayonida vazifalarni bajarish uchun zarur bo'ladigan funksional muloqot tili (bahslashish, savol berish, guruhda taklif kiritish, xulosa yasash)
Faqat o'qituvchining sinfni boshqarish uchun aytadigan buyruqlari
explanation: Language Triptych 3 qismdan iborat: 1) Language OF learning (mavzuviy atamalar); 2) Language FOR learning (darsda ishlash, bahslashish, fikr bildirish uchun zarur funksional til); 3) Language THROUGH learning (o'rganish jarayonida kashf qilinadigan yangi til birliklari).
mnemonic: Language Triptych: OF (Atamalar), FOR (Faoliyat tili), THROUGH (Yangi kashf qilingan til).

q: Alisher kimyo fani bilan integratsiyalashgan CLIL darsida 8-sinf o'quvchilariga murakkab ilmiy matn berdi. O'quvchilar matn mazmunini tushunishda qiynalmasliklari uchun Alisher qaysi 'scaffolding' (pedagogik tayanch) strategiyasini qo'llashi eng maqsadga muvofiq?
opts: O'quvchilarga lug'atdan foydalanishni qat'iyan taqiqlab, matnni yodlatish
Matnni olib qo'yib, o'quvchilarga mavzuni faqat o'zbek tilida konspekt qildirish
Matndagi barcha gaplarni o'qituvchi o'zi so'zma-so'z tarjima qilib berishi
Matnni vizual grafik organayzerlar (Venn diagrammasi, oqim sxemasi), lug'at glosariysi va jumlalarni boshlovchi tayanch qoliplar (sentence starters) bilan ta'minlash
explanation: CLIL darslarida fan mazmuni murakkab bo'lgani sababli kognitiv yuklamani kamaytirish uchun vizual organayzerlar, jadvallar, glosariy va sintaktik qoliplar (sentence frames) eng samarali scaffolding hisoblanadi.
mnemonic: CLIL Scaffolding = Grafik organayzer + Glosariy + Sintaktik qoliplar.

q: Nodira Cummins'ning 'Quadrant Matrix' (Kognitiv va kontekstual matritsa) modelidan foydalanib CLIL topshiriqlarini baholamoqda. O'quvchilar uchun eng murakkab bo'lgan, ya'ni 'Cognitively Demanding and Context-Reduced' (Yuqori kognitiv talab va kam kontekst) bo'lgan 4-kvadrantga qaysi faoliyat to'g'ri keladi?
opts: Hech qanday rasm yoki diagrammalarsiz iqtisodiy inqiroz sabablari haqida ilmiy insho yozish va tahlil qilish
Do'sti bilan xaritaga qarab yo'nalishni ko'rsatish (surat va imo-ishoralar bilan)
O'qituvchi ko'rsatgan meva rasmlarining nomini aytib berish
Tayyor dialog matnini sherigi bilan rollarga bo'lib ifodali o'qish
explanation: Cummins matritsasining D kvadranti (Quadrant 4) kognitiv jihatdan eng og'ir (CALP) va kontekstual ko'rgazmalilikdan mahrum holatdir (masalan, ilmiy abstrakt tahlil, rasmsiz matn tahlili).
mnemonic: Cummins Quadrant 4 = Kontekstsiz abstrakt ilmiy insho (Eng qiyin CALP bosqichi).

q: "O'quvchilar 15 daqiqalik guruh muhokamasi yakunida berilgan muammoli keys bo'yicha o'z yechimlarini 3 daqiqali taqdimot shaklida himoya qiladilar". Ushbu o'quv maqsadida SMART mezonining qaysi jihati yaqqol ifodalangan?
opts: Time-bound (Vaqt chegarasi aniq belgilangan) — faoliyat va natija uchun qat'iy vaqt me'yori ko'rsatilgan.
Theoretical (Faqat nazariy) — amaliyotdan mutlaqo uzoqlashtirilgan.
Traditional (An'anaviy) — o'tgan asrning boshidagi qoidalarga asoslangan.
Terminological (Faqat terminlar tahlili) — faqat lug'at yodlashga yo'naltirilgan.
explanation: SMART dagi 'T' — Time-bound (vaqt bilan chegaralanganlik) har bir harakat va kutilayotgan mahsulotning aniq vaqt doirasini ko'rsatishni talab qiladi (masalan: 15 daqiqa muhokama, 3 daqiqa taqdimot).
mnemonic: SMART-T = Time-bound (Aniq vaqt doirasiga ega bo'lish).

q:
Consider the following sentence:

*"Some of the delegates signed the armistice; in fact, all of them did."*

What fundamental property of conversational implicatures is demonstrated by the second clause?
opts: Conventionality: the implicature is hardwired into the morphological structure of the noun.
Nondetachability: implicatures remain attached even when lexical synonyms are substituted.
Cancellability / Defeasibility: conversational implicatures can be explicitly revoked or canceled without creating a logical contradiction.
Invariance: implicatures are mathematically immutable across all possible universes.
explanation: Conversational implicatures are defeasible (cancellable): a speaker can explicitly cancel the scalar implicature ('some, but not all') by adding 'in fact, all of them did' without semantic contradiction. (Entailments, by contrast, cannot be canceled).
mnemonic: Defeasibility: Implicatures can be canceled ('some, in fact all') without contradiction.

q:
Read the passage:
"The abyssal plains of the Clarion-Clipperton Zone in the central Pacific host vast fields of polymetallic nodules—mineral concretions rich in nickel, cobalt, and rare earth elements critical for the global green energy transition. However, these nodule fields constitute the fragile structural foundation for specialized benthic ecosystems. Growing at the glacial pace of a few millimeters per million years, the nodules provide hard substrate for sessile sponges, xenophyophores, and octocorals in an otherwise sediment-dominated desert. Heavy industrial dredging would obliterate these biogenic habitats, generating suspended sediment plumes that asphyxiate filter-feeders across thousands of square kilometers of the water column."

The word "sessile" as used in the passage describes organisms that are:
explanation: In biology, 'sessile' means stationary, immobile, anchored to a solid surface (like sponges or corals).
opts: Capable of swimming rapidly through upper pelagic currents.
Highly predatory creatures with articulated claws and jaws.
Parasitic microbes living inside the gut of marine mammals.
Permanently attached to a fixed substrate and unable to move freely.
options: Capable of swimming rapidly through upper pelagic currents.
Highly predatory creatures with articulated claws and jaws.
Parasitic microbes living inside the gut of marine mammals.
Permanently attached to a fixed substrate and unable to move freely.

q: If you substitute synonymous expressions into an utterance (e.g. changing *"He was slightly inebriated"* to *"He was somewhat intoxicated"* or *"He had consumed alcohol"*), the conversational implicature that he was not sober persists. This property is known in pragmatics as:
opts: Reinforceability: repeating a word until it loses all semiotic meaning.
Defeasibility: the capacity of an implicature to be refuted by laboratory data.
Calculability: the mathematical algorithm used to compute acoustic decibels.
Nondetachability: the implicature is tied to the semantic content of the message, not to the specific linguistic lexical form used.
explanation: 'Nondetachability' means that you cannot detach the implicature simply by switching to a synonym with the same semantic sense; the implicature arises from the propositional meaning itself.
mnemonic: Nondetachability: Synonyms carry the exact same conversational implicature.

q: Neil Fleming'ning VARK modeliga (Visual, Auditory, Read/Write, Kinesthetic) muvofiq dars rejalashtirayotgan o'qituvchi o'quv materialini qanday taqdim etishi eng to'g'ri hisoblanadi?
opts: Sinfni to'rt xonaga ajratib, har bir o'quvchiga faqat bitta uslubda dars o'tish va boshqa uslublarni taqiqlash.

Darsda ko'rgazmali infografika (Visual), tushuntirish va audio eshitish (Auditory), matn bilan ishlash (Read/Write) hamda rolli o'yin yoki harakatli amaliyot (Kinesthetic) elementlarini uyg'unlashtirgan multimodal taqdimot yaratish.
Faqat audiokitoblarni eshitish bilan cheklanib, daftarga yozishni to'liq man qilish.
Barcha o'quvchilarga bir xil uslubda faqat qora doskadan ko'chirib yozishni majburlash.
explanation: VARK modeli o'quvchilarning barchasini qat'iy bitta tor qolipga tiqish uchun emas, balki darsda multimodal (turli idrok kanallariga qaratilgan) resurslar va faoliyatlarni uyg'unlashtirib, har bir o'quvchiga materialni qulay yo'l bilan o'zlashtirish imkonini berish uchun qo'llaniladi.
mnemonic: VARK = Ko'rish, Eshitish, O'qish/Yozish, Harakat uyg'unligi (Multimodal ta'lim).

q: In certain cultural or institutional contexts (such as courtroom cross-examinations, commercial advertising, or funeral eulogies), participants do not expect the full observance of certain maxims (e.g., funeral eulogies do not mention negative traits of the deceased). Pragmatists term this:
opts: Suspending a maxim: cultural or genre conventions mutually relax the requirement to observe a specific maxim.
Violating a maxim: criminal fraud punishable by statutory incarceration.
Infringing a maxim: cognitive memory loss caused by traumatic shock.
Opting out of language: reverting to primate vocalizations.
explanation: 'Suspension' occurs when cultural rituals, legal genres, or social conventions create an institutional understanding that a maxim (such as Quality in poetry, or Quantity/Relevance in eulogies) is temporarily not enforced.
mnemonic: Suspending Maxims: Institutional/cultural genres where maxims are mutually waived.

q: Madina o'quvchilarning so'z boyligini oshirishda Michael Lewis tomonidan ilgari surilgan 'Lexical Approach' (Leksik yondashuv) tamoyillariga tayanmoqda. Ushbu yondashuvning markaziy shiori va falsafiy asosi qaysi javobda to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan?
opts: "Til leksikallashgan grammatika emas, balki grammatikalashgan leksikadir" (Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar)
"Til faqat grammatik qoidalar yig'indisi bo'lib, so'zlar unga shunchaki kiritiladi"
"Har bir so'zni alohida-alohida, kontekstdan ajratilgan holda tarjimasi bilan yodlash kerak"
"Grammatik qoidalarni bilmagan odam hech qachon tilda gapira olmaydi"
explanation: Maykl Lyuisning (1993) mashhur aksiomasi: 'Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar'. Ya'ni nutq alohida so'z va sintaksisdan emas, balki tayyor ko'p so'zli leksik bloklar (multi-word chunks) va kollokatsiyalardan yasaladi.
mnemonic: Lexical Approach: Til alohida so'zlardan emas, tayyor leksik bloklardan (chunks) iborat.

q: Rustam darsda o'quvchilarga 'commit a crime', 'make a decision', 'heavy rain', 'by the way', 'as far as I know' kabi birikmalarni yaxlit birlik sifatida o'rgatmoqda. Lewis tasnifiga ko'ra, bunday tayyor qoliplar qanday ataladi va ularning nutq ravonligiga ta'siri qanday?
opts: Erkin tasodifiy iboralar; ular grammatik xatolikni ko'paytiradi
Leksik bloklar (Lexical chunks / formulaic sequences); ular ishchi xotiradagi (working memory) yuklamani kamaytirib, nutq ravonligini (fluency) keskin oshiradi
Sintaktik o'zgaruvchilar; ular faqat badiiy adabiyotda qo'llaniladi
Metaforik xatolar; ularni alohida so'zlarga ajratib tahlil qilish shart
explanation: Formulaic sequences (leksik bloklar) inson miyasida yaxlit bitta so'z kabi saqlanadi. Nutq paytida ularni noldan grammatik yig'ish shart bo'lmagani sababli miyaning kognitiv yuklamasi kamayadi va ravonlik (fluency) ortadi.
mnemonic: Lexical Chunks = Tayyor bloklar -> Miyadagi kognitiv yuklamani kamaytirib, ravonlikni oshiradi.

q: Feruza ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p uchraydigan 'take', 'get', 'make', 'do', 'have' fe'llarini o'qitishda an'anaviy tarjima usuli samarasiz ekanligini angladi. Leksik yondashuvga ko'ra, ushbu 'de-lexicalised verbs' (ma'nosi kollokatsiyaga bog'liq fe'llar) qanday metod bilan o'rgatilishi kerak?
opts: Ularni faqat noto'g'ri fe'llar jadvalidagi 3 ta shakli (V1, V2, V3) bo'yicha yodlatish bilan
Har bir fe'lning lug'atdagi barcha 30 ta ma'nosini ketma-ket yodlatish orqali
Ularni mustaqil ma'noga ega so'z sifatida emas, balki o'zi bilan birga keladigan otlar bilan mustahkam kollokatsion blok holida ('take a break', 'make an effort', 'do homework')
Ularni darslikdan butunlay chiqarib tashlash orqali
explanation: De-lexicalised verbs (take, get, have, make, do) o'z holicha juda umumiy ma'noga ega. Ularning haqiqiy leksik ma'nosi ular birikkan ot orqali yuzaga chiqadi. Shuning uchun ular kollokatsiyalar zanjirida o'rgatilishi shart.
mnemonic: De-lexicalised verbs = Faqat kollokatsiyalar (make progress, do business) orqali o'rganiladi.

q:
Read the passage:
"During early childhood, the human cerebral cortex undergoes exuberant synaptogenesis, generating an overabundance of neural connections. Upon reaching adolescence, however, neurodevelopment pivots toward sweeping synaptic pruning orchestrated by microglial cells. Guided by the principle of neural Darwinism—'use it or lose it'—frequently activated pathways are reinforced with insulating myelin sheaths, whereas redundant or quiescent synapses are enzymatically eliminated. This selective streamlining optimizes cortical processing efficiency and consolidates executive function in the prefrontal cortex, but simultaneously renders the adolescent brain acutely vulnerable to addictive substance exploitation and psychiatric onset."

According to the passage, what governs which synapses are preserved during adolescent neurodevelopment?
opts: The frequency and consistency of neural pathway activation through lived experience and cognitive engagement.
The physical weight and cranial volume of the adolescent skull.
The complete eradication of all insulating myelin sheaths across the brain.
Random enzymatic mutation occurring entirely independently of external stimuli.
explanation: The passage cites 'use it or lose it': 'frequently activated pathways are reinforced with insulating myelin sheaths, whereas redundant or quiescent synapses are enzymatically eliminated'.

q:
Read the passage:
"During early childhood, the human cerebral cortex undergoes exuberant synaptogenesis, generating an overabundance of neural connections. Upon reaching adolescence, however, neurodevelopment pivots toward sweeping synaptic pruning orchestrated by microglial cells. Guided by the principle of neural Darwinism—'use it or lose it'—frequently activated pathways are reinforced with insulating myelin sheaths, whereas redundant or quiescent synapses are enzymatically eliminated. This selective streamlining optimizes cortical processing efficiency and consolidates executive function in the prefrontal cortex, but simultaneously renders the adolescent brain acutely vulnerable to addictive substance exploitation and psychiatric onset."

What developmental trade-off accompanies the adolescent synaptic pruning process?
options: A permanent loss of language comprehension accompanied by improved visual motor reflexes.
Enhanced executive efficiency and cognitive processing paired with heightened susceptibility to addiction and psychiatric disorders.
The complete cessation of all memory formation in exchange for increased physical endurance.
The spontaneous regeneration of dead neurons at the cost of chronic headaches.

q:
During a PhD thesis defense, an examiner asks a candidate:

*Examiner:* "Does your econometric model account for endogenous monetary policy shocks?"
*Candidate:* "Our survey received an outstanding ninety-eight percent response rate in municipal councils."

What is the pragmatic implicature generated by the candidate’s response?
opts: The candidate proves that monetary policy shocks are completely nonexistent.
By flouting the Maxim of Relation through deflecting to sample response rates, the candidate implicates that the model does not account for monetary policy shocks.
The candidate adheres to the Maxim of Quality by presenting relevant macroeconomic data.
The candidate demonstrates that municipal councils set national benchmark interest rates.
explanation: Evading the direct question about monetary policy shocks by boasting about survey response rates flouts Relation, generating the implicature that the candidate's model fails to account for those shocks.
mnemonic: Deflection Implicature: Answering a different question implicates a negative answer to the original.

"Pre-trained autoregressive language models optimize exclusively for next-token probability, mirroring both the erudition and the abhorrent biases present in raw internet corpora. q:
Consider the utterance:

*"Some of the laboratory specimens survived the cryogenic freeze, but not all of them."*

Adding *"but not all of them"* to *"some"* does not sound redundantly tautological because conversational implicatures possess the property of:
opts: Conventionality: they are hardwired into ancient Greek conjunctions.
Nondetachability: they cannot be separated from syntactic phrase trees.
Reinforceability: conversational implicatures can be made explicit without creating bizarre stylistic redundancy.
Invariance: they never change regardless of contextual factors.
explanation: Unlike entailments (which sound absurd when reinforced: *'I have a female sister who is female'*), conversational implicatures can be overtly reinforced (*'some, but not all'*) without sounding bizarre.
mnemonic: Reinforceability: Explicitly adding an implicature sounds natural, not tautological.

q: Dilnoza o'quvchilarning so'z boyligini oshirishda Michael Lewis tomonidan ilgari surilgan 'Lexical Approach' (Leksik yondashuv) tamoyillariga tayanmoqda. Ushbu yondashuvning markaziy shiori va falsafiy asosi qaysi javobda to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan?
opts: "Til leksikallashgan grammatika emas, balki grammatikalashgan leksikadir" (Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar)
"Til faqat grammatik qoidalar yig'indisi bo'lib, so'zlar unga shunchaki kiritiladi"
"Har bir so'zni alohida-alohida, kontekstdan ajratilgan holda tarjimasi bilan yodlash kerak"
"Grammatik qoidalarni bilmagan odam hech qachon tilda gapira olmaydi"
explanation: Maykl Lyuisning (1993) mashhur aksiomasi: 'Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar'. Ya'ni nutq alohida so'z va sintaksisdan emas, balki tayyor ko'p so'zli leksik bloklar (multi-word chunks) va kollokatsiyalardan yasaladi.
mnemonic: Lexical Approach: Til alohida so'zlardan emas, tayyor leksik bloklardan (chunks) iborat.
