q: Jamshid darsda o'quvchilarga 'commit a crime', 'make a decision', 'heavy rain', 'by the way', 'as far as I know' kabi birikmalarni yaxlit birlik sifatida o'rgatmoqda. Lewis tasnifiga ko'ra, bunday tayyor qoliplar qanday ataladi va ularning nutq ravonligiga ta'siri qanday?
opts: Erkin tasodifiy iboralar; ular grammatik xatolikni ko'paytiradi
Leksik bloklar (Lexical chunks / formulaic sequences); ular ishchi xotiradagi (working memory) yuklamani kamaytirib, nutq ravonligini (fluency) keskin oshiradi
Sintaktik o'zgaruvchilar; ular faqat badiiy adabiyotda qo'llaniladi
Metaforik xatolar; ularni alohida so'zlarga ajratib tahlil qilish shart
explanation: Formulaic sequences (leksik bloklar) inson miyasida yaxlit bitta so'z kabi saqlanadi. Nutq paytida ularni noldan grammatik yig'ish shart bo'lmagani sababli miyaning kognitiv yuklamasi kamayadi va ravonlik (fluency) ortadi.
mnemonic: Lexical Chunks = Tayyor bloklar -> Miyadagi kognitiv yuklamani kamaytirib, ravonlikni oshiradi.

opts: Ularni faqat noto'g'ri fe'llar jadvalidagi 3 ta shakli (V1, V2, V3) bo'yicha yodlatish bilan

Ularni mustaqil ma'noga ega so'z sifatida emas, balki o'zi bilan birga keladigan otlar bilan mustahkam kollokatsion blok holida ('take a break', 'make an effort', 'do homework')
Ularni darslikdan butunlay chiqarib tashlash orqali
explanation: De-lexicalised verbs (take, get, have, make, do) o'z holicha juda umumiy ma'noga ega. Ularning haqiqiy leksik ma'nosi ular birikkan ot orqali yuzaga chiqadi. Shuning uchun ular kollokatsiyalar zanjirida o'rgatilishi shart.
mnemonic: De-lexicalised verbs = Faqat kollokatsiyalar (make progress, do business) orqali o'rganiladi.

q:
When a speaker says:

The hearer immediately infers that the house and the dog did not belong to the speaker. This inference is:
opts: A generalized conversational implicature triggered by the indefinite article "a", which routinely implicates non-belonging unless specified otherwise.
A particularized implicature that requires secret knowledge of the speaker’s mortgage history.
A logical entailment that makes it physically impossible for the speaker to own a pet.
A semantic presupposition triggered by the past tense verb "walked".
explanation: In English, using the indefinite article 'a [noun]' (as opposed to possessive 'my house') triggers a generalized conversational implicature that the referent is not intimately associated with the speaker.
mnemonic: Generalized Indefinite: 'a car / a house' implicates not my own car/house.

q: Umida o'quvchilarning so'z boyligini oshirishda Michael Lewis tomonidan ilgari surilgan 'Lexical Approach' (Leksik yondashuv) tamoyillariga tayanmoqda. Ushbu yondashuvning markaziy shiori va falsafiy asosi qaysi javobda to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan?
opts: "Til leksikallashgan grammatika emas, balki grammatikalashgan leksikadir" (Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar)
"Til faqat grammatik qoidalar yig'indisi bo'lib, so'zlar unga shunchaki kiritiladi"
"Har bir so'zni alohida-alohida, kontekstdan ajratilgan holda tarjimasi bilan yodlash kerak"

explanation: Maykl Lyuisning (1993) mashhur aksiomasi: 'Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar'. Ya'ni nutq alohida so'z va sintaksisdan emas, balki tayyor ko'p so'zli leksik bloklar (multi-word chunks) va kollokatsiyalardan yasaladi.
mnemonic: Lexical Approach: Til alohida so'zlardan emas, tayyor leksik bloklardan (chunks) iborat.

q: Jon Svellerning (John Sweller) Kognitiv yuklama nazariyasiga ko'ra, dars taqdimotida bir vaqtning o'zida ham uzun matnni ekranga chiqarish, ham o'qituvchi tomonidan o'sha matnni so'zma-so'z o'qib berilishi nega o'rganish samaradorligini pasaytiradi?
opts: Pedagogik etika darsda kompyuterdan foydalanishni umuman taqiqlaydi.
Chunki o'quvchilar ko'zoynak taqmagan bo'lsa, slayd matnini ko'ra olmaydilar.
Bunday taqdimotlar maktab elektr tarmog'ida ortiqcha energiya sarfini keltirib chiqaradi.
Ushbu holat "ortiqcha yuklama" (Redundancy effect) keltirib chiqaradi va ishchi xotiraning (working memory) cheklangan imkoniyatini zo'riqtirib, tushunishni qiyinlashtiradi.
explanation: Insonning ishchi xotirasi (working memory) cheklangan hajmga ega. Bir xil ma'lumot ham ko'rish (matn), ham eshitish (o'qish) kanallariga bir vaqtda ortiqcha uzatilsa (Redundancy effect), miya zo'riqadi va o'zlashtirish pasayadi.
mnemonic: Redundancy effect: Slayddagi matnni so'zma-so'z o'qib berish miyani toliqtiradi.

q: Otabek darsda o'quvchilarga 'commit a crime', 'make a decision', 'heavy rain', 'by the way', 'as far as I know' kabi birikmalarni yaxlit birlik sifatida o'rgatmoqda. Lewis tasnifiga ko'ra, bunday tayyor qoliplar qanday ataladi va ularning nutq ravonligiga ta'siri qanday?

Leksik bloklar (Lexical chunks / formulaic sequences); ular ishchi xotiradagi (working memory) yuklamani kamaytirib, nutq ravonligini (fluency) keskin oshiradi

explanation: Formulaic sequences (leksik bloklar) inson miyasida yaxlit bitta so'z kabi saqlanadi. Nutq paytida ularni noldan grammatik yig'ish shart bo'lmagani sababli miyaning kognitiv yuklamasi kamayadi va ravonlik (fluency) ortadi.
mnemonic: Lexical Chunks = Tayyor bloklar -> Miyadagi kognitiv yuklamani kamaytirib, ravonlikni oshiradi.

A lost driver rolls down his window in an unfamiliar city and asks a pedestrian:

*Driver:* "Where is the nearest petrol station?"
*Pedestrian:* "Somewhere in the northern hemisphere."

What pragmatic response does the pedestrian execute?
opts: The pedestrian violates the Maxim of Quality by stating a geographical untruth.
The pedestrian flouts the Maxim of Quantity by giving comically insufficient, broad information, generating an implicature of unhelpfulness or ignorance.
The pedestrian adheres to the Maxim of Relation by giving precise GPS latitude coordinates.
The pedestrian observes the Maxim of Manner by speaking with supreme local efficiency.
explanation: Stating 'in the northern hemisphere' when street-level directions are needed is absurdly under-informative (flouting Quantity), implicating either that the pedestrian has no idea or refuses to assist.
mnemonic: Gross Under-Informativeness: Flouts Quantity to signal total lack of useful knowledge.

q: Zarina ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p uchraydigan 'take', 'get', 'make', 'do', 'have' fe'llarini o'qitishda an'anaviy tarjima usuli samarasiz ekanligini angladi. Leksik yondashuvga ko'ra, ushbu 'de-lexicalised verbs' (ma'nosi kollokatsiyaga bog'liq fe'llar) qanday metod bilan o'rgatilishi kerak?
opts: Ularni faqat noto'g'ri fe'llar jadvalidagi 3 ta shakli (V1, V2, V3) bo'yicha yodlatish bilan
Har bir fe'lning lug'atdagi barcha 30 ta ma'nosini ketma-ket yodlatish orqali
Ularni mustaqil ma'noga ega so'z sifatida emas, balki o'zi bilan birga keladigan otlar bilan mustahkam kollokatsion blok holida ('take a break', 'make an effort', 'do homework')
Ularni darslikdan butunlay chiqarib tashlash orqali
explanation: De-lexicalised verbs (take, get, have, make, do) o'z holicha juda umumiy ma'noga ega. Ularning haqiqiy leksik ma'nosi ular birikkan ot orqali yuzaga chiqadi. Shuning uchun ular kollokatsiyalar zanjirida o'rgatilishi shart.
mnemonic: De-lexicalised verbs = Faqat kollokatsiyalar (make progress, do business) orqali o'rganiladi.

How does this rhetorical question function under the Gricean framework?
opts: It observes the Maxim of Relation by requesting an empirical analysis of arboreal cellulose.
It violates the Maxim of Manner by utilizing complex botanical agricultural vocabulary.
It flouts the Maxim of Quality by posing a proposition whose literal assertion is absurdly false, implicating that funding is scarce and strictly finite.
It opts out of the Cooperative Principle by refusing to convene budget deliberations.
explanation: A rhetorical question flouts Quality: the speaker does not desire information, but asserts the obvious absurdity of the premise to force an implicature of fiscal scarcity.
mnemonic: Rhetorical Question: Flouts Quality to assert the obvious absurdity of the premise.

q: Which of the following pairs demonstrates a relationship of **semantic entailment** rather than pragmatic conversational implicature?
opts: Premise: "The coffee was warm." → Proposition: "The coffee was not hot."
Premise: "I managed to finish the examination." → Proposition: "The examination was exceptionally difficult."
Premise: "Some students passed the exam." → Proposition: "Not all students passed the exam."
Premise: "The assassin murdered the prime minister." → Proposition: "The prime minister is dead."
explanation: If an assassin murdered the prime minister, the prime minister is dead by absolute logical necessity (semantic entailment; cannot be canceled). The other three are pragmatic implicatures that can be canceled.
mnemonic: Entailment vs Implicature: If premise is true, entailment MUST be true logically.

q:

Under the scale <and, or>, what pragmatic implicature is generated by *or*?

Candidates are strictly required to take both gifts simultaneously.
Candidates will receive neither of the commemorative awards.
The university has canceled the commencement convocation ceremony.
explanation: On the scale <and, or>, using 'or' generates the scalar implicature that the stronger assertion 'and' does not hold, yielding an exclusive interpretation: 'one or the other, but not both'.
mnemonic: Scalar 'Or': Implicates 'not both' under the Maxim of Quantity.

q: Madina o'quvchilarning so'z boyligini oshirishda Michael Lewis tomonidan ilgari surilgan 'Lexical Approach' (Leksik yondashuv) tamoyillariga tayanmoqda. Ushbu yondashuvning markaziy shiori va falsafiy asosi qaysi javobda to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan?
opts: "Til leksikallashgan grammatika emas, balki grammatikalashgan leksikadir" (Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar)
"Til faqat grammatik qoidalar yig'indisi bo'lib, so'zlar unga shunchaki kiritiladi"
"Har bir so'zni alohida-alohida, kontekstdan ajratilgan holda tarjimasi bilan yodlash kerak"
"Grammatik qoidalarni bilmagan odam hech qachon tilda gapira olmaydi"
explanation: Maykl Lyuisning (1993) mashhur aksiomasi: 'Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar'. Ya'ni nutq alohida so'z va sintaksisdan emas, balki tayyor ko'p so'zli leksik bloklar (multi-word chunks) va kollokatsiyalardan yasaladi.
mnemonic: Lexical Approach: Til alohida so'zlardan emas, tayyor leksik bloklardan (chunks) iborat.

q: Rustam darsda o'quvchilarga 'commit a crime', 'make a decision', 'heavy rain', 'by the way', 'as far as I know' kabi birikmalarni yaxlit birlik sifatida o'rgatmoqda. Lewis tasnifiga ko'ra, bunday tayyor qoliplar qanday ataladi va ularning nutq ravonligiga ta'siri qanday?
opts: Erkin tasodifiy iboralar; ular grammatik xatolikni ko'paytiradi
Leksik bloklar (Lexical chunks / formulaic sequences); ular ishchi xotiradagi (working memory) yuklamani kamaytirib, nutq ravonligini (fluency) keskin oshiradi
Sintaktik o'zgaruvchilar; ular faqat badiiy adabiyotda qo'llaniladi
Metaforik xatolar; ularni alohida so'zlarga ajratib tahlil qilish shart
explanation: Formulaic sequences (leksik bloklar) inson miyasida yaxlit bitta so'z kabi saqlanadi. Nutq paytida ularni noldan grammatik yig'ish shart bo'lmagani sababli miyaning kognitiv yuklamasi kamayadi va ravonlik (fluency) ortadi.
mnemonic: Lexical Chunks = Tayyor bloklar -> Miyadagi kognitiv yuklamani kamaytirib, ravonlikni oshiradi.

q: Feruza ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p uchraydigan 'take', 'get', 'make', 'do', 'have' fe'llarini o'qitishda an'anaviy tarjima usuli samarasiz ekanligini angladi. Leksik yondashuvga ko'ra, ushbu 'de-lexicalised verbs' (ma'nosi kollokatsiyaga bog'liq fe'llar) qanday metod bilan o'rgatilishi kerak?
opts: Ularni faqat noto'g'ri fe'llar jadvalidagi 3 ta shakli (V1, V2, V3) bo'yicha yodlatish bilan
Har bir fe'lning lug'atdagi barcha 30 ta ma'nosini ketma-ket yodlatish orqali
Ularni mustaqil ma'noga ega so'z sifatida emas, balki o'zi bilan birga keladigan otlar bilan mustahkam kollokatsion blok holida ('take a break', 'make an effort', 'do homework')
Ularni darslikdan butunlay chiqarib tashlash orqali
explanation: De-lexicalised verbs (take, get, have, make, do) o'z holicha juda umumiy ma'noga ega. Ularning haqiqiy leksik ma'nosi ular birikkan ot orqali yuzaga chiqadi. Shuning uchun ular kollokatsiyalar zanjirida o'rgatilishi shart.
mnemonic: De-lexicalised verbs = Faqat kollokatsiyalar (make progress, do business) orqali o'rganiladi.

mnemonic: Noticing chunks = Tilni individual so'zlar emas, tayyor bloklar sifatida ko'ra olish.

A literary critic writes:

*"The author’s latest novel is not uninteresting."*

Why did the critic choose *"not uninteresting"* instead of *"interesting"*, and what is the pragmatic effect?
opts: The critic strictly observes the Maxim of Quantity by using the fewest possible syllables.
The critic violates the Maxim of Quality because the novel is completely illegible.
By flouting the Maxim of Manner (avoiding obscurity), the double negative creates a nuanced hedge, implicating faint, unenthusiastic, lukewarm praise.

explanation: Using litotic double negatives ('not uninteresting') flouts Manner ('be clear and direct'), implicating lukewarm, qualified praise (it is somewhat interesting, but far from great).

q: Ingliz tili grammatikasini o'qitishda deduktiv va induktiv dars rejalashtirish usullarining eng to'g'ri qiyosi qaysi javobda ko'rsatilgan?
opts: Deduktiv usul faqat yozma nutqqa, induktiv usul esa faqat tinglab tushunishga mo'ljallangan.
Deduktiv usulda avval qoida tushuntirilib, so'ng amaliy misollarga o'tiladi; induktiv usulda esa avval misollar va kontekst tahlil qilinib, o'quvchilar qoidani o'zlari chiqaradilar.
Deduktiv usul o'quvchiga yo'naltirilgan, induktiv usul esa faqat o'qituvchi ma'ruzasiga tayanadi.
Ikkala usul ham faqat lug'at diktanti yozdirish uchun qo'llaniladi.
explanation: Deduktiv (umumiy qoidadan xususiy misolga) — an'anaviy yo'l. Induktiv (xususiy misollardan umumiy qoidaga) — kashfiyotga asoslangan konstruktivistik yo'ldir.
mnemonic: Deduktiv = Qoida -> Misol; Induktiv = Misollar -> Qoida.

q: Dilnoza o'quvchilarning so'z boyligini oshirishda Michael Lewis tomonidan ilgari surilgan 'Lexical Approach' (Leksik yondashuv) tamoyillariga tayanmoqda. Ushbu yondashuvning markaziy shiori va falsafiy asosi qaysi javobda to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan?
opts: "Til leksikallashgan grammatika emas, balki grammatikalashgan leksikadir" (Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar)
"Til faqat grammatik qoidalar yig'indisi bo'lib, so'zlar unga shunchaki kiritiladi"
"Har bir so'zni alohida-alohida, kontekstdan ajratilgan holda tarjimasi bilan yodlash kerak"
"Grammatik qoidalarni bilmagan odam hech qachon tilda gapira olmaydi"
explanation: Maykl Lyuisning (1993) mashhur aksiomasi: 'Language consists of grammaticalised lexis, not lexicalised grammar'. Ya'ni nutq alohida so'z va sintaksisdan emas, balki tayyor ko'p so'zli leksik bloklar (multi-word chunks) va kollokatsiyalardan yasaladi.
mnemonic: Lexical Approach: Til alohida so'zlardan emas, tayyor leksik bloklardan (chunks) iborat.

q: In pragmatic theory, the property that allows a hearer to reconstruct step-by-step the rational inferential path connecting an utterance to its implicature is termed:
opts: Semantic rigidity: the immutable connection between a signifier and a referent.
Phonological detachment: the acoustic pitch contour that signals sarcasm.
Morphological transparency: the ability to divide compound words into morphemes.
Calculability: the hearer can rationally deduce the implicature using the utterance, the context, and the maxims.
explanation: 'Calculability' is Grice's principle that an implicature must be capable of being worked out or deduced through rational reasoning based on the Cooperative Principle and context.
mnemonic: Calculability: Hearers can rationally work out the inferential path to the implicature.

q: Jamshid darsda o'quvchilarga 'commit a crime', 'make a decision', 'heavy rain', 'by the way', 'as far as I know' kabi birikmalarni yaxlit birlik sifatida o'rgatmoqda. Lewis tasnifiga ko'ra, bunday tayyor qoliplar qanday ataladi va ularning nutq ravonligiga ta'siri qanday?
opts: Erkin tasodifiy iboralar; ular grammatik xatolikni ko'paytiradi
Leksik bloklar (Lexical chunks / formulaic sequences); ular ishchi xotiradagi (working memory) yuklamani kamaytirib, nutq ravonligini (fluency) keskin oshiradi
Sintaktik o'zgaruvchilar; ular faqat badiiy adabiyotda qo'llaniladi
Metaforik xatolar; ularni alohida so'zlarga ajratib tahlil qilish shart
explanation: Formulaic sequences (leksik bloklar) inson miyasida yaxlit bitta so'z kabi saqlanadi. Nutq paytida ularni noldan grammatik yig'ish shart bo'lmagani sababli miyaning kognitiv yuklamasi kamayadi va ravonlik (fluency) ortadi.
mnemonic: Lexical Chunks = Tayyor bloklar -> Miyadagi kognitiv yuklamani kamaytirib, ravonlikni oshiradi.

q: Nilufar ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p uchraydigan 'take', 'get', 'make', 'do', 'have' fe'llarini o'qitishda an'anaviy tarjima usuli samarasiz ekanligini angladi. Leksik yondashuvga ko'ra, ushbu 'de-lexicalised verbs' (ma'nosi kollokatsiyaga bog'liq fe'llar) qanday metod bilan o'rgatilishi kerak?
opts: Ularni faqat noto'g'ri fe'llar jadvalidagi 3 ta shakli (V1, V2, V3) bo'yicha yodlatish bilan
Har bir fe'lning lug'atdagi barcha 30 ta ma'nosini ketma-ket yodlatish orqali
Ularni mustaqil ma'noga ega so'z sifatida emas, balki o'zi bilan birga keladigan otlar bilan mustahkam kollokatsion blok holida ('take a break', 'make an effort', 'do homework')
Ularni darslikdan butunlay chiqarib tashlash orqali
explanation: De-lexicalised verbs (take, get, have, make, do) o'z holicha juda umumiy ma'noga ega. Ularning haqiqiy leksik ma'nosi ular birikkan ot orqali yuzaga chiqadi. Shuning uchun ular kollokatsiyalar zanjirida o'rgatilishi shart.
mnemonic: De-lexicalised verbs = Faqat kollokatsiyalar (make progress, do business) orqali o'rganiladi.

q: Farhod o'quvchilarga matn berib, undagi noma'lum so'zlarni qidirish o'rniga, matndan bir-biri bilan birikib kelgan 2-3 so'zli turg'un iboralar va kollokatsiyalarni aniqlab, tagiga chizishni topshirdi (Collocation hunting). Ushbu topshiriq o'quvchida qaysi muhim ko'nikmani shakllantiradi?
opts: Imlo xatolarini mexanik tekshirish ko'nikmasi

Faqat passiv zamon shakllarini topish mahorati

explanation: Lexical Approach'da 'Noticing' (e'tibor qaratish va payqash) asosiy o'rin tutadi. O'quvchi tilni individual so'zlar sifatida emas, bloklar shaklida ko'rishni boshlagandagina uning tildan foydalanish qobiliyati sifat jihatidan yangi bosqichga ko'tariladi.
mnemonic: Noticing chunks = Tilni individual so'zlar emas, tayyor bloklar sifatida ko'ra olish.

q: Malika o'quvchilarga yangi so'zlarni yodlatishda an'anaviy alifbo tartibidagi lug'at daftari o'rniga 'Collocation Grids' (kollokatsiya to'rlari) va 'Mind-maps' usulini joriy qildi. Ushbu usulning kognitiv xotiraga ta'siri qanday?
opts: So'zlar miyadagi semantik to'rlarga (semantic networks) bog'lanib, uzoq muddatli xotirada (long-term memory) mustahkam o'rnashadi va nutqda faol chaqirib olinadi

Miyadagi assotsiativ bog'lanishlarni butunlay to'xtatib qo'yadi
explanation: Inson miyasi leksikani alifbo tartibida emas, semantik assotsiatsiyalar va kollokatsion to'rlar ko'rinishida saqlaydi. Kollokatsiya to'rlari (masalan, fe'l + ot) xotirada mustahkam iz qoldiradi.
mnemonic: Collocation Grid = Miyadagi semantik to'r orqali uzoq muddatli eslab qolish.

q: Umida sinfga hech qanday darslik, nusxa ko'chirilgan tarqatmalar yoki slaydlarsiz kirdi. Audio-Lingual Method — laboratoriya mashg'ulotlariga asoslangan metod

q: Zarina maktabda dars o'tishda Berlitz tomonidan ommalashtirilgan 'Direct Method' (To'g'ridan-to'g'ri metod) qoidalariga amal qilmoqda. Ushbu metodning eng qat'iy va asosiy qoidasi qaysi javobda ko'rsatilgan?
opts: O'quvchilar faqat mustaqil ravishda uyda kitob o'qiydilar
Dars faqat ona tilida olib boriladi va har bir gap grammatik tahlil qilinadi
Ona tilidan (L1) foydalanish mutlaqo taqiqlanadi; barcha tushuntirishlar faqat maqsadli tilda (L2), real harakatlar, pantomima va ko'rgazmali qurollar orqali amalga oshiriladi
Barcha yangi so'zlar faqat o'zbekcha tarjimasi bilan diktovka qilinadi
explanation: Direct Method (Berlitz): Darsda ona tiliga (L1) mutlaqo ruxsat berilmaydi. Ma'no to'g'ridan-to'g'ri maqsadli tilda real narsalar (realia), rasmlar va imo-ishoralar vositasida bog'lanadi.
mnemonic: Direct Method = Ona tili (L1) 0% + Faqat maqsadli til (L2) + Ko'rgazmalilik.

q: Sherzod metodika tarixini o'rganar ekan, Georgi Lozanov tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan 'Suggestopedia' metodini tahlil qildi. Ushbu metodda klassik barokko musiqasi, qulay kreslolar va ruhiy relaksatsiyadan foydalanishning asosiy ilmiy maqsadi nima bo'lgan?
opts: Faqat musiqa savodxonligini baholash
O'quvchilarni dars vaqtida uxlab qolishlarini ta'minlash
O'qituvchining darsda gapirish yuklamasini kamaytirish
O'quvchilar ong osti to'siqlarini olib tashlash, psixologik xavotirni minimumga tushirish (desuggestion) va o'rganish tezligini ko'p marotaba oshirish
explanation: Lozanovning Suggestopedia metodi o'quvchidagi psixologik qo'rquv va to'siqlarni (desuggestion) yengillashtirish uchun qulay atmosfera va barokko musiqasidan foydalanib, chet tilini giper-eslab qolishni maqsad qilgan.
mnemonic: Suggestopedia = Barokko musiqasi + Relaksatsiya + Ong osti to'siqlarini olib tashlash.

q: Kamola darsida Caleb Gattegno tomonidan yaratilgan 'Silent Way' (Sukut saqlash metodi) usulini sinab ko'rmoqchi. Ushbu metodda o'qituvchining darsdagi jim turishi (sukuti) qanday pedagogik maqsadga xizmat qiladi?
opts: O'quvchilarda mustaqillik (autonomy), faol kashfiyotchanlik va ichki xatoni o'zi payqash (inner criteria) ko'nikmasini rivojlantirish
O'qituvchining ovozi charchab qolmasligini ta'minlash
Sinfda dars o'tilmayotganini ko'rsatish
O'quvchilarni jazolash usuli sifatida
explanation: The Silent Way metodida o'qituvchi iloji boricha kam gapiradi (silent), Cuisenaire rods (rangli tayoqchalar) va Fidel charts bilan yo'naltiradi, bu orqali o'quvchilarda mustaqil til yaratish va o'z xatosini o'zi tuzatish faollashadi.
mnemonic: Silent Way = O'qituvchi sukuti -> O'quvchining mustaqil kashfiyoti va ichki mezonlari.

q: Sardor James Asher tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan 'Total Physical Response' (TPR — Jismoniy harakatlar orqali javob berish) metodidan foydalanmoqda. Ushbu metod ayniqsa qaysi bosqichdagi o'quvchilar uchun eng samarali va nega?
opts: Akademik C1 darajadagi talabalar uchun; ilmiy maqolalar tahlil qilish uchun
Boshlang'ich (Beginner/Young learners) bosqichda; chunki o'quvchilar gapirishga majburlanmasdan (silent period), jismoniy harakatlar orqali tushunishni (comprehension) xavotirsiz namoyon etadilar
Faqat yozma insho yozish darslarida
Faqat grammatik qoidalarni tahlil qilishda
explanation: TPR (Asher) bolalarning ona tilini o'rganishiga o'xshaydi: bola avval gapirmaydi, buyruqlarni eshitib harakat qiladi (Stand up, open the door). Bu usul stressni nolga tushiradi va eshitib tushunishni rivojlantiradi.
mnemonic: TPR = Eshitish + Jismoniy harakat (Stresssiz boshlang'ich o'zlashtirish).

q: Gulbahor Charles Curran tomonidan asos solingan 'Community Language Learning' (CLL — Jamoaviy til o'rganish) metodini qo'llamoqda. Ushbu metodda o'qituvchi doira bo'lib o'tirgan o'quvchilarning orqasida turadi va ular nima demoqchi bo'lsa, past ovozda qulog'iga shivirlab inglizchasini aytib turadi (counselor). Bu metod qaysi gumanistik nazariyaga asoslangan?
opts: Chomsky'ning Universal Grammatika nazariyasiga
Bixevioristik qat'iy jazolash nazariyasiga
O'qituvchi-maslahatchi (Counselor) va o'quvchi-mijoz (Client) psixologik munosabatiga; o'quvchilar qo'rquvini minimallashtirib, jamoaviy ishonch hosil qilish
Faqat texnologik kompyuter ta'limi tizimiga
explanation: Community Language Learning (CLL) Karl Rojersning psixoterapiya tamoyillariga asoslangan bo'lib, sinfdagi har qanday xavotirni bartaraf etish uchun guruh hamjihatligi va o'qituvchining psixologik ko'magiga tayanadi.
mnemonic: CLL = Guruh terapiyasi + O'qituvchi-maslahatchi (Counselor) ko'magi.

q: Azamat XIX asr oxirigacha hukmron bo'lgan 'Grammar-Translation Method' (GTM) ning zamonaviy kommunikativ til ta'limi nuqtai nazaridan eng zaif tomonini tahlil qilmoqda. GTM ning qaysi kamchiligi o'quvchilarning real muloqot qila olmasligiga asosiy sabab bo'lgan?
opts: O'qituvchining o'quvchilarga guruhda ishlash imkonini bermasligi
O'quvchilarning juda ko'p erkin muloqot qilishi
Darsda juda ko'p audio materiallar eshittirilishi

Og'zaki nutq (Speaking) va eshitib tushunish (Listening) ko'nikmalarining butunlay e'tibordan chetda qolishi, faqat o'lik grammatik qoidalarni yodlash va ikki tomonlama so'zma-so'z tarjimaga bog'lanib qolishi
explanation: Grammar-Translation Method (GTM) tilni o'lik tizim sifatida o'rgatgan: faqat matn tarjimasi va grammatik formulalar. Natijada o'quvchilar grammatikani mukammal bilsa ham, oddiy og'zaki savolga javob bera olmagan.
mnemonic: GTM = So'zma-so'z tarjima + O'lik qoidalar -> Og'zaki nutq va tinglash 0%.

explanation: MMT argues the constraint is not money (the government can issue currency), but real physical resources (labor, materials, productive capacity). When demand exceeds resources, inflation occurs.
q:
Read the passage:
"Modern Monetary Theory (MMT) challenges orthodox neoclassical economics by positing that sovereign nations issuing fiat currencies unpegged to gold or foreign exchange reserves face no operational financial budget constraints. Because a sovereign government is the monopoly issuer of its currency, it can never involuntarily default on debt denominated in that currency. The true boundary governing public expenditure is not fiscal solvency, but physical resource capacity. When aggregate demand outstrips the productive potential of labor, materials, and technology, inflation ensues; therefore, taxation functions not to fund government outlays, but to drain excess liquidity and manage inflationary pressure."

According to Modern Monetary Theory, what is the ultimate limiting factor on sovereign state expenditure?
opts: The real physical availability of labor, natural resources, and industrial productive capacity.
The accumulated quantity of physical gold bullion stored in the central bank vault.
The willingness of international financial institutions to purchase foreign-currency treasury bills.
The total amount of tax revenue collected from citizens during the previous fiscal quarter.
mnemonic: MMT Axiom: Physical resources and inflation constrain spending, not financial solvency.

q: Madina sinfga hech qanday darslik, nusxa ko'chirilgan tarqatmalar yoki slaydlarsiz kirdi. U doskaga shunchaki 'My most unforgettable journey' deb yozdi va o'quvchilarning real hayotiy tajribalari asosida jonli muloqot boshladi. Muloqot jarayonida o'quvchilardan chiqqan til xatolari va yangi ifodalarni doskaga yozib, tahlil qildi. Thornbury va Meddings tasnifiga ko'ra bu qaysi metod?
opts: Dogme ELT (Teaching Unplugged) — materiallarsiz, jonli muloqotga va paydo bo'ladigan tilga (emergent language) asoslangan yondashuv
Audio-Lingual Method — laboratoriya mashg'ulotlariga asoslangan metod
Grammar-Translation Method — qat'iy matn tahlili metodi
Direct Method — faqat rasm orqali o'rgatish metodi
explanation: Dogme ELT (Luke Meddings va Scott Thornbury): 1) Conversation-driven (muloqotga asoslangan); 2) Materials-light (darsliksiz/texnologiyasiz); 3) Focusing on emergent language (o'quvchilar nutqida tabiiy yuzaga keladigan tilni o'rgatish).
mnemonic: Dogme ELT = Darsliksiz + Jonli suhbat + Yuzaga chiquvchi til (Emergent language).

q: Rustam o'z hamkasbining darsini kuzatganda, o'qituvchi 45 daqiqa davomida faqat o'quvchilarga dialoglarni yodlatayotgani va turli drillar (substitution drill, repetition drill) orqali grammatik qolipni avtomatlashtirishga urinayotganini ko'rdi. B.F. Skinnerning bixevioristik 'Stimul-Reaksiya-Mustahkamlash' nazariyasiga asoslangan ushbu metod qaysi va uning asosiy kamchiligi nima?
opts: Direct Method; kamchiligi — o'qituvchi darsda faqat ona tilidan foydalanishidir
Audio-Lingual Method (ALM); uning asosiy kamchiligi — o'quvchilarda mexanik odat shakllansa-da, real hayotiy va kutilmagan vaziyatlarda erkin va ijodiy muloqot qila olmasligidir
CLIL; kamchiligi — fan mazmuniga ortiqcha e'tibor qaratilishidir
Task-Based Learning; kamchiligi — o'quvchilarning mustaqil topshiriq bajarishidir
explanation: Audio-Lingual Method bixeviorizmga tayanib tilni odat (habit formation) deb biladi. Noam Chomsky buni keskin tanqid qilib, inson tili cheksiz ijodiy (creative) ekanligini, mexanik drill real muloqot kompetentsiyasini yarata olmasligini isbotlagan.
mnemonic: ALM = Bixeviorizm + Mexanik drill -> Kamchiligi: Real hayotda ijodiy muloqot qila olmaslik.

q: Feruza maktabda dars o'tishda Berlitz tomonidan ommalashtirilgan 'Direct Method' (To'g'ridan-to'g'ri metod) qoidalariga amal qilmoqda. Ushbu metodning eng qat'iy va asosiy qoidasi qaysi javobda ko'rsatilgan?
opts: O'quvchilar faqat mustaqil ravishda uyda kitob o'qiydilar
Dars faqat ona tilida olib boriladi va har bir gap grammatik tahlil qilinadi
Ona tilidan (L1) foydalanish mutlaqo taqiqlanadi; barcha tushuntirishlar faqat maqsadli tilda (L2), real harakatlar, pantomima va ko'rgazmali qurollar orqali amalga oshiriladi
Barcha yangi so'zlar faqat o'zbekcha tarjimasi bilan diktovka qilinadi
explanation: Direct Method (Berlitz): Darsda ona tiliga (L1) mutlaqo ruxsat berilmaydi. Ma'no to'g'ridan-to'g'ri maqsadli tilda real narsalar (realia), rasmlar va imo-ishoralar vositasida bog'lanadi.
mnemonic: Direct Method = Ona tili (L1) 0% + Faqat maqsadli til (L2) + Ko'rgazmalilik.

q: Alisher metodika tarixini o'rganar ekan, Georgi Lozanov tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan 'Suggestopedia' metodini tahlil qildi. Ushbu metodda klassik barokko musiqasi, qulay kreslolar va ruhiy relaksatsiyadan foydalanishning asosiy ilmiy maqsadi nima bo'lgan?
opts: Faqat musiqa savodxonligini baholash
O'quvchilarni dars vaqtida uxlab qolishlarini ta'minlash
O'qituvchining darsda gapirish yuklamasini kamaytirish
O'quvchilar ong osti to'siqlarini olib tashlash, psixologik xavotirni minimumga tushirish (desuggestion) va o'rganish tezligini ko'p marotaba oshirish
explanation: Lozanovning Suggestopedia metodi o'quvchidagi psixologik qo'rquv va to'siqlarni (desuggestion) yengillashtirish uchun qulay atmosfera va barokko musiqasidan foydalanib, chet tilini giper-eslab qolishni maqsad qilgan.
mnemonic: Suggestopedia = Barokko musiqasi + Relaksatsiya + Ong osti to'siqlarini olib tashlash.

q:
When the Spartan magistrates received a threatening ultimatum from King Philip of Macedon stating: *"If I bring my army into your land, I will destroy your farms, slay your people, and raze your city"*, the Spartans replied with a single word:

*"If."*

In pragmatic analysis, this legendary laconic response functions by:
opts: Flouting the Maxim of Quantity through extreme brevity, generating a defiant implicature that Philip will never succeed in entering their territory.
Violating the Maxim of Quality by misidentifying Greek conditional grammar.
Opting out of the Spartan constitution due to political cowardice.
Infringing the Maxim of Manner through acoustic stuttering.
explanation: Responding with just the conditional conjunction 'If' flouts Quantity with maximum economy, implicating absolute defiance and challenging the likelihood of Philip ever invading.
mnemonic: Laconic Quantity Flouting: Extreme brevity conveying crushing defiance.

q:
Read the following exchange between two travelers:

*Traveler A:* "Where does Dr. Thorne reside?"
*Traveler B:* "Somewhere in the south of France."

Traveler B knows that A wants a specific city, but B genuinely does not know the exact town. Traveler B’s response illustrates:
opts: A malicious violation of the Maxim of Relation designed to mislead Traveler A.
A clash between the Maxim of Quantity (be informative) and the Maxim of Quality (do not say what you lack evidence for), where Quality overrides Quantity.
A deliberate flouting of the Maxim of Manner to demonstrate poetic ambiguity.
An opting out of communication caused by severe geographical amnesia.
explanation: A 'maxim clash' occurs when a speaker cannot satisfy one maxim without violating another. To avoid lying or guessing (violating Quality), B gives vague information (sacrificing Quantity). Quality supercedes Quantity.
mnemonic: Maxim Clash: Sacrificing Quantity to uphold Quality (don't lie when you don't know).

q:

"Modern Monetary Theory (MMT) challenges orthodox neoclassical economics by positing that sovereign nations issuing fiat currencies unpegged to gold or foreign exchange reserves face no operational financial budget constraints. Because a sovereign government is the monopoly issuer of its currency, it can never involuntarily default on debt denominated in that currency. The true boundary governing public expenditure is not fiscal solvency, but physical resource capacity. When aggregate demand outstrips the productive potential of labor, materials, and technology, inflation ensues; therefore, taxation functions not to fund government outlays, but to drain excess liquidity and manage inflationary pressure."

Affective Filter Hypothesis (Affektiv filtr gipotezasi) — past filtr (low anxiety, high motivation) til o'zlashtirishni jadallashtiradi

mnemonic: Past Affektiv Filtr = Qo'rquvsiz muhit + Yuqori motivatsiya -> Erkin til egallash.

q: Sherzod o'quvchilarga '3rd person singular -s' (He works) qoidasini 1 oy davomida mashq qildirishiga qaramasdan, o'quvchilar erkin nutqda hamon 'He work' deyishda davom etmoqda. Krashen va Dulat & Burt tadqiqotlariga binoan bu holat nima bilan izohlanadi?
opts: Ingliz tilida fe'llar zamoni juda kamligi bilan
O'qituvchining dars o'tish metodikasini umuman bilmasligi bilan
O'quvchilarning xotirasi zaifligi va intizomsizligi bilan

explanation: Dulay va Burt morfemik tadqiqotlari (Natural Order) shuni ko'rsatadiki, Present Simple'dagi 3-shaxs birlik '-s' qo'shimchasi qoidasi juda oson bo'lishiga qaramay, tabiiy o'zlashtirish ierarxiyasida eng kech (late-acquired) avtomatlashadigan morfemadir.
mnemonic: Natural Order: '-s' qoidasi oson, ammo tabiiy o'zlashtirishda eng kech avtomatlashadi.

"At the Anglo-Indian club in Chandrapore, the verandah smelled faintly of gin, damp coir matting, and unexamined imperial complacency. The British military garrison lacked sufficient ammunition to maintain law and order.

Indian bazaars should be demolished to build wider paved highways for colonial carriages.
explanation: Fielding identifies that the chasm is built on 'the club members' terror of treating another human being simply as an equal', unmasking imperial arrogance as fearful insecurity.

Affective Filter-free user — mutlaqo xavotirsiz o'rganuvchi
explanation: Krashen'ning Monitor gipotezasida 'Monitor Over-users' grammatik qoidalarni haddan ortiq tahlil qilib, nutq oqimini (fluency) to'xtatib qo'yadilar. Ular xato qilishdan cho'chib, erkin muloqotga kirisha olmaydi.

q: Feruza dars jarayonida o'quvchilar xavotirini (anxiety) kamaytirish, sinfda do'stona muhit yaratish va ularning o'ziga bo'lgan ishonchini oshirish orqali til o'rganish samaradorligini keskin oshirdi. Ushbu pedagogik amaliyot Krashenning qaysi gipotezasiga bevosita asoslangan?
opts: Acquisition-Learning Hypothesis — ongli va ongsiz o'rganish farqi
Natural Order Hypothesis — morfemalarning qat'iy o'zlashtirilish tartibi
Affective Filter Hypothesis (Affektiv filtr gipotezasi) — past filtr (low anxiety, high motivation) til o'zlashtirishni jadallashtiradi
Universal Grammar Hypothesis — tug'ma sintaktik parametrlar
explanation: Affective Filter gipotezasiga ko'ra, qo'rquv, past o'z-o'zini baholash va yuqori xavotir (high affective filter) ongda to'siq hosil qilib, tushunarli kiruvchi axborotning (input) tilni egallash mexanizmiga (LAD) yetib borishiga to'sqinlik qiladi.
mnemonic: Past Affektiv Filtr = Qo'rquvsiz muhit + Yuqori motivatsiya -> Erkin til egallash.

q: Alisher o'quvchilarga '3rd person singular -s' (He works) qoidasini 1 oy davomida mashq qildirishiga qaramasdan, o'quvchilar erkin nutqda hamon 'He work' deyishda davom etmoqda. Krashen va Dulat & Burt tadqiqotlariga binoan bu holat nima bilan izohlanadi?
opts: Ingliz tilida fe'llar zamoni juda kamligi bilan
O'qituvchining dars o'tish metodikasini umuman bilmasligi bilan
O'quvchilarning xotirasi zaifligi va intizomsizligi bilan

Natural Order Hypothesis (Tabiiy ketma-ketlik gipotezasi) — grammatik morfemalar o'qitish tartibidan qat'i nazar, qat'iy tabiiy ketma-ketlikda o'zlashtiriladi va '-s' qo'shimchasi eng kech avtomatlashuvchi morfemalardan biridir
explanation: Dulay va Burt morfemik tadqiqotlari (Natural Order) shuni ko'rsatadiki, Present Simple'dagi 3-shaxs birlik '-s' qo'shimchasi qoidasi juda oson bo'lishiga qaramay, tabiiy o'zlashtirish ierarxiyasida eng kech (late-acquired) avtomatlashadigan morfemadir.
mnemonic: Natural Order: '-s' qoidasi oson, ammo tabiiy o'zlashtirishda eng kech avtomatlashadi.

q: Nodira Krashenning 'Acquisition' (Tilni tabiiy egallash) va 'Learning' (Tilni ongli o'rganish) o'rtasidagi 'Non-interface position' (O'zaro bog'lanmaslik) konsepsiyasini tahlil qilmoqda. Ushbu konsepsiyaning mazmuni nima?
opts: Ongli ravishda o'rganilgan grammatik qoidalar (explicit learning) hech qachon tabiiy, ongsiz va avtomatik ravon nutqqa (implicit acquisition) aylanmaydi
Har qanday ongli o'rganilgan qoida 2 kundan keyin darhol avtomatik ravon nutqqa aylanadi
Tilni faqat kitobdan o'qib o'rganish eng samarali yo'ldir
Bolalar va kattalar tilni mutlaqo bir xil tezlikda o'rganadilar
explanation: Krashen'ning radikal 'Non-interface position'iga ko'ra, ongli o'rganish (learning) va ongsiz tabiiy egallash (acquisition) miyada ikkita mutlaqo alohida tizimdir; qoidani bilish faqat monitor (tahrirchi) bo'lib xizmat qiladi, avtomatik ravonlikka aylanmaydi.
mnemonic: Non-interface = Qoidani yodlash (learning) avtomatik ravon nutqqa (acquisition) aylanmaydi.

q: Bekzod o'quvchilarga matn tanlashda Krashenning 'i + 1' formulasiga amal qilmoqda. Agar matn o'quvchining joriy bilim darajasidan ancha yuqori bo'lsa (ya'ni 'i + 5' darajasida), bu o'rganish jarayoniga qanday ta'sir qiladi?
opts: O'quvchilar tilni besh barobar tezroq o'rganib oladi
O'quvchilar matnni tushunolmaydi, kognitiv zo'riqish va tushkunlik (frustration) yuzaga kelib, affektiv filtr ko'tariladi va o'rganish to'xtaydi
O'quvchilarning imlo savodxonligi avtomatik ravishda C2 darajaga chiqadi
O'qituvchiga darsda hech narsa tushuntirish shart bo'lmay qoladi
explanation: Agar kiritilayotgan til birligi 'i + 1' emas, balki 'i + 3' yoki 'i + 5' bo'lsa, u 'incomprehensible input'ga aylanadi. Natijada o'quvchida tushkunlik paydo bo'lib, affektiv to'siq ko'tariladi.
mnemonic: Input i + 1 bo'lishi shart; i + 5 = Tushunarsiz, stress va samarasiz.

q: Mohira o'quvchisi Jamol muloqot paytida grammatik xatolarga umuman e'tibor bermaydi, juda tez va to'xtovsiz gapiradi, ammo xatolari juda ko'pligi sababli tinglovchi uni tushunishda qiynaladi. Krashen tasnifiga ko'ra Jamol qaysi guruhga mansub?
opts: Optimal user
Monitor Over-user

mnemonic: Monitor Under-user = Qoidani tekshirmaydi -> Xatolar ko'p, tushunish qiyin.

q: Differensiyalangan darsni rejalashtirishda Carol Ann Tomlinson modeliga ko'ra, o'qituvchi o'quvchilarning qaysi 3 ta individual xususiyatiga tayanib ta'limni moslashtiradi?

Bo'yi, vazni va qon guruhi.
Tayyorgarlik darajasi (Readiness), Qiziqishlari (Interests) va O'rganish profili (Learning Profile).

mnemonic: Tomlinson 3-ligi: Tayyorgarlik (Readiness) + Qiziqish (Interest) + Profil.

q: 45 daqiqalik intensiv grammatik darsning o'rtasida (25-daqiqada) o'quvchilarda jismoniy va aqliy toliqish alomatlari sezildi. Kasbiy standart talabiga muvofiq, o'qituvchi qanday chorani rejalashtirishi lozim?
opts: O'quvchilarga ko'zlarini yumib dars tugaguncha uxlashni buyurish.
O'quvchilarga qattiq baqirib, intizomni saqlashni va dars oxirigacha qimirlamay o'tirishni talab qilish.
Darsni butunlay to'xtatib, barchaga qoniqarsiz baho qo'yish.
1-2 daqiqalik harakatli til o'yini, jismoniy daqiqa (Total Physical Response / Energizer) o'tkazib, miya faoliyatini va qon aylanishini qayta faollashtirish.
explanation: Qisqa harakatli jismoniy daqiqalar (Kinesthetic energizers / TPR) kislorod oqimini yaxshilaydi, asab tizimidagi tormozlanishni yechadi va diqqatni yangilaydi.
mnemonic: Energizer (25-daqiqa): 1 daqiqalik harakat miyani qayta ishga tushiradi.

q: Sanjar Krashenning 'Comprehensible Input' nazariyasi bo'yicha darsda tushunishni osonlashtirish uchun qo'shimcha vositalardan foydalanmoqda. Quyidagilardan qaysi biri inputni tushunarli qilishning eng samarali vositasi hisoblanadi?
opts: O'quvchilarga hech qanday yordamisiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri audio eshittirish
Matndagi barcha so'zlarni o'quvchilarga 10 martadan ko'chirtirish
Faqat doskaga qoidalarning formulasini yozib berish
Kontekstual tayanchlar, ko'rgazmali vositalar (rasmlar, realia), tana harakatlari (body language) va nutq tezligini moslashtirish
explanation: Krashen ta'kidlaganidek, inputni 'comprehensible' qiladigan narsa — bu kontekst, vizual materiallar, real narsalar (realia) va o'qituvchining para-lingvistik qo'llab-quvvatlashidir.
mnemonic: Comprehensible Input = Kontekst + Vizual tayanchlar + Tana tili.

q: Dilnoza 5-sinf o'quvchisi Anvarni kuzatmoqda. Anvar darsda yangi tilni tushunib, o'qituvchining barcha ko'rsatmalarini to'g'ri bajarsa-da, birinchi 3 oy davomida ingliz tilida umuman gapirishni istamadi. O'qituvchi uni majburlamasdan, ko'p miqdorda tushunarli audio va vizual manbalar bilan ta'minladi. Krashenning qaysi gipotezasi bu 'Silent Period' (jimlik davri)ni tushuntiradi?
opts: Krashenning 'Input Hypothesis' (Tushunarli kirish ma'lumoti) — til o'rganuvchi gapirishdan avval tushunish bazasini to'plashi tabiiy holat bo'lib, 'Silent Period' bu ichki kompetentsiyaning shakllanish bosqichidir
Krashenning 'Monitor Hypothesis' — o'quvchining ichki tahrirchisi buzilganligi sababli gapirmaydi
Bixevioristik nazariya — o'quvchida stimul-reaksiya zanjiri uzilgan
Chomsky'ning LAD apparati ishlamay qolganligi
explanation: Stephen Krashen'ning Input gipotezasiga ko'ra, til o'rganishda 'Silent Period' (jimlik davri) mutlaqo tabiiy. O'quvchi bu paytda tushunarli ma'lumotni ($i+1$) o'zlashtiradi; ichki kompetentsiya yetilgach, nutq o'z-o'zidan erkin paydo bo'ladi.
mnemonic: Silent Period = Input ($i+1$) to'plash davri; majburlash kognitiv to'siq yaratadi.

q: O'qituvchi sinf xonasini 3 ta stansiyaga ajratdi: 1-stansiya — planshetda audio tinglash va test; 2-stansiya — o'qituvchi bilan kichik guruhda murakkab qoidani tahlil qilish; 3-stansiya — juftlikda loyiha posteri chizish. opts: Station Rotation (Stansiyalar rotatsiyasi) — aralash ta'lim (Blended learning) ning faol modeli.
Frontal dars — o'qituvchining faqat qora doska oldida turib gapirishi.
An'anaviy imtihon komissiyasi yig'ilishi.
Sport musobaqalarining estafeta yugurishi.
explanation: Station Rotation — aralash ta'lim (Blended Learning) modeli bo'lib, o'quvchilar kichik guruhlarda turli xil o'quv stansiyalari (onlayn, o'qituvchi bilan bevosita va mustaqil amaliyot) bo'ylab navbat bilan aylanadilar.
mnemonic: Station Rotation = Guruhlar stansiyalar bo'ylab aylanadi (Aralash ta'lim).

q: Problem-Based Learning (PBL) darsini rejalashtirishda muammo qanday xususiyatlarga ega bo'lishi shart?
opts: Muammo darslikdagi qoidaning so'zma-so'z nusxasi bo'lib, faqat 'ha' yoki 'yo'q' deb javob berilishi kerak.
Muammo ochiq uchli (aniq bitta yagona javobi bo'lmagan), real hayotiy vaziyatga asoslangan va o'quvchilarni tadqiqot olib borishga undaydigan bo'lishi lozim.
Muammo faqat o'qituvchining shaxsiy avtomobili buzilib qolgani haqida bo'lishi kerak.
Muammo shunchalik mavhum bo'lishi kerakki, unga hech qanday ilmiy dalil topib bo'lmasin.
explanation: PBL da muammo real hayotiy (authentic), noaniqlikka ega (ill-structured/open-ended) va ko'p qirrali bo'lishi kerak, shunda o'quvchilar tanqidiy fikrlash va turli yechimlarni izlashga kirishadilar.
mnemonic: PBL muammosi = Ochiq uchli, hayotiy, tadqiqot talab qiluvchi.

q: Erkin so'zlashuv (Fluency activity) bosqichida o'quvchi gapirayotganda bir nechta grammatik xatolarga yo'l qo'ydi. Kasbiy standart talablariga ko'ra o'qituvchi qanday yo'l tutishi eng to'g'ri?

Xatolarga umuman e'tibor bermaslik va ularni hech qachon tuzatmaslik.
explanation: Ravonlik (Fluency) mashg'ulotida nutqni har soniyada bo'lish o'quvchining kommunikativ ishtiyoqini so'ndiradi va qo'rquv uyg'otadi. Eng professional usul — kechiktirilgan anonim tahlil (Delayed error correction).
mnemonic: Fluency da xato tuzatish: Nutqni bo'lma -> Yozib ol -> Keyin birga tahlil qil.

q: Under standard Gricean scalar semantics, the utterance *"David has three children"* typically scalar-implicates:
opts: David has exactly three children (no more than three).
David has at least ten children.
David has no biological offspring.
David has adopted three foreign infants.
explanation: While 'three' semantically means 'at least three' in pure logic, pragmatically under the Maxim of Quantity it implicates an upper bound: 'no more than three', hence 'exactly three'.
mnemonic: Numerical Scalar Implicature: 'has three' implicates 'has exactly three'.

q: Jasur o'quvchilarga matn tanlashda Krashenning 'i + 1' formulasiga amal qilmoqda. Agar matn o'quvchining joriy bilim darajasidan ancha yuqori bo'lsa (ya'ni 'i + 5' darajasida), bu o'rganish jarayoniga qanday ta'sir qiladi?

mnemonic: Input i + 1 bo'lishi shart; i + 5 = Tushunarsiz, stress va samarasiz.

q: What distinguishes a **conversational implicature** from an **idiom**?
opts: An implicature is always printed in quotation marks, while an idiom is never punctuated.

q: Sanjar Vygotskiyning sotsiokultural nazariyasini tahlil qilar ekan, bolaning aqliy rivojlanishidagi ikki tekislik qonunini o'rgandi. Unga ko'ra, har qanday madaniy va lingvistik ko'nikma inson ongida qanday tartibda rivojlanadi?
opts: Hech qanday ijtimoiy ta'sirsiz o'z-o'zidan paydo bo'ladi
Dastlab ichki ongda, keyin tashqi muloqotda

Deep, suppressed moral alienation from their chauvinistic dogmatism.

the expedition had reached

*"Barely _____ the summit ridge when a catastrophic blizzard obliterated all visual orientation."*

q: Shahnoza o'z sinfida o'quvchilar mustaqil topshiriq bajarayotganda ularga darhol to'g'ri javobni aytib qo'yish o'rniga, kichik savollar berish (prompting) orqali to'g'ri javobga yo'naltirdi. Ushbu usul qaysi pedagogik tushunchaga mos keladi?
opts: Negative Punishment (Jazolash)
Direct Spoon-feeding (Tayyorini berish)
Scaffolding doirasidagi yo'naltiruvchi ko'mak (Guided scaffolding / Prompting)
Drilling (Mexanik takrorlash)
explanation: Scaffolding hech qachon tayyor javobni berish emas; u yo'naltiruvchi ishoralar (prompts, cues) orqali o'quvchining o'zini mustaqil kashfiyotga undash sanaladi.
mnemonic: Guided Scaffolding = Javobni aytish emas, o'quvchini yechim tomon yetaklash.

q: Bobur Vygotskiyning sotsiokultural nazariyasini tahlil qilar ekan, bolaning aqliy rivojlanishidagi ikki tekislik qonunini o'rgandi. Unga ko'ra, har qanday madaniy va lingvistik ko'nikma inson ongida qanday tartibda rivojlanadi?
opts: Hech qanday ijtimoiy ta'sirsiz o'z-o'zidan paydo bo'ladi
Dastlab ichki ongda, keyin tashqi muloqotda
Faqat genetik tarzda tug'ilishdan mavjud bo'ladi
Dastlab ijtimoiy tekislikda odamlararo munosabatda (interpsychological), so'ngra bolaning ichki aqliy tekisligida (intrapsychological)
explanation: Vygotskiyning mashhur genetik qonuni: 'Har bir funksiya bolaning rivojlanishida ikki marta paydo bo'ladi: birinchi — ijtimoiy (odamlararo / interpsychological), ikkinchi — psixologik (bola ongining ichida / intrapsychological)'.
mnemonic: Rivojlanish yo'li: Avval ijtimoiy muloqot (Inter), keyin ichki ong (Intra).

q: Umida o'quvchisi Boburning yolg'iz o'zi bajara olmaydigan, ammo o'qituvchining kichik ko'rsatmasi yoki tajribaliroq sinfdoshining ko'magi bilan bemalol uddalay oladigan bilim va ko'nikmalar maydonini aniqladi. Lev Vygotskiyning sotsiokultural nazariyasida ushbu oraliq nima deb ataladi?
opts: Yaqin rivojlanish zonasi (Zone of Proximal Development — ZPD)
Affektiv filtr sohasi (Affective Filter Zone)
Fosillashuv darajasi (Fossilization Stage)
Mustaqil kompetentsiya platosi (Plateau of Competence)
explanation: Vygotskiy ta'rifiga ko'ra, ZPD (Zone of Proximal Development) — o'quvchining mustaqil yechish darajasi bilan kattalar yoki bilimdonroq tengdoshlari (MKO - More Knowledgeable Other) yordamida erishadigan potensial darajasi o'rtasidagi masofadir.
mnemonic: ZPD = Mustaqil qila oladigan daraja va Yo'l-yo'riq bilan erishadigan cho'qqi oralig'i.

q: Otabek dars jarayonida Bruner va Vygotskiy g'oyalariga asoslangan 'Scaffolding' (pedagogik qo'llab-quvvatlash/tayanch) strategiyasini qo'llamoqda. Scaffolding jarayonining eng muhim qoidasi qaysi javobda to'g'ri ko'rsatilgan?
opts: O'qituvchi o'quvchi o'rniga barcha mashqlarni o'zi to'liq bajarib berishi kerak
O'quvchining mustaqilligi va kompetentsiyasi oshib borgan sari pedagogik yordam asta-sekin kamaytirib (fading), to'liq mustaqil faoliyatga olib chiqilishi lozim
Scaffolding faqat darsning birinchi daqiqasida ishlatilib, keyin butunlay to'xtatiladi
Yordam hech qachon kamaytirilmaydi va o'quvchi doim o'qituvchiga to'liq qaram bo'lib qoladi
explanation: Scaffolding (Bruner) ning asosiy mexanizmi — 'Fading' (yordamni bosqichma-bosqich kamaytirish). Dastlab yuqori yordam beriladi, o'quvchi o'zlashtirgani sari tayanch olib tashlanadi va o'quvchi to'liq avtonom bo'ladi.
mnemonic: Scaffolding = Vaqtinchalik bino shotisi kabi; bino qad ko'targach, shoti olib tashlanadi.

q:
Read the passage:
"At the Anglo-Indian club in Chandrapore, the verandah smelled faintly of gin, damp coir matting, and unexamined imperial complacency. Major Callendar was expounding upon the 'oriental temperament' with that booming dogmatism common to men whose authority is backed by armed infantry. Fielding listened, twisting his whiskey tumbler with quiet revulsion. Across the manicured tennis lawn, beyond the barbed-wire fence, lay the dusty, sprawling bazaar with all its vibrant squalor and chaotic vitality. Fielding knew that between these two worlds stood an unbridgeable chasm, constructed not by geographic distance, but by the club members' terror of treating another human being simply as an equal."

The phrase "unexamined imperial complacency" characterizes the officials as being:
explanation: 'Complacency' is smug, unreflective self-satisfaction; 'unexamined' means they never question the righteousness of their rule.
opts: Deeply devoted to mastering classical Sanskrit poetry.
Constantly auditing and reforming their administrative governance methods.
Terrified of losing their personal financial savings in local currency exchanges.
Uncritically satisfied with their inherited supremacy, blind to its moral bankruptcy.
options: Deeply devoted to mastering classical Sanskrit poetry.
Constantly auditing and reforming their administrative governance methods.
Terrified of losing their personal financial savings in local currency exchanges.
Uncritically satisfied with their inherited supremacy, blind to its moral bankruptcy.

q:
In a courtroom trial:

*Prosecutor:* "Did you touch the murder weapon found in the vault?"
*Witness:* "I have never in my life visited the city of Boston!"

Given that the vault was located in Boston, the witness’s reply:
opts: Flouts Manner through speaking Latin.
Violates Quality by proving he was born in Boston.
Opts out of the legal trial entirely.
Answers the question indirectly via Relation, implicating that since he was never in Boston, he could not have touched the weapon.
explanation: The witness provides a higher-order premise (never was in the city) that entails a negative answer to the specific weapon question, relying on Relation to generate the implicature.
mnemonic: Higher-Order Premise: Denying the geographic precondition implicates denial of the act.

q: O'qituvchi 9-sinf ingliz tili darsida chorak davomida "Sayohat va Transport" hamda "Texnologiyalar" mavzularini o'tdi. Ammo choraklik summativ test savollarining 80 foizi darsda mutlaqo o'tilmagan "Tibbiyot va Anatomiya" mavzusidagi murakkab terminlardan iborat bo'lib chiqdi. Ushbu test qaysi asosiy psixometrik talabni qo'pol ravishda buzgan?
opts: Test-retest ishonchliligi — testni ikki marta o'tkazganda natijalarning mos kelishi.
Mazmuniy validlik (Content Validity) — test topshiriqlari o'quv dasturi va o'tilgan ta'limiy mazmunga to'liq va mutanosib vakillik qilishi shartligi talabi.
Ekspertlararo kelishuv indeksi.
Test blankalarining shrift o'lchami va varaq formati.
explanation: Mazmuniy validlik (Content validity) test savollarining o'quv dasturi (kurrikulum) mazmuniga qay darajada to'g'ri va adolatli mutanosiblikda vakillik qilishini ko'rsatadi. O'tilmagan mavzuni testga kiritish mazmuniy validlikni yo'qqa chiqaradi.
mnemonic: Mazmuniy validlik = Dasturda nima o'tilsa, testda aynan o'sha bo'lishi shart!

q:
An art critic writes of a blank white canvas:

*"The ontological dialectic of its non-chromatic void subverts the ocular hegemony of Western representation."*

In pragmatic analysis, this opaque, convoluted prose flouts the Maxim of Manner to:
opts: Generate an aura of profound intellectual prestige and esoteric exclusivity around a banal object.
Inform the reader of the precise chemical formula of titanium white pigment.
Violate the Maxim of Quality by claiming the canvas is made of stone.
Infringe the Maxim of Quantity by refusing to publish the review.
explanation: Obscure, pseudo-intellectual jargon flouts Manner ('be clear, avoid obscurity') to project an illusion of philosophical depth onto mundane things.
mnemonic: Pretentious Manner Flouting: Obscure jargon deployed to confer spurious intellectual prestige.

q: Zarina sinfdagi juftlik mashg'ulotida kuchli o'quvchi bilan o'rta darajadagi o'quvchini biriktirdi. Richard Donato tadqiqotlariga ko'ra, o'quvchilarning o'zaro hamkorlikda bir-biriga yordam berib bilimlarni birgalikda yaratish jarayoni qanday ataladi?
opts: Interferensiya (Negative transfer)
O'zaro raqobat (Mutual competition)
Kollektiv/Tengdoshlar tayanchi (Collective scaffolding / Peer scaffolding)
Passiv o'zlashtirish (Passive absorption)
explanation: Donato (1994) sotsiokultural nazariyani SLA ga tatbiq etib, nafaqat o'qituvchi, balki o'quvchilar ham bir-biriga tengdosh sifatida 'collective scaffolding' bera olishini va bilimlarni hamkorlikda (co-construction) yaratishini isbotlagan.
mnemonic: Collective Scaffolding = Tengdoshlarning birgalikda bilim yaratishi va bir-birini qo'llashi.

q: O'qituvchi o'quvchilarning "tinglab tushunish" (Listening) ko'nikmasini tekshirish uchun audio matn eshittirdi, ammo topshiriqda o'quvchilardan eshitganlari asosida murakkab matematik geometrik integrallarni yozma hisoblashni talab qildi. Ushbu test nega konstrukt validligiga (Construct validity) ega emas?
opts: Chunki geometriya barcha tillarda lotin alifbosida ifodalanadi.
Chunki audio yozuv quloqchinlar orqali eshittirilmagan.
Chunki test o'lchanishi kerak bo'lgan asosiy konstruktni (til bo'yicha tinglab tushunishni) emas, balki boshqa begona konstruktni (matematik hisoblash qobiliyatini) o'lchamoqda.
Chunki test 15 daqiqadan ko'proq davom etgan.
explanation: Konstrukt validligi — testning aynan o'lchash uchun mo'ljallangan nazariy tushuncha/ko'nikmani (masalan, tilni tushunish) o'lchayotganligini kafolatlaydi. Agar til testida boshqa qobiliyat (matematika) to'siq bo'lsa, konstrukt buziladi.
mnemonic: Konstrukt validligi: Maqsad nima bo'lsa, faqat o'shani o'lcha (begona to'siqlarsiz)!

q: Sherzod o'quvchilarning qiyin yozma topshiriqni bajarayotganda o'z-o'ziga past ovozda inglizcha gapirib, fikrini tartibga solayotganini (Private speech) eshitdi. Vygotskiy ta'limotiga ko'ra, 'Private speech' (ichki nutqqa o'tish) nimadan dalolat beradi?
opts: Dars mavzusini mutlaqo tushunmaganidan
O'quvchida psixologik chalg'ish paydo bo'lganidan
O'quvchining sinfdoshlariga ataylab xalaqit berayotganidan
O'quvchining o'z xatti-harakatlari va kognitiv jarayonlarini boshqarishga (self-regulation) urinishidan
explanation: Vygotskiy bo'yicha 'Private speech' (o'z-o'ziga gapirish) kognitiv boshqaruvning (self-regulation) eng muhim bosqichidir. Inson murakkab aqliy vazifani bajarishda tashqi nutq vositasida o'z fikrlarini yo'naltiradi.
mnemonic: Private Speech = Kognitiv o'z-o'zini boshqarish (Self-regulation) belgisi.

q: Bitta o'quvchining yozgan inshosini ikki xil o'qituvchi tekshirdi. Birinchi o'qituvchi 100 balldan 95 ball qo'ydi, ikkinchi o'qituvchi esa xuddi shu inshoga 45 ball qo'ydi. Ushbu baholash tizimida qanday jiddiy nuqson mavjud?
opts: Insho faqat ko'k siyohda yozilmaganligi sababli shunday farq kelib chiqqan.
O'quvchi ikkita bir xil insho yozishda plagiatga yo'l qo'ygan.
Birinchi o'qituvchining ko'zoynagi sinib qolgan.
Baholovchilararo ishonchlilik (Inter-rater reliability) o'ta past, chunki baholash mezonlari (rubrikalar) noaniq yoki o'qituvchilar o'rtasida standartlashtirilgan moderatsiya o'tkazilmagan.
explanation: Baholovchilararo ishonchlilik — turli baholovchilar bitta ishni tekshirganda natijalarning bir-biriga yaqin va barqaror chiqishidir. 95 va 45 o'rtasidagi tafovut mezonlarning subyektivligi va moderatsiya yo'qligini isbotlaydi.
mnemonic: Inter-rater reliability = Turli tekshiruvchilar bir xil xulosaga kelishi shart.

q: If a chef tests a soup and states *"The soup is warm"*, the customer naturally infers that:
opts: The soup is boiling vigorously at 100 degrees Celsius.
The soup is not hot (scalar implicature from the scale <boiling, hot, warm, cool>).
The soup is frozen solid into an ice block.
The chef refuses to serve food to customers.
explanation: On the scale <scalding, hot, warm, lukewarm>, asserting 'warm' generates the scalar implicature 'warm, but not hot'.
mnemonic: Scalar Temperature: 'Warm' scalar-implicates 'not hot'.

q: Kamola o'quvchilarni an'anaviy statik test bilan emas, balki 'Dynamic Assessment' (Dinamik baholash) orqali baholamoqda. Dinamik baholashning an'anaviy testdan tub farqi nimada?
opts: Baholash va o'qitish birlashtiriladi: o'quvchining faqat hozirgi bilimi emas, balki pedagogik ko'mak orqali qanchalik tez o'rgana olish salohiyati (learning potential) baholanadi
O'quvchilarga faqat besh baho qo'yiladi
Test savollari darslikdan tashqaridan olinadi
Imtihon faqat kompyuterda o'tkaziladi
explanation: Dynamic Assessment (Vygotskiy ZPD asosida) o'quvchining mustaqil qila olganini (static) emas, balki yo'l-yo'riq berilganda uning o'rganish salohiyati (learning potential) qanchalik yuqori ekanligini baholaydi.
mnemonic: Dynamic Assessment = O'qitish va baholash birga (O'rganish salohiyatini aniqlash).

q: Sardor o'quvchilarga murakkab grammatik strukturani o'rgatishda 'Mediated Learning' (Vositachilik orqali o'rganish) tamoyilini qo'lladi. Sotsiokultural nazariyada 'vosita' (mediation tool) vazifasini nima bajarishi mumkin?
opts: Faqat jismoniy parta va doska
Tilning o'zi, vizual grafik sxemalar, jadvallar va madaniy belgilar tizimi
Faqat qog'oz formatidagi darslik
Sinf xonasining harorati
explanation: Vygotskiy nazariyasida barcha insoniy aqliy jarayonlar semiotik vositalar — birinchi navbatda Til, shuningdek ramzlar, grafik sxemalar va modellar vositachiligida (mediation) rivojlanadi.
mnemonic: Mediation vositasi = Til, ramzlar va kognitiv grafik sxemalar.

q:
Read the passage:
"Ecological rewilding represents an ontological departure from traditional conservation biology, which has historically fixated on static, museum-like preservation of arbitrary historical baselines. Rather than micro-managing endangered species within cordoned sanctuaries, rewilding reinstates apex keystone predators and ecosystem engineers to restore dynamic trophic self-regulation. The celebrated reintroduction of gray wolves to Yellowstone National Park demonstrated that apex predators initiate landscape-scale trophic cascades: by altering the browsing behavior of elk, wolves permitted willow and aspen regeneration along riparian corridors, which in turn stabilized eroded riverbanks and fostered beaver recolonization."

q: O'tkazilgan test tahlilida muayyan bir savol bo'yicha diskriminativlik indeksi $D = -0.35$ (manfiy) bo'lib chiqdi. Ushbu natija testologik jihatdan nimani anglatadi va o'qituvchi ushbu savol bilan nima qilishi kerak?

Savol yaroqsiz va chalg'ituvchi bo'lib, umumiy past ball olgan kuchsiz o'quvchilar unga to'g'ri javob bergan, yuqori ball olgan kuchli o'quvchilar esa chalg'ib xato qilgan; savol zudlik bilan tahrirlanishi yoki testdan chiqarib tashlanishi lozim.

explanation: Decoherence shows that interaction with the environment causes phase information to leak into surrounding particles, suppressing interference without requiring an active conscious observer.
q:
Read the passage:
"A profound conundrum of early quantum mechanics was the measurement problem: why do microscopic wavefunctions evolve via deterministic, continuous Schrödinger equations until observation causes an abrupt, non-unitary 'collapse' into a single classical reality? Modern quantum decoherence theory resolves this paradox without invoking mystical observer consciousness. When an isolated quantum system inevitably interacts with its chaotic thermodynamic environment, phase coherence is rapidly dissipated across countless environmental degrees of freedom. The system does not collapse; rather, quantum superposition becomes unobservable due to entanglement with ambient photons and air molecules, giving rise to the appearance of a classical macroscopic world."

How does quantum decoherence explain the transition from quantum superposition to macroscopic reality?
opts: Environmental entanglement rapidly disperses phase coherence, making quantum superpositions unobservable in macroscopic systems.
The conscious human mind emits physical energy waves that physically destroy subatomic wavefunctions.
Subatomic particles completely disintegrate whenever they travel through vacuum tubes.
Macroscopic objects do not contain atoms and therefore operate outside quantum laws.

"The glacier of Montanvert loomed above me like a petrified ocean, its frozen waves suspended in an eternity of jagged ice. I had ascended these precipices in the desperate hope of banishing my intolerable remorse, seeking solace in the majestic desolation of the sublime. Measuring the velocity of glacial meltwater to publish an academic treatise in physics.

q:
Consider the contrast between:
1. *"The general took the city and won the battle."*
2. *"The general won the battle and took the city."*

Why does sentence (1) sound strange to a pragmatic listener, and which sub-maxim of Manner is at stake?
opts: It violates the sub-maxim of Manner: "Be orderly", because chronological events coordinated by "and" are pragmatically expected to mirror the real-world temporal sequence.
It violates the Maxim of Quality because generals never take cities.
It flouts the Maxim of Relation because battles have no connection to cities.
It opts out of the Cooperative Principle through grammatical passive voice.
explanation: The sub-maxim of Manner 'Be orderly' requires coordinating temporal events in their chronological order of occurrence. Taking a city before winning the battle violates the expected temporal iconicity of 'and'.
mnemonic: Order of Manner: Temporal coordination with 'and' must reflect chronological order.

q: During an international symposium, a session chair looks at a presenter who has exceeded his time limit and states firmly: *"Colleagues are waiting outside for the next panel."* What is the illocutionary force of this utterance?
opts: A purely constative assertive reporting meteorological and spatial facts without communicative intent.
The physical acoustic act of producing grammatical English sentences about colleagues outside.
The psychological effect of nervousness and embarrassment induced in the presenting speaker.
A directive speech act implicitly commanding the speaker to conclude his presentation immediately.
explanation: In Austin's speech act tripartite framework, the locutionary act is the literal phonological/syntactic utterance, the illocutionary act (or force) is the intended communicative action performed in saying it (here, a directive to wrap up), and the perlocutionary effect is the consequential psychological or behavioral outcome on the hearer.
mnemonic: Illocution = Intended communicative action performed IN saying something.

q: Azamat darsda o'quvchilar xatolarini tuzatishda 'Clarification Request' ("Pardon? What do you mean?") va 'Elicitation' ("He... what?") usullarini qo'lladi. Ushbu tuzatish usullari o'quvchida qaysi muhim jarayonni ishga soladi?
opts: Sinfdoshlar orasida janjal keltirib chiqaradi
O'quvchining nutqini butunlay to'xtatadi
O'qituvchining darsdagi obro'sini tushiradi
O'quvchini o'z nutqidagi nomutanosiblikni o'zi payqashga (Noticing the gap) va o'zini o'zi tuzatishga (Self-repair) undaydi
explanation: Clarification request va Elicitation kabi 'prompts' o'quvchiga tayyor javobni bermaydi, balki ularni o'z xatosi va maqsadli til o'rtasidagi bo'shliqni payqashga (noticing the gap) va o'zini o'zi tuzatishga (self-repair) undaydi.
mnemonic: Prompts = O'z xatosini o'zi payqash (Noticing the gap) va Self-repair.

q: Which of the following utterances represents an explicit performative utterance according to J.L. Austin's foundational taxonomy?
opts: "I hereby pronounce you husband and wife under the authority vested in me by the State."
"The committee usually meets every second Tuesday of the academic semester."
"I have always admired the extraordinary resilience displayed by our student cohort."
"She solemnly promised her mentor that her dissertation draft would arrive by midnight."
explanation: An explicit performative contains a performative verb in the first person singular present indicative active (often co-occurring with 'hereby'), where uttering the words under appropriate institutional conditions actually executes the act itself rather than describing an event.
mnemonic: Explicit performative = First-person, present indicative + 'hereby' performs the action.

q: Madina o'quvchisi Azizaning til o'rganishdagi o'ziga xos bosqichini kuzatmoqda. Aziza o'zbek tiliga ham, toza ingliz tiliga ham to'liq to'g'ri kelmaydigan, ammo o'z ichki mantiqiy qoidalariga ega bo'lgan oraliq dinamik til tizimidan foydalanmoqda. Larry Selinker (1972) ushbu tizimni nima deb atagan?
opts: Interlanguage (Oraliq til tizimi / Intertil)
Broken English (Buzilgan ingliz tili)
Pidginization dialect (Pidjin dialekti)
Universal Grammar deficit (Tug'ma grammatika yetishmovchiligi)
explanation: Larry Selinker tomonidan asos solingan 'Interlanguage' (Oraliq til) nazariyasiga ko'ra, har bir o'rganuvchi L1 dan L2 ga o'tishda o'zining dinamik, tizimli va qoidalarga asoslangan oraliq til tizimini yaratadi. Bu xatoliklar to'plami emas, rivojlanish bosqichidir.
mnemonic: Interlanguage = L1 dan L2 ga o'tishdagi mustaqil va dinamik oraliq til tizimi.

q: Rustam o'quvchilarda yuzaga keladigan xatolarni tahlil qilar ekan, Pit Corder (1967) tasnifiga binoan 'Error' (Tizimli xato) va 'Mistake' (Tasodifiy yanglishuv / slip) o'rtasidagi farqni aniqlamoqda. Quyidagi ta'riflardan qaysi biri 'Error' tushunchasini to'g'ri ifodalaydi?
opts: O'quvchi qoidani bilsa-da, charchoq yoki e'tiborsizlik sababli nutqda yo'l qo'ygan va o'zi darhol tuzata oladigan yanglishuv
O'quvchining bilim kompetentsiyasi (competence) yetishmasligi sababli yuzaga keladigan va o'quvchi o'z kuchi bilan mustaqil tuzata olmaydigan tizimli xatolik
O'qituvchining noto'g'ri tushuntirishi natijasida butun sinf yo'l qo'ygan kamchilik
Faqat yozma nutqda uchraydigan texnik imlo xatosi
explanation: Pit Corder bo'yicha: 'Mistake/Slip' — kompetentsiya bor, faqat ijroda (performance) charchoq tufayli adashish bo'lib, o'quvchi o'zi tuzata oladi. 'Error' esa o'quvchining til kompetentsiyasi (competence) hali yetishmaganini bildiradi va u mustaqil tuzata olmaydi.
mnemonic: Mistake = O'zi tuza oladi (Charchoq/Ijro); Error = Bilmaydi, mustaqil tuza olmaydi (Kompetentsiya).

q: Testologiya qoidalariga ko'ra, testning ishonchlilik koeffitsientini (Reliability) oshirishning eng samarali va to'g'ri didaktik usuli qaysi?
opts: Barcha savollarni faqat bitta mavzudan tuzish va 3 daqiqa vaqt berish.

Testdagi topshiriqlar sonini yetarli darajada ko'paytirish (namunani kengaytirish), savollar bo'yicha ko'rsatmalarni maksimal aniq va bir xil qilish hamda baholash mezonlarini qat'iy standartlashtirish.
Test savollarini mutlaqo tushunarsiz va chalkash so'zlar bilan boyitish.
Test natijalarini e'lon qilmasdan, baholarni tasodifiy lotereya orqali qo'yish.
explanation: Test topshiriqlari soni kam bo'lsa (masalan 3 ta savol), tasodifiy xato ehtimoli yuqori bo'ladi. Savollar sonini me'yorida oshirish (Spearman-Brown bashorati), yo'riqnomalarni bir xillashtirish va aniq kalitlar ishonchlilikni oshiradi.
mnemonic: Ishonchlilikni oshirish = Ko'proq reprezentativ savollar + Aniq standart yo'riqnoma.

q: Katta summativ imtihon tuzishdan oldin "Test spetsifikatsiyasi" (Table of Specifications) ishlab chiqish nima uchun zarur?
opts: O'quvchilarning imtihonga qanday kiyimda kelishini qat'iy belgilash uchun.
Imtihon o'tkaziladigan xonadagi stullarning geometrik o'lchamini hisoblash uchun.
Test savollarining fan mavzulari va Bloom taksonomiyasi kognitiv darajalari bo'yicha to'g'ri, adolatli va mutanosib taqsimlanishini loyihalashtirish va ta'minlash uchun.
Test blankalarini chop etuvchi bosmaxonaga byudjet ajratish uchun.
explanation: Test spetsifikatsiyasi — bu testning arxitektura chizmasi. U qaysi mavzudan nechtadan savol bo'lishi va qaysi kognitiv darajaga (eslab qolish, qo'llash, tahlil) tegishli ekanligini belgilab, testning mazmuniy validligini kafolatlaydi.
mnemonic: Test spetsifikatsiyasi = Testning mavzular va kognitiv darajalar bo'yicha chizmasi.

q: Xolistik rubrikalar (Holistic Rubrics) analitik rubrikalarga nisbatan tezroq tekshirish imkonini bersa-da, ularning o'quvchi uchun asosiy pedagogik kamchiligi nimada?
opts: Ushbu rubrika bilan faqat boshlang'ich sinf rasmlari baholanadi.
Xolistik rubrikalar faqat rangli qog'ozlarda chop etilishi kerak.
Xolistik rubrikadan foydalanganda baholash ballari har doim manfiy chiqadi.
O'quvchiga o'zining aynan qaysi mezon (lug'at, mantiq, grammatika) bo'yicha xato qilgani va qanday yaxshilash mumkinligi haqida batafsil diagnostik qayta aloqa bermaydi.
explanation: Xolistik rubrika faqat umumiy yagona baho (masalan '3' yoki 'O'rta') beradi. O'quvchi nima uchun bu bahoni olganini va aynan qaysi jihatini yaxshilashi kerakligini bilolmay qoladi.
mnemonic: Xolistik rubrika kamchiligi: Yaxlit ball bor, lekin qayerda xato qilganing noma'lum.

q: Feruza bir necha yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganayotgan kattalar guruhida ba'zi grammatik xatolarning (masalan, 'He like apples' yoki noto'g'ri artikllar) doimiy darslar va tushuntirishlarga qaramasdan butunlay yo'qolmay, qotib qolganini (mustahkamlanib ketganini) ko'rdi. Selinker ta'limotiga ko'ra bu fenomen nima deb ataladi?
opts: Overgeneralization (Qoidani haddan ortiq kengaytirish)
Code-switching (Kodni almashtirish)
Fossilization (Fosillashuv / Xatolarning tosh qotishi)
Language attrition (Tilning unutilishi)
explanation: Fossilization (Fosillashuv) — o'quvchi ma'lum bir darajaga yetgach, muloqot ehtiyojlari qondirilgani sababli oraliq til tizimidagi xatoliklarning mustahkamlanib, toshdek qotib qolishi va rivojlanishdan to'xtashidir.
mnemonic: Fossilization = Xatolarning tuzalmay tosh qotib qolishi (Muloqot yetarli bo'lgach to'xtash).

q: Alisher 6-sinf o'quvchisi Jasurning 'goed', 'comed', 'foots', 'sheeps' kabi so'zlarni ishlatayotganini ko'rdi. Jasur bu so'zlarni hech qayerda eshitmagan bo'lsa-da, o'zi shunday shakllantirgan. Til o'rganishda ushbu hodisa nima deb ataladi?
opts: Linguistic interference (Leksik chalkashlik)
Negative transfer (Ona tilining salbiy ta'siri)
Auditory hallucination (Eshitish buzilishi)
Overgeneralization (Qoidani haddan tashqari umumlashtirish) — o'rganilgan umumiy qoidani istisnolarga ham noto'g'ri tatbiq etish
explanation: Overgeneralization (haddan tashqari umumlashtirish) — o'quvchining muntazam qoidani (masalan, o'tgan zamon uchun '-ed' yoki ko'plik uchun '-s') barcha so'zlarga, jumladan istisno so'zlarga ham mexanik tatbiq etishidir. Bu rivojlanishning ijobiy belgisidir.
mnemonic: Overgeneralization = Qoidani (masalan, -ed) hamma joyga, hatto noto'g'ri fe'llarga ham yopishtirish.

q: At a formal military tribunal, the presiding officer strikes the gavel and states: *"The defendant is hereby stripped of his rank and dishonorably discharged."* Into which of Searle’s five illocutionary categories does this act fall, and what is its direction of fit?
opts: An assertive, exhibiting a words-to-world direction of fit because it reports an empirical biological condition.
A declaration, displaying a dual direction of fit (both words-to-world and world-to-words) as it creates the institutional reality it describes.
A commissive, having a world-to-words direction of fit because the speaker commits to future personal integrity.
An expressive, possessing no direction of fit because it solely conveys internal psychological emotions.
explanation: Declarations bring about an immediate correspondence between the propositional content and reality by virtue of being uttered by an authorized institutional authority. Thus, they alter the institutional world to match the words while making the words describe that new state (dual direction of fit).
mnemonic: Declarations: Dual fit — saying the words creates the institutional reality.

opts: Flawlessly
Flawless

options: Flawlessly

Because flawless

q:
Match each research finding (1‑3) with its most appropriate implication (A‑C).
1. 75% of participants reported improved sleep after using blue‑light filters.
2. A study found that daily meditation reduces cortisol levels by 20%.
3. Survey results show that 60% of teenagers prefer video lessons over textbooks.
A. Enhanced well‑being and stress reduction.
B. Potential shift toward digital learning resources.
C. Better sleep quality through reduced exposure to blue light.
explanation: Finding 1 links to improved sleep (C), finding 2 to stress reduction (A), and finding 3 to a move toward digital resources (B). The combination 1‑C, 2‑A, 3‑B matches option A.

q: O'qituvchi dars jarayonida o'quvchilarga qizil, sariq va yashil kartochkalarni ko'rsatishni taklif qildi (Yashil — "to'liq tushundim va tushuntirib bera olaman", Sariq — "qisman tushundim, savolim bor", Qizil — "umuman tushunmadim, yordam kerak"). Bu usul darsda qanday vazifani bajaradi?
opts: Haqiqiy vaqt rejimida (Real-time) butun sinfning tushunish holatini bir zumda ko'rish va dars sur'atiga darhol tuzatish kiritish imkonini beruvchi formativ monitoring.
Yo'l harakati qoidalarini ingliz tilida yoddan so'rash vositasi.
Darsda eng ko'p gapirgan o'quvchilarni jazolash tizimi.
O'quvchilarning ko'rish o'tkirligini tekshiruvchi tibbiy test.

mnemonic: Svetafor texnikasi = Tushunish holatini bir zumda ko'rsatuvchi formativ signal.

q:
Read the passage:
"Gabriel Conroy leaned against the cool glass of the Gresham Hotel window, watching the snowflakes fall through the lamplight onto the dark waters of the Liffey. His wife Gretta lay asleep on the bed, her face turned away in shadow, still haunted by the memory of young Michael Furey, who had died for her sake in the Galway rain. Gabriel’s earlier vanity, his petty oratorical pride at the Christmas dinner, seemed now so pitiful, so grotesquely small. A strange, generous tears filled his eyes. Snow was general all over Ireland. It was falling softly upon the Bog of Allen and, farther westward, softly falling into the dark mutinous Shannon waves, falling faintly through the universe and faintly falling, like the descent of their last end, upon all the living and the dead."

What profound transformation (epiphany) occurs within Gabriel as he watches the falling snow?
opts: His egotistical vanity dissolves into a humbling realization of his own mediocrity and shared mortality with all humanity.
He resolves to divorce Gretta immediately and move permanently to the European continent.
He becomes furious that Michael Furey was a more talented lyric tenor than himself.
He plans a new lecture series on British political supremacy in Irish municipal governance.
explanation: Gabriel experiences a profound spiritual epiphany: his intellectual arrogance and possessive vanity melt away, replaced by 'strange, generous tears' recognizing universal human mortality.
