q: Ko'chirishning (plagiat) oldini olish maqsadida imtihonda A va B variantlar tuzildi. Ushbu variantlar haqiqatan ham ekvivalent (Parallel Forms) ekanligini tasdiqlash uchun qaysi shart bajarilishi shart?
opts: A variant faqat oson, B variant esa faqat daho darajasidagi qiyin savollardan iborat bo'lishi kerak.
Ikkala variant ham bir xil spetsifikatsiya asosida tuzilgan bo'lib, ularning o'rtacha ballari, dispersiyasi va qiyinlik darajalari statistik jihatdan teng bo'lishi lozim.
A variant qizil, B variant esa sariq qog'ozga bosilishi shart.
B variantdagi barcha savollar A variantning so'zma-so'z teskari tarjimasi bo'lishi kerak.
explanation: Parallel / Ekvivalent formalar (A va B variant) bir xil bilim va ko'nikmalarni o'lchashi, bir xil test spetsifikatsiyasiga ega bo'lishi va ularning qiyinlik darajalari teng bo'lishi shart, aks holda adolatsizlik kelib chiqadi.
mnemonic: Variantlar ekvivalentligi = Bir xil spetsifikatsiya, teng qiyinlik darajasi.

q: A head of department emails a junior lecturer: *"I guarantee that you will be assigned a reduced teaching load during the upcoming research semester."* According to Searle's taxonomy of speech acts, which category does this belong to?
opts: Assertive, because the utterance merely evaluates historical teaching assignments across departments.
Directive, because the speaker attempts to compel the recipient to perform extensive academic research.
Commissive, because the speaker commits themselves to a specific future course of action.
Declaration, because the email automatically rewrites university statutory bylaws without administrative review.
explanation: Commissives (promises, pledges, vows, guarantees, threats) commit the speaker to do something in the future. Their direction of fit is world-to-words (the speaker obligates themselves to make the world match what was spoken).
mnemonic: Commissives = Speaker Commits to future action (world-to-words).

q: Consider the utterance: *"Could you please furnish the audit committee with the unredacted expenditure spreadsheets by 5:00 PM tomorrow?"* What is the primary speech act category and its underlying direction of fit?
opts: Declaration, with dual direction of fit, as the mere asking instantly balances the company's ledger.
Assertive, displaying a words-to-world direction of fit, as it conveys historical financial data to the audience.
Expressive, with no direction of fit, as it expresses subjective satisfaction regarding accounting standards.
Directive, displaying a world-to-words direction of fit, as it aims to get the hearer to make the world match the speaker's propositional content.
explanation: Directives (requests, orders, advice, commands) attempt to get the addressee to perform an action. The direction of fit is world-to-words: the hearer's subsequent actions in the world must conform to the speaker's uttered words.
mnemonic: Directives: Get hearer to act -> World must match the Words.

q: O'qituvchi choraklik yozma ish natijalarini tekshirgach, sinf taxtasiga barcha o'quvchilarning ism-familiyasi va past baholarini qizil rangda yozib, butun sinf oldida ularni "maktab sharmandasi" deb e'lon qildi. Pedagogik etika va kasb standarti bo'yicha o'qituvchining bu xatti-harakati qanday baholanadi?
opts: O'qituvchining mutlaq qonuniy huquqi bo'lib, buni maktab ma'muriyati rag'batlantirishi lozim.
O'quvchilarda g'urur uyg'otuvchi va ularni o'qishga undovchi eng ilg'or tarbiyaviy metod.

Qo'pol professional va axloqiy qoidabuzarlik; o'quvchilarning shaxsiy baholari va o'zlashtirish ko'rsatkichlari konfidentsial (maxfiy) ma'lumot bo'lib, ularni ommaviy kamsitish uchun ishlatish qat'iyan man etiladi.
Faqat o'quvchilarning ota-onalari norozilik bildirmasagina to'g'ri hisoblanadi.
explanation: Baholar — shaxsiy konfidentsial ma'lumotdir. Ularni ommaviy ravishda kamsitish yoki sharmanda qilish vositasiga aylantirish pedagogik etikaga mutlaqo ziddir va bolaning ruhiyatiga jiddiy zarar yetkazadi.
mnemonic: Baho konfidentsialligi: Shaxsiy bahoni butun sinf oldida sharmanda qilishga yo'l qo'yilmaydi!

q: O'quv yili yoki yangi modul boshlanishida o'tkaziladigan diagnostik baholashning asosiy vazifasi nima?
opts: Maktabdan haydalishi kerak bo'lgan o'quvchilar ro'yxatini tuzish.
O'quvchilarga darhol rasmiy qat'iy jurnal baholarini qo'yib, kim a'lochi va kim yomon ekanini hal qilish.
O'quvchilarni qo'rqitib, intizomga chaqirish.
O'quvchilarning yangi mavzuni o'zlashtirish uchun zarur bo'lgan boshlang'ich bilim va ko'nikmalari darajasini hamda mavjud bo'shliqlarni aniqlab, ta'lim jarayonini shunga mos rejalashtirish.
explanation: Diagnostik baholash (Pre-assessment) o'quvchilarning nimalarni bilishi va nimalarni bilmasligini aniqlash (tashxis qo'yish) uchun xizmat qiladi. Unga rasmiy jazo ballari qo'yilmaydi.
mnemonic: Diagnostika = Tashxis qo'yish; bo'shliqlarni aniqlab, darsni to'g'ri boshlash.

q: Malika o'quvchisi Azizaning til o'rganishdagi o'ziga xos bosqichini kuzatmoqda. Aziza o'zbek tiliga ham, toza ingliz tiliga ham to'liq to'g'ri kelmaydigan, ammo o'z ichki mantiqiy qoidalariga ega bo'lgan oraliq dinamik til tizimidan foydalanmoqda. Larry Selinker (1972) ushbu tizimni nima deb atagan?
opts: Interlanguage (Oraliq til tizimi / Intertil)
Broken English (Buzilgan ingliz tili)
Pidginization dialect (Pidjin dialekti)
Universal Grammar deficit (Tug'ma grammatika yetishmovchiligi)
explanation: Larry Selinker tomonidan asos solingan 'Interlanguage' (Oraliq til) nazariyasiga ko'ra, har bir o'rganuvchi L1 dan L2 ga o'tishda o'zining dinamik, tizimli va qoidalarga asoslangan oraliq til tizimini yaratadi. Bu xatoliklar to'plami emas, rivojlanish bosqichidir.
mnemonic: Interlanguage = L1 dan L2 ga o'tishdagi mustaqil va dinamik oraliq til tizimi.

q: Following an acrimonious faculty debate, the dean sends a note stating: *"I sincerely apologize for losing my composure during this morning’s curriculum deliberation."* How is this speech act categorized in Searle's framework?
opts: An expressive, having no direction of fit, as it articulates the speaker's psychological state regarding a prior state of affairs.
A commissive, having a world-to-words direction of fit, because the speaker guarantees flawless behavior at every future meeting.
A declaration, because uttering the apology legally amends the university's regulatory code of conduct.
An assertive, having a words-to-world direction of fit, because it neutrally documents the acoustic decibel levels recorded in the hall.
explanation: Expressives (apologies, condolences, congratulations, thanks) express the speaker's psychological attitude or internal affective stance regarding a presupposed state of affairs specified in the proposition. They have no direction of fit (null / empty direction of fit) because the truth of the event is taken for granted.
mnemonic: Expressives: No direction of fit (presupposed reality, communicates inner psychological state).

q: O'quvchilarda o'z-o'zini baholash ko'nikmasini rivojlantirish ularda qaysi hayotiy muhim qobiliyatni tarbiyalaydi?
opts: Metakognitsiya — o'z fikrlash va o'rganish jarayonini mustaqil tahlil qilish, o'z xatolarini anglash va o'zini o'zi rivojlantirishga mas'uliyat bilan yondashish qobiliyatini.
O'ziga faqat eng yuqori baholarni qo'yib, o'qituvchini aldash mahoratini.
Boshqa sinfdoshlarining daftarlarini yashirincha tekshirish instinktini.
Baholash mezonlarini o'z xohishiga qarab o'zgartirish vakolatini.
explanation: Self-assessment metakognitiv ko'nikmalarni rivojlantiradi: o'quvchi tashqi bahoga qaram bo'lib qolmasdan, o'z ishiga tanqidiy qaray oladigan mustaqil shaxsga aylanadi.
mnemonic: Self-assessment = Metakognitsiya (O'z tafakkurini o'zi tahlil qilish).

q: Jasur o'quvchilarda yuzaga keladigan xatolarni tahlil qilar ekan, Pit Corder (1967) tasnifiga binoan 'Error' (Tizimli xato) va 'Mistake' (Tasodifiy yanglishuv / slip) o'rtasidagi farqni aniqlamoqda. Quyidagi ta'riflardan qaysi biri 'Error' tushunchasini to'g'ri ifodalaydi?
opts: O'quvchi qoidani bilsa-da, charchoq yoki e'tiborsizlik sababli nutqda yo'l qo'ygan va o'zi darhol tuzata oladigan yanglishuv
O'quvchining bilim kompetentsiyasi (competence) yetishmasligi sababli yuzaga keladigan va o'quvchi o'z kuchi bilan mustaqil tuzata olmaydigan tizimli xatolik
O'qituvchining noto'g'ri tushuntirishi natijasida butun sinf yo'l qo'ygan kamchilik
Faqat yozma nutqda uchraydigan texnik imlo xatosi
explanation: Pit Corder bo'yicha: 'Mistake/Slip' — kompetentsiya bor, faqat ijroda (performance) charchoq tufayli adashish bo'lib, o'quvchi o'zi tuzata oladi. 'Error' esa o'quvchining til kompetentsiyasi (competence) hali yetishmaganini bildiradi va u mustaqil tuzata olmaydi.
mnemonic: Mistake = O'zi tuza oladi (Charchoq/Ijro); Error = Bilmaydi, mustaqil tuza olmaydi (Kompetentsiya).

q: Shahnoza bir necha yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganayotgan kattalar guruhida ba'zi grammatik xatolarning (masalan, 'He like apples' yoki noto'g'ri artikllar) doimiy darslar va tushuntirishlarga qaramasdan butunlay yo'qolmay, qotib qolganini (mustahkamlanib ketganini) ko'rdi. Selinker ta'limotiga ko'ra bu fenomen nima deb ataladi?
opts: Overgeneralization (Qoidani haddan ortiq kengaytirish)
Code-switching (Kodni almashtirish)
Fossilization (Fosillashuv / Xatolarning tosh qotishi)
Language attrition (Tilning unutilishi)
explanation: Fossilization (Fosillashuv) — o'quvchi ma'lum bir darajaga yetgach, muloqot ehtiyojlari qondirilgani sababli oraliq til tizimidagi xatoliklarning mustahkamlanib, toshdek qotib qolishi va rivojlanishdan to'xtashidir.
mnemonic: Fossilization = Xatolarning tuzalmay tosh qotib qolishi (Muloqot yetarli bo'lgach to'xtash).

q: A climate scientist publishes in a peer-reviewed monograph: *"Anthropogenic tropospheric warming has accelerated markedly over the past four decades."* In pragmatic terms, which illocutionary class and epistemic commitment are exemplified?
opts: A directive, which carries a world-to-words direction of fit and commands the reader to reduce carbon emissions immediately.
An assertive (representative), which carries a words-to-world direction of fit and commits the speaker to the truth of the expressed proposition.
A declaration, which magically cools atmospheric temperatures by virtue of institutional peer review.
An expressive, which has no direction of fit and merely expresses idiosyncratic personal grief regarding climate changes.
explanation: Assertives (or representatives) commit the speaker in varying degrees to the truth of the expressed proposition. Their direction of fit is words-to-world: the speaker seeks to make their words accurately reflect the objective state of the world.
mnemonic: Assertives / Representatives: Words describe World (true/false assessment).

q: A university lecturer jokingly says to two undergraduate students in a coffee shop: *"I now pronounce you husband and wife."* Why does this speech act fail to take institutional effect, according to J.L. Austin?
opts: It violates the Maxim of Quantity because the lecturer failed to list all legal divorce prerequisites.
It is an abuse caused by an insincere psychological state in an otherwise legally competent magistrate.
It is a misfire resulting from a breach of conventional preparatory authority and appropriate institutional procedure.
It suffers from perlocutionary breakdown because the coffee shop barista failed to hear the utterance.
explanation: Austin distinguishes between 'misfires' (the act is null and void because conventions or participants are not appropriately authorized/executed) and 'abuses' (the act is executed but insincere or unfulfilled, e.g. a false promise). Because a lecturer in a coffee shop lacks legal marriage jurisdiction, the performative is null and void — an absolute misfire.
mnemonic: Misfire = Act is null and void (unauthorized/invalid procedure). Abuse = Act occurs but is insincere.

q: A politician publicly promises: *"I will veto any bill that raises sales taxes,"* while secretly harboring the private intention to sign the bill upon its passage. In Austinian speech act terminology, this utterance represents:
opts: A perlocutionary nullity, because voters inevitably disbelieve all electoral pledges.
A misfire, because the politician lacked legislative standing to discuss taxation policy in public.
A locutionary failure, because the grammatical syntax of future tense cannot encode commitments.
An abuse of the speech act, because the performative is executed but lacks the necessary sincerity condition.
explanation: When an utterer goes through the correct procedure and possesses legitimate authority, but lacks the appropriate internal belief, feeling, or intention required by the sincerity condition, Austin classifies the speech act as an 'abuse' (infelicitous due to insincerity, rather than a void misfire).
mnemonic: Abuse = Sincerity condition breached; words are bindingly uttered but hollow/deceptive.

Theoretical digression: it describes the aesthetic beauty of crystalline quartz minerals found in mountain caves.

q: In Searle’s framework for the illocutionary act of promising (*I promise to do A*), what is the essential preparatory condition?
opts: The speaker believes that doing A is beneficial to the hearer, and that doing A is not something the speaker would routinely do in the normal course of events.
The speaker possesses full executive legal authority to enforce statutory penal sanctions upon the hearer.
The hearer has explicitly demanded a monetary bond guaranteeing the completion of action A.
The propositional content predicates a past event that the hearer has already completed.
explanation: For a promise, Searle’s preparatory conditions state that: (1) Hearer would prefer S's doing A to S's not doing A, and S believes H would prefer this; (2) It is not obvious to both that S will do A in the normal course of events.
mnemonic: Promise Preparatory: Hearer wants it, and it's not going to happen anyway without the promise.

opts: Satirical hyperbole mocking rural Irish funeral traditions.
Harsh cacophony mimicking the violent crashing of Atlantic waves.
Chiasmus and rhythmic parallelism that mirrors the gentle, drifting descent of the snow.
Oxymoron expressing violent joy during a military triumph.
q:
Read the passage:
"Gabriel Conroy leaned against the cool glass of the Gresham Hotel window, watching the snowflakes fall through the lamplight onto the dark waters of the Liffey. His wife Gretta lay asleep on the bed, her face turned away in shadow, still haunted by the memory of young Michael Furey, who had died for her sake in the Galway rain. Gabriel’s earlier vanity, his petty oratorical pride at the Christmas dinner, seemed now so pitiful, so grotesquely small. A strange, generous tears filled his eyes. Snow was general all over Ireland. It was falling softly upon the Bog of Allen and, farther westward, softly falling into the dark mutinous Shannon waves, falling faintly through the universe and faintly falling, like the descent of their last end, upon all the living and the dead."

What literary device is prominent in the cadence of the final line: "falling faintly through the universe and faintly falling"?
explanation: The hypnotic reversal ('falling faintly... faintly falling') is chiasmus, producing a lyrical, rhythmic lullaby that mimics falling snow.
options: Satirical hyperbole mocking rural Irish funeral traditions.
Harsh cacophony mimicking the violent crashing of Atlantic waves.
Chiasmus and rhythmic parallelism that mirrors the gentle, drifting descent of the snow.
Oxymoron expressing violent joy during a military triumph.

opts: A strict functional compartmentalization between an elite learned variety and a vernacular native dialect.
The complete absence of written literature or standardized spelling rules.
The rapid and total extinction of the native vernacular tongue within two generations.

q:
Read the passage:
"In sociolinguistics, diglossia describes a stable sociolinguistic situation where two distinct varieties of a language coexist across a speech community, segregated by rigid social functions. The High (H) variety, acquired through formal pedagogical instruction and codified in classical literature, is restricted to official administration, university lectures, and sacred liturgy. Conversely, the Low (L) variety is acquired natively as a primary tongue, serving daily conversational intercourse and folk culture. Despite centuries of coexistence, the L variety is often stigmatized by native speakers as 'corrupt' or 'grammarless', even though descriptive linguistics reveals its morphological complexity and expressive richness."

What defining structural feature characterizes a classic diglossic speech community?
explanation: Diglossia involves two varieties of the same language 'segregated by rigid social functions' (High variety for formal/official domains; Low variety for home/informal).
options: A strict functional compartmentalization between an elite learned variety and a vernacular native dialect.
The complete absence of written literature or standardized spelling rules.
The rapid and total extinction of the native vernacular tongue within two generations.
A requirement that all citizens speak two entirely unrelated foreign language families.

q: Umida dars taqdimotida bir vaqtning o'zida ham juda uzun murakkab inglizcha matnni, ham uning audio yozuvini, ham matnga aloqasi bo'lmagan harakatlanuvchi animatsiyalarni qo'ydi. O'quvchilar hech narsani tushunmaganliklaridan shikoyat qilishdi. John Sweller'ning 'Cognitive Load Theory' (Kognitiv yuklama nazariyasi) bo'yicha bu qanday yuklamaning oshib ketishi hisoblanadi?
opts: Extraneous Cognitive Load (Tashqi / Ortiqcha kognitiv yuklama) — noto'g'ri dars dizayni va chalg'ituvchi elementlar tufayli ishchi xotiraning (working memory) to'lib qolishi
Intrinsic Cognitive Load (Ichki kognitiv yuklama)
Germane Cognitive Load (Foydali kognitiv yuklama)
Affective Cognitive Load (Emotsional yuklama)
explanation: Cognitive Load Theory (Sweller): 1) Intrinsic (mavzuning tabiiy qiyinligi); 2) Extraneous (yomon metodika, chalg'ituvchi slaydlardan kelib chiquvchi keraksiz yuklama); 3) Germane (sxema hosil qilishga xizmat qiluvchi foydali yuklama). O'qituvchi Extraneous yuklamani minimallashtirishi shart.
mnemonic: Extraneous Load = Chalg'ituvchi yomon dizayn -> Ishchi xotirani o'ldiradi.

q: Otabek grammatikani o'rgatishda 'Deductive' (Deduktiv) va 'Inductive' (Induktiv / Guided Discovery) yondashuvlarni taqqoslamoqda. Induktiv yondashuvning deduktiv yondashuvdan eng asosiy pedagogik afzalligi nimada?
opts: O'qituvchining dars davomida 40 daqiqa tinimsiz gapirishini ta'minlaydi
O'quvchilar qoidani tayyor holda olmay, berilgan boy misollar asosida o'zlari tahlil qilib kashf qiladilar (deeper cognitive processing), natijada bilim xotirada uzoqroq va mustahkamroq saqlanadi
Vaqtni deduktiv usulga qaraganda ancha tejaydi
O'quvchilardan hech qanday aqliy zo'riqish talab qilmaydi
explanation: Induktiv (Guided discovery) yondashuvda chuqur kognitiv ishlov (deep semantic processing) yuz beradi. Inson o'z mehnati bilan kashf qilgan qoidani tayyor eshitgan qoidasiga qaraganda ancha yaxshi eslab qoladi.
mnemonic: Inductive = Misollar -> Kashfiyot -> Chuqur xotira (Guided discovery).

Dars davomida faqat alohida ajratilgan grammatik qoidalarni ketma-ket yodlash
Asosiy e'tibor muloqot va ma'noga qaratilgan paytda, zarurat tug'ilgandagina o'quvchilar diqqatini qisqa muddatga tilning aniq grammatik yoki leksik shakliga jalb qilish
Darsda faqat yozma testlar yechish
explanation: Michael Long tasnifi: Focus on Forms (FoFs) — an'anaviy sintetik usul (alohida qoidalarni ketma-ket o'rganish). Focus on Form (FoF) — kommunikativ muloqot davomida muammo chiqqanda qisqa muddatga shaklga e'tibor qaratish (incidental focus on form).
mnemonic: Focus on Form (FoF) = Muloqot ustuvor, shakl ehtiyojga qarab kiritiladi.

q: Sherzod o'quvchilarda yangi leksikani 'Working Memory' (Ishchi xotira)dan 'Long-Term Memory' (Uzoq muddatli xotira)ga o'tkazish uchun Alan Baddeley'ning xotira modelidan foydalanmoqda. Ishchi xotiradagi 'Phonological Loop' (Fonologik halqa)ning asosiy vazifasi nima?
opts: Barcha xotiralarni bir umrga saqlash
Murakkab matematik hisob-kitoblarni amalga oshirish
O'quvchining jismoniy harakatlarini muvofiqlashtirish
Eshitilgan yoki o'qilgan yangi so'zlarning tovush qoliplarini qisqa muddat ichida takrorlab, ovozli tarzda ushlab turish
explanation: Baddeley xotira modelida 'Phonological Loop' fonetik-tovushli axborotni 2-3 soniya davomida ichki sub-vokal takrorlash orqali ushlab turadi. Bu yangi xorijiy so'zlarning talaffuzi va shaklini eslab qolishning birlamchi zanjiridir.
mnemonic: Phonological Loop = Yangi so'z tovushlarini ichki takrorlash orqali ushlab turuvchi mexanizm.

A comedy of errors resulting from an innocent clerical postal mix-up.

q: What defines the *essential condition* of a directive speech act (such as ordering or requesting)?
opts: The speaker must feel genuine personal affection toward the addressee during the interaction.
The utterance counts as an attempt by the speaker to get the hearer to perform a specific future action.
The utterance must contain an overt syntactic imperative verb followed by an overt polite adverbial.
The hearer must explicitly confirm their agreement before the utterance can be classified as a directive.
explanation: The essential condition determines what the speech act fundamentally *counts as*. For directives, the utterance counts as an attempt by the speaker to make the hearer perform an act.
mnemonic: Essential condition = What the act 'counts as' (its core illocutionary point).

q: In John Searle’s analysis of illocutionary acts, what is the *sincerity condition* required for an apology to be felicitous?
opts: The speaker proves that the past incident was entirely accidental and caused by third-party negligence.
The hearer explicitly executes a written waiver forgiving the transgressor of all legal tort liability.
The speaker genuinely feels regret or sorrow for the past act or state of affairs that affected the hearer.
The utterance contains no auxiliary modal verbs that might imply shared epistemic culpability.
explanation: The sincerity condition focuses on the internal psychological state of the speaker. For an expressive act of apologizing, the sincerity condition is that the speaker genuinely regrets the offensive event.
mnemonic: Sincerity condition = Speaker genuinely possesses the required psychological state (regret for apologies).

"In sociolinguistics, diglossia describes a stable sociolinguistic situation where two distinct varieties of a language coexist across a speech community, segregated by rigid social functions. The High (H) variety, acquired through formal pedagogical instruction and codified in classical literature, is restricted to official administration, university lectures, and sacred liturgy. Conversely, the Low (L) variety is acquired natively as a primary tongue, serving daily conversational intercourse and folk culture. opts: O'qituvchining dars davomida 40 daqiqa tinimsiz gapirishini ta'minlaydi
O'quvchilar qoidani tayyor holda olmay, berilgan boy misollar asosida o'zlari tahlil qilib kashf qiladilar (deeper cognitive processing), natijada bilim xotirada uzoqroq va mustahkamroq saqlanadi

mnemonic: Inductive = Misollar -> Kashfiyot -> Chuqur xotira (Guided discovery).

q:

"When Josef K. arrived at the nondescript tenement building in the suburbs, there was no sign on the door to indicate that a court of inquiry was in session. It provides comic relief to lighten the mood of a tense criminal murder mystery.

q: A manager says to an employee: *"Do you know that the client files are still unfiled on the conference table?"* In Searle’s analysis of indirect speech acts, what are the primary and secondary illocutionary acts?
opts: The secondary act is an interrogative inquiry regarding knowledge; the primary act is an indirect directive to file the client files.
The primary act is an inquiry regarding cognitive awareness; the secondary act is an expressive complaint about room tidiness.
Both primary and secondary acts are pure constative assertives devoid of any communicative expectation.
The primary act is an explicit performative declaration firing the employee for insubordination.
explanation: In Searle’s terminology, the literal act performed via syntactic form is the 'secondary illocutionary act' (asking whether the hearer knows), whereas the non-literal, intended communicative act is the 'primary illocutionary act' (ordering the hearer to tidy up the files).
mnemonic: Primary = Intended goal (directive). Secondary = Literal vehicle (question).

q: Why is the question *"Can you pass the water pitcher?"* universally interpreted in standard dining contexts as a request rather than an inquiry about physical capability?
opts: The word 'can' has lost its semantic ability meaning entirely in the English language.
It has become conventionalized as an indirect directive questioning the hearer's preparatory ability condition.
Dining table etiquette suspends all normal semantic and syntactic parsing procedures.
The sentence represents an ungrammatical imperative masquerading as an indicative clause.
explanation: Searle observed that one standard way to execute an indirect directive is to query one of the felicity conditions — specifically, the preparatory condition (the hearer's ability to perform the act). Over time, questioning ability (*Can you...*) has become conventionalized as a polite indirect request.
mnemonic: Conventionalized request: Querying hearer's preparatory ability (*Can you...?*).

In a promise, the direction of fit is world-to-words, whereas in a threat, the direction of fit is words-to-world.
In a promise, the speaker assumes the hearer desires the future event; in a threat, the speaker assumes the hearer views the future event as detrimental.
Threats always utilize grammatical past progressive tense, whereas promises require future modals.
explanation: Both promises and threats are commissives committing the speaker to future action. However, their preparatory conditions diverge completely regarding hearer preference: a promise predicates an action assumed to be beneficial/welcomed by the hearer, whereas a threat predicates an action assumed to be harmful/unwelcome.
mnemonic: Commissive contrast: Promise = Hearer wants it; Threat = Hearer fears/dislikes it.

opts: A poignant contrast between the family’s illusory bygone prosperity and their subsequent ruin.
The emotional detachment of Arthur’s grandfather from the estate's maintenance.
The superior durability of Victorian mechanical instruments over modern devices.
Arthur’s scientific ambition to restore the conservatory’s meteorological station.

"Newland Archer gazed across the parquet floor of the Van der Luyden ballroom, watching the small, pale face of the Countess Olenska amidst the plumage and diamonds of the New York elect. q: A supreme court judge announces: *"We find the newly enacted statute unconstitutional under the equal protection doctrine."* According to Austin's taxonomy of performatives, this act is classified as a:
opts: Expositive, which merely illustrates syntactic parsing rules during rhetorical lectures.
Behabitive, which solely expresses psychological reactions to social conduct.
Commissive, which commits the judge to run for political executive office.
Verdictive, which involves delivering a formal legal finding or judgment based on institutional authority.
explanation: Austin classified performatives into five groups: Verdictives (giving a verdict or authoritative judgment), Exercitives (exercising powers/rights), Commissives (committing to actions), Behabitives (attitudes and social behavior), and Expositives (clarifying arguments). A judicial ruling is a prototypical verdictive.
mnemonic: Austin's Verdictive = Delivering an authoritative verdict or judicial judgment.

mnemonic: Passive performatives + 'hereby' = Valid formal/institutional performative.

q: In early speech act theory, how did J.L. Austin define a *constative* utterance, prior to developing the broader illocutionary framework?
opts: An utterance that asserts something that can be evaluated as true or false, rather than performing an action.
An utterance that automatically transforms social reality without requiring listener comprehension.
An expletive or emotional scream that bypasses the cerebral cortex entirely.
A ritualistic incantation delivered during coronation ceremonies.
explanation: Austin originally contrasted 'performatives' (doing things with words, evaluated for felicity) with 'constatives' (stating or reporting facts, evaluated for truth or falsity). Later, he recognized that stating is itself a speech act.
mnemonic: Constatives = Statements evaluating truth/falsity (versus Performatives = doing actions).

q: Why did Austin ultimately abandon his rigid dichotomy between *performatives* and *constatives* in favor of the general theory of speech acts?
opts: He concluded that constatives exist only in written Latin and cannot be spoken aloud in modern English.
He realized that stating and asserting are themselves actions performed through speech, subject to felicity conditions like sincerity and evidence.
He found that all performatives could be scientifically translated into electro-chemical brain waves.
British common law abolished all legal verbal contracts, making performatives theoretically redundant.
explanation: Austin discovered that statements (constatives) are also actions (*asserting*, *claiming*) and are subject to felicity conditions (e.g. you cannot felicitously say *The cat is on the mat* if you believe it is not — Moore's paradox). Thus, every utterance performs an illocutionary act.
mnemonic: Constatives collapsed because stating IS an action (an assertive illocutionary act).

"Conventional reverse osmosis desalination relies on polyamide composite membranes that require colossal hydraulic pressures to force seawater across dense polymeric matrices, imposing severe energetic and economic costs. q: Jamshid yozish darsida 'Product Approach' (Tayyor mahsulotga asoslangan yondashuv) bilan 'Genre Approach' (Janrli yondashuv) o'rtasidagi farqni tahlil qilmoqda. Janrli yondashuvning (Genre Approach - Swales, Martin) eng asosiy markaziy xususiyati nimada?
opts: Faqat namunaviy matnni mexanik tarzda so'zma-so'z ko'chirib yozish
Matnning ijtimoiy maqsadi (social purpose), auditoriyasi (target audience) va shu janrga xos ritorik harakatlar (rhetorical moves / conventions)ni tahlil qilib, kontekstga mos matn yaratish
Yozma ishda faqat passiv nisbatdagi gaplarni ishlatish majburiyati
O'quvchiga har qanday qoidalardan xoli erkin she'r yozdirish
explanation: Genre Approach (John Swales) matnni ijtimoiy muloqot vositasi deb qaraydi. Har bir janrning (masalan: ariza, ilmiy maqola, shikoyat xati) o'ziga xos ritorik bosqichlari (rhetorical moves) va auditoriya bilan muloqot qilish qoidalari bo'ladi.
mnemonic: Genre Approach = Ijtimoiy maqsad + Auditoriya + Ritorik harakatlar (Moves).

q: Nilufar o'quvchilar yozgan insholarni baholashda 'Peer Review' (Tengdoshlar taqrizi) bosqichini kiritdi. O'quvchilar bir-birlarining ishiga baho berishda shunchaki 'yaxshi' yoki 'yomon' demasdan, sifatli tahlil qilishlari uchun o'qituvchi ularga nima berishi shart?
opts: Darslikdagi barcha grammatik qoidalar kitobi
Qizil qalam va jazo daftarchasi
Aniq mezonlarga asoslangan yo'riqnoma va savolnomalar (Peer review checklist / guided rubric)
Faqat lug'at kitoblari
explanation: Peer Review muvaffaqiyati aniq yo'naltiruvchi rubrika va cheklistlarga (Checklist) bog'liq. Cheklist bo'lmasa o'quvchilar nima qilishni bilmay, faqat shaxsiy munosabat yoki mayda imlo xatolariga chalg'ib ketadilar.
mnemonic: Peer Review = Aniq mezonli cheklist (Checklist & Rubric) bilan samarali.

q: Farhod insholarni tekshirganda 'Revising' (Qayta ishlash) va 'Editing' (Tahrirlash) bosqichlarining mohiyatini o'quvchilarga ajratib bermoqchi. Ushbu ikki bosqich qanday farqlanadi?
opts: Revising o'qituvchi tomonidan, Editing esa direktor tomonidan qilinadi
Revising faqat imlo xatolarini tekshiradi, Editing esa butun inshoni o'chirib qayta yozdiradi
Bu ikkisi mutlaqo bir xil jarayon bo'lib, hech qanday farqi yo'q
Revising — matnning mazmuni, mantiqiy tuzilishi, g'oyalari va abzatslar ketma-ketligini qayta ko'rib chiqish; Editing esa imlo, punktuatsiya va grammatik aniqlikni tuzatishdir
explanation: Revising (Re-vision = qayta tasavvur qilish) global darajada ishlaydi: g'oyalar to'liqmi, dalillar yetarlimi, mantiq bormi? Editing esa lokal mikrolingvistik tahrirdir: tinish belgilari, harflar, artikllar.
mnemonic: Revising = Mazmun va mantiq (Global); Editing = Imlo va punktuatsiya (Lokal).

q: Testologiyada Kronbax alfasi (Cronbach's Alpha, $\alpha$) koeffitsienti nimani o'lchaydi va standart testlar uchun uning maqbul ko'rsatkichi qanday bo'lishi kerak?
opts: O'quvchilarning kompyuter monitori oldida qancha vaqt o'tirganini; optimal qiymat $\alpha = 0.10$.
Test savollarining ichki izchilligi va bir xil konstruktni o'lchash darajasini (Internal consistency); standartlashtirilgan testlar uchun $\alpha \ge 0.70$ (yoki 0.80) bo'lishi talab etiladi.
Test blankalarining oqlik darajasi va qog'oz zichligi koeffitsientini.
Imtihon zalidagi harorat va shamollatish tezligini.
explanation: Cronbach's Alpha — testning ichki izchilligini (ishonchliligini) tekshiruvchi asosiy statistik metrika. 0.70 dan past bo'lsa test savollari bir-biriga mantiqan mos kelmasligini bildiradi.
mnemonic: Cronbach Alpha $\ge 0.70$ = Testning ichki ishonchliligi va muvofiqligi a'lo darajada.

q: 50 ta savoldan iborat testning ishonchliligini tekshirish uchun o'qituvchi testni toq (1, 3, 5...) va juft (2, 4, 6...) raqamli savollarga ajratib, har bir o'quvchining toq va juft savollar bo'yicha olgan ballari o'rtasidagi korrelyatsiyani hisobladi. Bu usul qanday nomlanadi?
opts: Faktorli tahlil — yangi o'zgaruvchilarni kashf etish.
Test-retest usuli — bir necha haftadan keyin qayta o'tkazish.
Split-Half ishonchliligini tekshirish usuli (Yarimga bo'lish orqali ichki muvofiqlikni baholash).
Tasodifiy lotereya usuli.
explanation: Split-Half Reliability bitta testni ikkita teng yarimga (odatda toq va juft savollar) bo'lib, o'quvchining har ikki yarimdagi ballari korrelyatsiyasini (Spearman-Brown formulasi bilan) aniqlaydi.
mnemonic: Split-Half = Testni toq/juft savollarga bo'lib, o'zaro solishtirish.

q: Jasur yozish darsida 'Product Approach' (Tayyor mahsulotga asoslangan yondashuv) bilan 'Genre Approach' (Janrli yondashuv) o'rtasidagi farqni tahlil qilmoqda. Janrli yondashuvning (Genre Approach - Swales, Martin) eng asosiy markaziy xususiyati nimada?
opts: Faqat namunaviy matnni mexanik tarzda so'zma-so'z ko'chirib yozish
Matnning ijtimoiy maqsadi (social purpose), auditoriyasi (target audience) va shu janrga xos ritorik harakatlar (rhetorical moves / conventions)ni tahlil qilib, kontekstga mos matn yaratish
Yozma ishda faqat passiv nisbatdagi gaplarni ishlatish majburiyati
O'quvchiga har qanday qoidalardan xoli erkin she'r yozdirish
explanation: Genre Approach (John Swales) matnni ijtimoiy muloqot vositasi deb qaraydi. Har bir janrning (masalan: ariza, ilmiy maqola, shikoyat xati) o'ziga xos ritorik bosqichlari (rhetorical moves) va auditoriya bilan muloqot qilish qoidalari bo'ladi.
mnemonic: Genre Approach = Ijtimoiy maqsad + Auditoriya + Ritorik harakatlar (Moves).

q: Shahnoza o'quvchilar yozgan insholarni baholashda 'Peer Review' (Tengdoshlar taqrizi) bosqichini kiritdi. O'quvchilar bir-birlarining ishiga baho berishda shunchaki 'yaxshi' yoki 'yomon' demasdan, sifatli tahlil qilishlari uchun o'qituvchi ularga nima berishi shart?
opts: Darslikdagi barcha grammatik qoidalar kitobi
Qizil qalam va jazo daftarchasi
Aniq mezonlarga asoslangan yo'riqnoma va savolnomalar (Peer review checklist / guided rubric)
Faqat lug'at kitoblari
explanation: Peer Review muvaffaqiyati aniq yo'naltiruvchi rubrika va cheklistlarga (Checklist) bog'liq. Cheklist bo'lmasa o'quvchilar nima qilishni bilmay, faqat shaxsiy munosabat yoki mayda imlo xatolariga chalg'ib ketadilar.
mnemonic: Peer Review = Aniq mezonli cheklist (Checklist & Rubric) bilan samarali.

q: Bobur insholarni tekshirganda 'Revising' (Qayta ishlash) va 'Editing' (Tahrirlash) bosqichlarining mohiyatini o'quvchilarga ajratib bermoqchi. Ushbu ikki bosqich qanday farqlanadi?
opts: Revising o'qituvchi tomonidan, Editing esa direktor tomonidan qilinadi
Revising faqat imlo xatolarini tekshiradi, Editing esa butun inshoni o'chirib qayta yozdiradi
Bu ikkisi mutlaqo bir xil jarayon bo'lib, hech qanday farqi yo'q
Revising — matnning mazmuni, mantiqiy tuzilishi, g'oyalari va abzatslar ketma-ketligini qayta ko'rib chiqish; Editing esa imlo, punktuatsiya va grammatik aniqlikni tuzatishdir
explanation: Revising (Re-vision = qayta tasavvur qilish) global darajada ishlaydi: g'oyalar to'liqmi, dalillar yetarlimi, mantiq bormi? Editing esa lokal mikrolingvistik tahrirdir: tinish belgilari, harflar, artikllar.
mnemonic: Revising = Mazmun va mantiq (Global); Editing = Imlo va punktuatsiya (Lokal).

q: A colleague approaches a grieving co-worker and whispers: *"I was deeply saddened to hear of your father’s passing."* Under Searle’s taxonomy, which speech act is realized?
opts: A declaration, which legally invalidates the deceased father's financial estate.
A directive, commanding the co-worker to complete bereavement counseling within thirty days.
An expressive, conveying empathy and sympathy regarding a presupposed tragic event.
A commissive, guaranteeing that the speaker will inherit the vacant family residence.
explanation: Condolences and expressions of sympathy are expressives: they convey the speaker's emotional state regarding a presupposed state of affairs, with no direction of fit.
mnemonic: Condolences = Expressives (sharing grief/empathy; presupposed sorrowful reality).

q: Test-retest ishonchliligi usulida bitta test ma'lum vaqt oralig'ida (masalan, 2 haftadan keyin) xuddi shu o'quvchilar guruhiga qayta topshirtiriladi. Ushbu usulning asosiy maqsadi nima?
opts: Ikkinchi safar barcha o'quvchilarga avtomatik tarzda 100 ball qo'yish.
O'quvchilarning test savollarini yodlab olganligini tekshirish.
O'qituvchining imtihon o'tkazish tezligini oshirish.
Test natijalarining vaqt o'tishi bilan qanchalik barqaror va o'zgarmasligini (Stability over time) aniqlash.
explanation: Test-Retest barqarorlikni tekshiradi: agar oraliqda maxsus yangi dars o'tilmagan bo'lsa, o'quvchining olgan bali birinchi va ikkinchi safar deyarli bir xil chiqishi kerak.
mnemonic: Test-Retest = Vaqt o'tishi bilan natijalar barqarorligi (Stability).

q: Umida insho yozish darsida 'Process Writing' (Jarayonli yozuv) modelini qo'llamoqda. Ushbu yondashuvda yozish bosqichlarining eng to'g'ri va ilmiy ketma-ketligi qaysi javobda ko'rsatilgan?
opts: Pre-writing (Brainstorming / G'oyalar to'plash) -> Outlining (Reja tuzish) -> Drafting (Dastlabki qoralama) -> Peer Review (Tengdoshlar taqrizi) -> Revising (Mazmuniy qayta ishlash) -> Editing (Grammatik va imloviy tahrir) -> Publishing (Yakuniy nashr)
Drafting -> Publishing -> Brainstorming -> Grammar test
Grammar rules explanation -> Dictation -> Final examination
Memorizing a model essay -> Reproduction from memory -> Grading
explanation: Process Writing yozishni bir martalik natija (product) emas, balki ko'p bosqichli dinamik jarayon deb biladi: Brainstorming -> Drafting -> Peer review -> Revising (mazmunni boyitish) -> Editing (imlo va grammatika) -> Publishing.
mnemonic: Process Writing: G'oya -> Qoralama -> Fikr almashish -> Qayta ishlash -> Tahrir -> Nashr.

q: Maktab bitiruvchilarining ingliz tili yakuniy attestatsiya testi natijalari ularning kelgusida xorijiy universitetlarda muvaffaqiyatli tahsil olishini 90% aniqlik bilan to'g'ri ko'rsatib berdi. Ushbu test qaysi validlik turiga ega?
opts: Bashoratli validlik (Predictive Validity) — test natijalarining o'quvchining kelajakdagi real faoliyati yoki muvaffaqiyatini oldindan to'g'ri bashorat qila olish qobiliyati.
Yuzaki validlik (Face Validity) — test varag'ining tashqi chiroyli dizayni.
Retrospektiv xatolik — o'tmishdagi xatolarni qayta hisoblash.
Standartlashtirilgan disbalans.
explanation: Bashoratli validlik (Predictive validity) — mezonli validlikning bir turi bo'lib, test ballari kelajakdagi aniq amaliy natijalar (universitetda o'qish, ishga joylashish) bilan yuqori korrelyatsiyada bo'lishini bildiradi.
mnemonic: Bashoratli validlik = Test kelajakdagi muvaffaqiyatni oldindan aniq ko'rsatib beradi.

q: Tibbiyot yo'nalishidagi kasb-hunar maktabi o'quvchilari uchun tuzilgan ingliz tili testida barcha matnlar bolalar multfilmlari haqida bo'lsa va unda birorta ham tibbiy yoki ilmiy mavzu uchramasa, ushbu test qaysi jihatdan oqsagan hisoblanadi?
opts: Ishonchlilik koeffitsienti noldan past bo'lganligi.
Yuzaki validlik (Face Validity) — test topshiruvchilar va jamoatchilik nazarida test o'z maqsadiga va kasbiy kontekstiga mos deb qabul qilinmasligi.
Test savollarining barchasi grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri ekanligi.
Test blankalarining rangli printerda chiqarilmaganligi.
explanation: Face validity (Yuzaki validlik) — bu testning tashqi ko'rinishi va mavzusi topshiruvchiga mantiqiy va o'rinli ko'rinishi. Bo'lajak hamshiraga multfilm testi berilsa, uning testga jiddiyligi va motivatsiyasi tushib ketadi.
mnemonic: Yuzaki validlik (Face validity) = Test tashqaridan qaraganda ham o'z maqsadiga jiddiy va mos ko'rinishi shart.

q: Summativ nazorat ishidan so'ng o'quvchi o'ziga qo'yilgan ball bilan rozi bo'lmasdan, rubrika mezonlariga tayanib asosli e'tiroz bildirdi. Kasbiy standart va pedagogik etika bo'yicha o'qituvchining eng to'g'ri harakati qaysi?
opts: O'quvchining e'tirozi uchun uning choraklik bahosini yana bitta ballga pasaytirib jazolash.
O'quvchini sinfdan haydab chiqarish va 'menga e'tiroz bildirishga qanday hadding sig'di' deb baqirish.

O'quvchining ishini uning ishtirokida rubrika mezonlari asosida xotirjam va bafurja qayta ko'rib chiqish, baholash asoslarini tushuntirish va agar baholashda nohaqlik bo'lsa, xatoni tan olib ballni to'g'rilash.
O'quvchining ota-onasini chaqirib, bolaning intizomi ustidan shikoyat qilish.
explanation: Apellyatsiya va shaffoflik — zamonaviy baholashning uzviy qismi. Professional o'qituvchi o'quvchi bilan rubrika asosida ishni ochiq ko'rib chiqadi, o'z bahosini dalillar bilan asoslaydi yoki texnik xatosini to'g'rilaydi.
mnemonic: Apellyatsiya madaniyati = Rubrika bilan birga xotirjam ko'rib chiqish va adolatni ta'minlash.

mnemonic: Peer Review = Aniq mezonli cheklist (Checklist & Rubric) bilan samarali.

q: Testologiya bo'yicha xalqaro standartlarda ko'p tanlovli savollarda "Yuqoridagilarning barchasi to'g'ri" (All of the above) variantidan foydalanish nima uchun tavsiya etilmaydi?
opts: Chunki bunday variantlar faqat magistratura imtihonlarida ruxsat etiladi.
Chunki bu ibora ingliz tili qoidalariga mutlaqo ziddir.
Chunki barcha test dasturlari bu iborani ko'rganda avtomatik o'chib qoladi.
Chunki o'quvchi variantlardan faqat ikkitasining to'g'riligini bilsa ham, uchinchi variantni o'qimasdanoq osonlik bilan 'barchasi'ni tanlab, savolning diskriminativ kuchini pasaytiradi.
explanation: "All of the above" testi zaiflashtiradi: o'quvchi qolgan variantlarni to'liq bilmasa ham, 2 ta to'g'rini ko'rishi bilan mantiqiy taxmin qilib qo'yadi. Shu bois zamonaviy testologiya bu variantdan voz kechishni talab qiladi.
mnemonic: 'All of the above' varianti savolning tahliliy qiymatini pasaytiradi (qo'llash tavsiya etilmaydi).

q: After a novice presenter drops all his index cards and fumbles through slides, an audience member murmurs: *"Well, that was a dazzling display of professional poise."* Pragmatically, how does this speech act function?
opts: The utterance is a pure directive compelling the presenter to reprint the fallen index cards.
The speaker executes an unassailable constative assertive that validates the presenter for tenure.
The utterance functions as an explicit performative declaring the presenter an honorary laureate.
The superficial expressive praise is subverted by ironical flouting of Quality, achieving a primary illocutionary act of severe negative critique.
explanation: Superficially formatted as an expressive compliment, the glaring conflict with observable reality flouts Grice's Maxim of Quality, producing an indirect speech act: a cutting evaluation/criticism (primary illocution).
mnemonic: Sarcastic compliment: Surface expressive inverted into a biting critique.

q:
Read the passage:
"Scobie sat in his damp police office in Freetown, listening to the relentless drumming of the monsoon rain upon the corrugated tin roof. In the tropics, he thought, pity was the most corrupting of all human passions. It was pity that had led him to borrow money from the Syrian merchant Yusef; pity that had bound him to his unhappy, self-pitying wife Louise; pity that had lured him into an adulterous liaison with the shipwrecked widow Helen. A Catholic knows when he is entering damnation: it does not arrive with a thunderclap, but with a series of gentle, merciful compromises, each undertaken to prevent another human being from suffering. As he locked the compromising contraband diamonds inside his desk drawer, he realized that in attempting to save everyone, he had damned himself beyond redemption."

What paradoxical moral insight forms the central theme of Scobie’s dilemma?
opts: Excessive pity and the desire to spare others suffering can become a corrupting path to moral self-destruction.
Greed for financial wealth is the only genuine source of criminal corruption in colonial governance.
A police officer should always prioritize personal romantic desires over professional loyalty.
Living in a tropical climate automatically cleanses an individual of Christian theological guilt.
explanation: Greene's trademark theme: Scobie's downfall is not cruelty or greed, but pity—an agonizing, self-destructive urge to prevent others from crying that drags him into corruption and damnation.
options: Excessive pity and the desire to spare others suffering can become a corrupting path to moral self-destruction.

q: Nodira insho yozish darsida 'Process Writing' (Jarayonli yozuv) modelini qo'llamoqda. Ushbu yondashuvda yozish bosqichlarining eng to'g'ri va ilmiy ketma-ketligi qaysi javobda ko'rsatilgan?
opts: Pre-writing (Brainstorming / G'oyalar to'plash) -> Outlining (Reja tuzish) -> Drafting (Dastlabki qoralama) -> Peer Review (Tengdoshlar taqrizi) -> Revising (Mazmuniy qayta ishlash) -> Editing (Grammatik va imloviy tahrir) -> Publishing (Yakuniy nashr)
Drafting -> Publishing -> Brainstorming -> Grammar test
Grammar rules explanation -> Dictation -> Final examination
Memorizing a model essay -> Reproduction from memory -> Grading
explanation: Process Writing yozishni bir martalik natija (product) emas, balki ko'p bosqichli dinamik jarayon deb biladi: Brainstorming -> Drafting -> Peer review -> Revising (mazmunni boyitish) -> Editing (imlo va grammatika) -> Publishing.
mnemonic: Process Writing: G'oya -> Qoralama -> Fikr almashish -> Qayta ishlash -> Tahrir -> Nashr.

q: Bekzod yozish darsida 'Product Approach' (Tayyor mahsulotga asoslangan yondashuv) bilan 'Genre Approach' (Janrli yondashuv) o'rtasidagi farqni tahlil qilmoqda. Janrli yondashuvning (Genre Approach - Swales, Martin) eng asosiy markaziy xususiyati nimada?
opts: Faqat namunaviy matnni mexanik tarzda so'zma-so'z ko'chirib yozish
Matnning ijtimoiy maqsadi (social purpose), auditoriyasi (target audience) va shu janrga xos ritorik harakatlar (rhetorical moves / conventions)ni tahlil qilib, kontekstga mos matn yaratish
Yozma ishda faqat passiv nisbatdagi gaplarni ishlatish majburiyati
O'quvchiga har qanday qoidalardan xoli erkin she'r yozdirish
explanation: Genre Approach (John Swales) matnni ijtimoiy muloqot vositasi deb qaraydi. Har bir janrning (masalan: ariza, ilmiy maqola, shikoyat xati) o'ziga xos ritorik bosqichlari (rhetorical moves) va auditoriya bilan muloqot qilish qoidalari bo'ladi.
mnemonic: Genre Approach = Ijtimoiy maqsad + Auditoriya + Ritorik harakatlar (Moves).

opts: O'quvchi bitta mavzu bo'yicha birinchi sherigiga 4 daqiqa, ikkinchi sherigiga 3 daqiqa, uchinchi sherigiga esa 2 daqiqa ichida xuddi shu ma'lumotni yetkazib berishi kerak; vaqt qisqargani sari nutq tezligi va ravonligi ortadi
O'quvchi 4 ta yangi so'z yodlaydi, 3 ta gap tuzadi va 2 ta savolga javob beradi

mnemonic: 4/3/2 Texnikasi = 4 daq -> 3 daq -> 2 daq (Mavzu bitta, sherik yangi, tezlik yuqori).

q: Jamshid munozarali mavzuni butun sinf bilan muhokama qilish uchun 'Fishbowl' (Akvarium) munozara metodini tashkil etdi. Ushbu metod qanday amalga oshiriladi?
opts: O'quvchilar akvariumdagi baliqlar haqida insho yozadilar

Sinf markazida kichik guruh (ichki doira) faol bahs olib boradi, qolgan barcha o'quvchilar (tashqi doira) ularni diqqat bilan kuzatib, tahlil qilib boradi va xohlovchilar ichki doiradagi bo'sh stulga o'tirib munozaraga qo'shiladi
O'qituvchi barcha savollarga o'zi javob beradi, o'quvchilar esa jim o'tiradilar
O'quvchilar guruhlarga bo'linmasdan faqat juftlikda yozma test yechadilar
explanation: Fishbowl metodi — ichki doiradagi faol ishtirokchilar muloqotini tashqi doiradagi kuzatuvchilar tahlil qilishi va erkin almashinuvi orqali butun sinfni faollashtiruvchi ajoyib interaktiv muhokama shaklidir.
mnemonic: Fishbowl = Ichki doira (Akvarium) bahslashadi + Tashqi doira kuzatadi va qo'shiladi.

q:
Read the passage:
"For the first three billion years of life on Earth, the biosphere was dominated by microscopic prokaryotes and enigmatic, soft-bodied Ediacaran organisms. Then, approximately 541 million years ago, the fossil record registers the Cambrian Explosion: the sudden geologically synchronous emergence of virtually all modern animal phyla featuring mineralized exoskeletons, compound optical eyes, and active predatory lifestyles. While once dismissed by creationists as a flaw in evolutionary gradualism, geochemical proxies suggest this morphological diversification was unbottlenecked by a steep surge in oceanic oxygenation and calcium saturation, which unlocked the high-metabolism threshold necessary for carnivory and biomineralized shell construction."

What ecological lifestyle became viable only after the oxygenation threshold was crossed?
explanation: High-energy cellular metabolism supported by oxygen 'unlocked the high-metabolism threshold necessary for carnivory and biomineralized shell construction'.

q: Shahnoza o'quvchilarning og'zaki suhbat jarayonida 'Turn-taking' (Navbat bilan so'zlash) va 'Backchanneling' (Tinglovchi replikalari: Uh-huh, Really?, I see, Wow!) vositalaridan to'g'ri foydalanishini ta'minlamoqda. Ushbu vositalar nutqda qanday vazifani bajaradi?
opts: O'quvchining so'z boyligi yo'qligini yashirish vositasidir
Suhbatdoshning gapini qo'pollik bilan bo'lish uchun xizmat qiladi
Muloqotning tabiiy oqimini ta'minlaydi, suhbatdoshni diqqat bilan eshitayotganini bildiradi va muloqotni interaktiv hamkorlikka aylantiradi
Faqat imtihonda baland ball olish uchun sun'iy usuldir
explanation: Backchanneling (Really? Right, Exactly) va Turn-taking so'zlovchiga eshitilayotganini tasdiqlovchi va muloqotni jonli ushlab turuvchi pragmatik nutq mexanizmlaridir.
mnemonic: Backchanneling = 'Uh-huh, I see, Really?' orqali muloqotni qo'llab-quvvatlash.

q: Bobur o'quvchilarda qiyin ijtimoiy muammolar bo'yicha konsensusga erishish ko'nikmasini shakllantirish uchun 'Pyramid Discussion' (Piramida / Snowball) usulini tanladi. Ushbu usulda o'quvchilar qanday guruhlanadi?
opts: O'qituvchi o'quvchilarga o'z qarorini majburlab qabul qildiradi
Butun sinf bir vaqtda qichqirib gapiradi
Faqat a'lochi o'quvchilar fikr bildiradi
Individual qaror -> Juftlikda muhokama -> To'rt kishilik guruhda kelishuv -> Butun sinf miqyosida umumiy konsensus
explanation: Pyramid (Snowball) munozarasi: 1 kishi -> 2 kishi -> 4 kishi -> butun sinf. Bu tuzilma eng tortinchoq o'quvchilarga ham avval juftlikda o'z fikrini sinab ko'rish va bosqichma-bosqich katta doiraga chiqish imkonini beradi.
mnemonic: Pyramid Discussion = 1 -> 2 -> 4 -> Butun sinf (Qor uyumi kabi kengayish).

q: Umida o'quvchilarda nutq tezligi, ravonlik va avtomatik gapirish ko'nikmasini rivojlantirish uchun Paul Nation tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan '4/3/2 Activity' texnikasini qo'llamoqda. Ushbu texnikaning mohiyati nimadan iborat?
opts: O'quvchi bitta mavzu bo'yicha birinchi sherigiga 4 daqiqa, ikkinchi sherigiga 3 daqiqa, uchinchi sherigiga esa 2 daqiqa ichida xuddi shu ma'lumotni yetkazib berishi kerak; vaqt qisqargani sari nutq tezligi va ravonligi ortadi
O'quvchi 4 ta yangi so'z yodlaydi, 3 ta gap tuzadi va 2 ta savolga javob beradi
Dars 4 qismga bo'linadi, 3 nafar o'quvchi gapiradi, 2 nafari baholanadi
O'quvchi 4 daqiqa o'qituvchini tinglaydi, 3 daqiqa yozadi, 2 daqiqa uxlaydi
explanation: Paul Nation'ning '4/3/2' texnikasi nutq ravonligini (fluency) oshirishning eng samarali metodidir. Takrorlanish (repetition) va vaqt chegarasining qisqarishi (time pressure) o'quvchini ikkilanmasdan, tez va avtomatlashgan ravon nutq so'zlashga majbur qiladi.
mnemonic: 4/3/2 Texnikasi = 4 daq -> 3 daq -> 2 daq (Mavzu bitta, sherik yangi, tezlik yuqori).

q: Baholash rubrikasini ishlab chiqishda darajalar tavsifi (deskriptorlar) qanday so'zlar bilan ifodalanishi professional testologiya talablariga to'g'ri keladi?
opts: Faqat bitta 'a'lo' so'zini yozib, qolgan darajalarni bo'sh qoldirish orqali.
Faqat o'qituvchining shaxsiy kayfiyatini ifodalovchi emotsional so'zlar bilan.
Noaniq va subyektiv sifatlar ('yaxshi', 'yomon', 'chiroyli') o'rniga, o'quvchining bajara oladigan aniq, kuzatiladigan va o'lchanadigan harakatlari va xatolar miqdori aks etgan aniq tavsiflar bilan.
Har bir darajaga qonun moddalarining raqamlarini keltirish orqali.
explanation: Rubrika deskriptorlarida 'yaxshi gapiradi', 'o'rtacha yozadi' kabi so'zlar subyektivlik keltirib chiqaradi. Sifatli deskriptor aniq mezonlarni ko'rsatadi: 'Nutqda 3 tadan ortiq grammatik xatoga yo'l qo'ymaydi, mavzuni to'liq ochib beradi va 5 ta tematik leksik birlikdan o'rinli foydalanadi'.
mnemonic: Rubrika deskriptori = Noaniq sifatlar ('yaxshi') emas, aniq kuzatiladigan mezonlar!

explanation: After making an honest concession ('It is undeniable that...'), the author pivots back with 'Nonetheless' to firmly reassert their core thesis with empirical evidence.
q:
Read the following passage:

"It is undeniable that market-based carbon trading schemes offer corporate polluters short-term flexibility and minimize immediate administrative compliance friction. *Nonetheless, the empirical evidence from two decades of emissions trading demonstrates unequivocally that without mandatory structural caps and direct public investments in green infrastructure, carbon markets produce little more than elaborate accounting illusions.*"

What is the discourse role of the sentence introduced by *Nonetheless*?
opts: Abandoning the author’s original environmental thesis in favor of free-market deregulation.
Reasserting the primary argumentative thesis with intensified evidentiary weight following a necessary concession.
Suggesting that corporate accounting firms should be exempt from tax filing deadlines.
Providing an entertaining anecdote about carbon brokers working on the London stock exchange.

q: Austin further subdivided the *locutionary act* into phonetic, phatic, and rhetic acts. What constitutes the *rhetic act*?
opts: The mere physiological act of vibrating the vocal cords to produce audible sounds.
The act of using the uttered expressions with a more or less definite sense and reference.
The act of producing vocables belonging to a specific vocabulary and conforming to grammatical rules.
The psychological manipulation of the listener’s nervous system during hypnosis.
explanation: Austin subdivided locution into: (1) phonetic act (producing sounds), (2) phatic act (producing words conforming to a language's grammar), and (3) rhetic act (using those words with a specific sense and reference).
mnemonic: Locution breakdown: Phonetic (sounds) -> Phatic (words/grammar) -> Rhetic (sense & reference).

opts: Sinf rahbariga oylik maoshini hisoblashda ko'maklashish.

O'quvchining kundaligiga har kuni 10 tadan qizil imzo qo'yish.

q:
Choose the sentence that correctly demonstrates extraposition of a clausal subject:

*"That quantum computers will eventually crack RSA encryption is widely accepted among cryptographers."*
opts: Cryptographers widely accept it that quantum computers will crack RSA encryption.
It is widely accepted among cryptographers that quantum computers will eventually crack RSA encryption.
There is widely accepted among cryptographers that quantum computers will crack encryption.
What is widely accepted it that quantum computers will crack RSA encryption.
explanation: Extraposition moves a heavy clausal subject ('That quantum computers will...') to the end of the sentence, replacing it with dummy 'It': 'It is widely accepted that...'.
options: Cryptographers widely accept it that quantum computers will crack RSA encryption.
It is widely accepted among cryptographers that quantum computers will eventually crack RSA encryption.
There is widely accepted among cryptographers that quantum computers will crack encryption.
What is widely accepted it that quantum computers will crack RSA encryption.
question:

*"That quantum computers will eventually crack RSA encryption is widely accepted among cryptographers."*

q: Nodira o'quvchilarda nutq tezligi, ravonlik va avtomatik gapirish ko'nikmasini rivojlantirish uchun Paul Nation tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan '4/3/2 Activity' texnikasini qo'llamoqda. Ushbu texnikaning mohiyati nimadan iborat?
opts: O'quvchi bitta mavzu bo'yicha birinchi sherigiga 4 daqiqa, ikkinchi sherigiga 3 daqiqa, uchinchi sherigiga esa 2 daqiqa ichida xuddi shu ma'lumotni yetkazib berishi kerak; vaqt qisqargani sari nutq tezligi va ravonligi ortadi

explanation: Paul Nation'ning '4/3/2' texnikasi nutq ravonligini (fluency) oshirishning eng samarali metodidir. Takrorlanish (repetition) va vaqt chegarasining qisqarishi (time pressure) o'quvchini ikkilanmasdan, tez va avtomatlashgan ravon nutq so'zlashga majbur qiladi.
mnemonic: 4/3/2 Texnikasi = 4 daq -> 3 daq -> 2 daq (Mavzu bitta, sherik yangi, tezlik yuqori).

q: If an ambassador says, *"Our government pledges to demilitarize the disputed border zone,"* while top generals are secretly mobilizing artillery battalions, what specific felicity condition has been violated?
opts: The sincerity condition, because the speaker’s government does not genuinely intend to perform the promised demilitarization.
The propositional content condition, because border demilitarization is syntactically an abstract noun phrase.
The locutionary condition, because diplomatic statements cannot contain transitive verbs.
The phonetic condition, because the ambassador spoke with a regional dialectal accent.
explanation: For a commissive (pledge, promise), the sincerity condition requires that the speaker (or the sovereign entity represented) genuinely intends to execute the committed action. Deceitful pledges violate the sincerity condition.
mnemonic: Pledge without intent to fulfill = Breach of Sincerity Condition.

opts: The internal fracturing of ancestral kinship bonds and traditional authority under the dual pressures of missionary religion and colonial governance.

q:
Read the passage:
"Okonkwo returned from his seven years of exile in Mbanta to find that the white man’s missionary church had built its compound in the Evil Forest of Umuofia, and yet the gods had not struck them dead. Worse still, the white man had brought not only a strange religion, but a court of law and an armed district commissioner to enforce it. The clan was divided against itself; fathers fought with sons who had cast aside the ancestral rites to sing the new hymns. Okonkwo’s heart mourned for the warrior clan which had so suddenly gone soft like women. As he gathered the elders in the marketplace, he raised his battle-axe, but the sound that answered him was not the fierce roar of warriors eager for battle, but a trembling murmur of panic and confusion. He knew then that Umuofia would not fight. The clan had fallen apart."

What historical tragedy is dramatized in the collapse of Umuofia’s resistance?

Excessive manufacturing costs and global shortages of synthetic petroleum.

q:
Read the passage:
"The therapeutic deployment of fragile messenger RNA (mRNA) was long obstructed by enzymatic degradation in the bloodstream and the electrostatic repulsion of cellular membranes. The breakthrough came with the engineering of ionizable lipid nanoparticles (LNPs). These microscopic vesicles encapsulate the negatively charged nucleic acid cargo, remaining neutral at physiological pH to evade renal clearance, yet acquiring a positive charge within acidic endosomes. This charge inversion disrupts the endosomal membrane, facilitating the intracellular release of intact mRNA into the cytoplasm."

What dual obstacle historically prevented the successful clinical use of mRNA therapies?

"Okonkwo returned from his seven years of exile in Mbanta to find that the white man’s missionary church had built its compound in the Evil Forest of Umuofia, and yet the gods had not struck them dead. Worse still, the white man had brought not only a strange religion, but a court of law and an armed district commissioner to enforce it. The clan was divided against itself; fathers fought with sons who had cast aside the ancestral rites to sing the new hymns. Okonkwo’s heart mourned for the warrior clan which had so suddenly gone soft like women. As he gathered the elders in the marketplace, he raised his battle-axe, but the sound that answered him was not the fierce roar of warriors eager for battle, but a trembling murmur of panic and confusion. He knew then that Umuofia would not fight. The clan had fallen apart."

Why was the survival of the church in the "Evil Forest" culturally catastrophic for the clan’s faith?
explanation: The villagers gave the church the Evil Forest expecting the spirits to kill them; when nothing happened, the psychological authority of traditional cosmology was fractured.

q: Madina o'quvchilarda nutq tezligi, ravonlik va avtomatik gapirish ko'nikmasini rivojlantirish uchun Paul Nation tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan '4/3/2 Activity' texnikasini qo'llamoqda. Ushbu texnikaning mohiyati nimadan iborat?
opts: O'quvchi bitta mavzu bo'yicha birinchi sherigiga 4 daqiqa, ikkinchi sherigiga 3 daqiqa, uchinchi sherigiga esa 2 daqiqa ichida xuddi shu ma'lumotni yetkazib berishi kerak; vaqt qisqargani sari nutq tezligi va ravonligi ortadi
O'quvchi 4 ta yangi so'z yodlaydi, 3 ta gap tuzadi va 2 ta savolga javob beradi
Dars 4 qismga bo'linadi, 3 nafar o'quvchi gapiradi, 2 nafari baholanadi
O'quvchi 4 daqiqa o'qituvchini tinglaydi, 3 daqiqa yozadi, 2 daqiqa uxlaydi
explanation: Paul Nation'ning '4/3/2' texnikasi nutq ravonligini (fluency) oshirishning eng samarali metodidir. Takrorlanish (repetition) va vaqt chegarasining qisqarishi (time pressure) o'quvchini ikkilanmasdan, tez va avtomatlashgan ravon nutq so'zlashga majbur qiladi.
mnemonic: 4/3/2 Texnikasi = 4 daq -> 3 daq -> 2 daq (Mavzu bitta, sherik yangi, tezlik yuqori).

mnemonic: Disleksiya yordami: Multimodal (Audio+Matn) + Shrift qulayligi + Qo'shimcha vaqt.

mnemonic: Fishbowl = Ichki doira (Akvarium) bahslashadi + Tashqi doira kuzatadi va qo'shiladi.

q:
Read the passage:
"Many years later, as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendía was to remember that distant afternoon when his father took him to discover ice. Macondo was then a village of twenty adobe houses built on the bank of a river of clear water that ran along a bed of polished stones, which were white and enormous, like prehistoric eggs. The world was so recent that many things lacked names, and in order to indicate them it was necessary to point. Every year in the month of March, a family of ragged gypsies would set up their tents near the village, bringing novelties that seemed supernatural: a magnetic ingot that dragged iron pots across clay floors, and an enormous magnifying glass that could set fire to dry straw. Aureliano watched these wonders with solemn eyes, already marked by the solitary destiny that would lead him through thirty-two lost wars and an infinity of unmade gold fishes."

What narrative perspective and temporal structure characterizes the famous opening of Macondo’s chronicle?
opts: A sweeping circular temporality that unifies past, present, and future in a single legendary memory.
A strict, diary-like chronological sequence advancing hour by hour from the morning of an execution.
A first-person journalistic confession recorded by a war correspondent during a military court-martial.
An unreliable narration delivered by an insane prisoner hallucinating in an underground dungeon.
explanation: Márquez achieves legendary mythic time by linking three temporal planes in one breath: future ('Many years later'), present of memory ('facing the firing squad'), and mythic primordial past ('that distant afternoon... discover ice').
mnemonic: Magical Realist Time: Past, present, and future woven together in mythic memory.

opts: It treats probability as a quantifiable degree of belief that is systematically updated as evidence emerges.
It claims that probability cannot be expressed using mathematical fractions or formulas.
It asserts that probability is an illusion and that all physical events are 100% predetermined.
It restricts probability calculations exclusively to casino roulette wheels and coin tosses.
explanation: Frequentists view probability as long-run frequency in infinite trials; Bayesians define it as a rational 'degree of belief' updated via Bayes' rule upon observing new data.
q:
Read the passage:
"Classical frequentist statistics defines probability strictly as the limit of relative frequency in infinite repeated trials, rejecting the notion of assigning probabilities to unique historical events or scientific hypotheses. Bayesian epistemology revolutionizes this framework by conceptualizing probability as a subjective degree of belief that is rationally updated in the light of novel empirical evidence. Governed by Bayes' theorem, an agent begins with a prior probability distribution, assesses the likelihood of observed data given competing hypotheses, and computes a posterior probability. Far from subjective whim, Bayesianism establishes a mathematically rigorous normative model for how scientific consensus should rationally converge as empirical evidence accumulates."

How does Bayesian epistemology redefine the concept of probability compared to classical frequentism?
options: It treats probability as a quantifiable degree of belief that is systematically updated as evidence emerges.
It claims that probability cannot be expressed using mathematical fractions or formulas.
It asserts that probability is an illusion and that all physical events are 100% predetermined.
It restricts probability calculations exclusively to casino roulette wheels and coin tosses.

"Classical frequentist statistics defines probability strictly as the limit of relative frequency in infinite repeated trials, rejecting the notion of assigning probabilities to unique historical events or scientific hypotheses. Governed by Bayes' theorem, an agent begins with a prior probability distribution, assesses the likelihood of observed data given competing hypotheses, and computes a posterior probability. Far from subjective whim, Bayesianism establishes a mathematically rigorous normative model for how scientific consensus should rationally converge as empirical evidence accumulates."

How does Bayesian epistemology redefine the concept of probability compared to classical frequentism?

q:
Read the passage:
"Many years later, as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendía was to remember that distant afternoon when his father took him to discover ice. Macondo was then a village of twenty adobe houses built on the bank of a river of clear water that ran along a bed of polished stones, which were white and enormous, like prehistoric eggs. The world was so recent that many things lacked names, and in order to indicate them it was necessary to point. Every year in the month of March, a family of ragged gypsies would set up their tents near the village, bringing novelties that seemed supernatural: a magnetic ingot that dragged iron pots across clay floors, and an enormous magnifying glass that could set fire to dry straw. Aureliano watched these wonders with solemn eyes, already marked by the solitary destiny that would lead him through thirty-two lost wars and an infinity of unmade gold fishes."

How does the author evoke the primordial innocence of the village of Macondo in its origins?
explanation: The description of white stones 'like prehistoric eggs' and a world so young 'many things lacked names' evokes Edenic, Genesis-like primordial simplicity.
mnemonic: Mythic Eden: Stones like prehistoric eggs and things so new they lacked names.

explanation: Bayes' theorem is the mathematical engine that takes a 'prior probability', weighs the 'likelihood of observed data', and calculates the 'posterior probability'.
opts: It proves that all scientific hypotheses are equally valid regardless of empirical evidence.
It provides a normative mathematical calculus for updating hypotheses from prior beliefs to posterior probabilities.
It eliminates the need to conduct laboratory experiments or observational trials.
It guarantees that a scientist's initial personal biases will never change.
q:
Read the passage:
"Classical frequentist statistics defines probability strictly as the limit of relative frequency in infinite repeated trials, rejecting the notion of assigning probabilities to unique historical events or scientific hypotheses. Bayesian epistemology revolutionizes this framework by conceptualizing probability as a subjective degree of belief that is rationally updated in the light of novel empirical evidence. Governed by Bayes' theorem, an agent begins with a prior probability distribution, assesses the likelihood of observed data given competing hypotheses, and computes a posterior probability. Far from subjective whim, Bayesianism establishes a mathematically rigorous normative model for how scientific consensus should rationally converge as empirical evidence accumulates."

What role does Bayes' theorem perform in scientific reasoning, according to the passage?
options: It proves that all scientific hypotheses are equally valid regardless of empirical evidence.
It provides a normative mathematical calculus for updating hypotheses from prior beliefs to posterior probabilities.
It eliminates the need to conduct laboratory experiments or observational trials.
It guarantees that a scientist's initial personal biases will never change.

q:
Read the passage:
"Many years later, as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendía was to remember that distant afternoon when his father took him to discover ice. Macondo was then a village of twenty adobe houses built on the bank of a river of clear water that ran along a bed of polished stones, which were white and enormous, like prehistoric eggs. The world was so recent that many things lacked names, and in order to indicate them it was necessary to point. Every year in the month of March, a family of ragged gypsies would set up their tents near the village, bringing novelties that seemed supernatural: a magnetic ingot that dragged iron pots across clay floors, and an enormous magnifying glass that could set fire to dry straw. Aureliano watched these wonders with solemn eyes, already marked by the solitary destiny that would lead him through thirty-two lost wars and an infinity of unmade gold fishes."

What is the thematic significance of the "thirty-two lost wars and an infinity of unmade gold fishes"?
explanation: The repetitive loop of 32 lost wars and making/melting gold fishes symbolizes the core theme of Macondo: circular, Sisyphean solitude and futility.
mnemonic: Solitude Theme: 32 lost wars and melted gold fish = circular, futile obsession.

q: During a ship christening ceremony, an unauthorized prankster runs onto the dock, smashes a bottle against the hull, and shouts: *"I name this ship the Flying Dutchman!"* Why is this christening legally and pragmatically invalid?
opts: A flaw in preparatory execution and authority (Austin’s A conditions), rendering the performative an absolute misfire.
An abuse of the sincerity condition, because the prankster privately intended to buy the ship.
A failure of perlocutionary acoustics, because the shipyard workers failed to applaud.
A violation of the Maxim of Manner, because 'Flying Dutchman' is a mythological idiom.
explanation: Austin's Condition A states that there must exist an accepted conventional procedure having a conventional effect, and the particular persons in a given case must be appropriate for the invocation. A prankster lacks legal authorization to name a vessel, making the act a complete misfire.
mnemonic: Unauthorized person executing ceremony = Austinian Misfire (Condition A breach).

q:
Read the passage:
"Algorithmic curation on digital platforms optimizes user engagement by prioritizing hyper-partisan and emotionally provocative content over nuanced analysis. explanation: In magical realism, the ordinary (ice, magnets) is treated as miraculous magic, while the truly supernatural is treated as mundane fact.
q:
Read the passage:
"Many years later, as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendía was to remember that distant afternoon when his father took him to discover ice. Macondo was then a village of twenty adobe houses built on the bank of a river of clear water that ran along a bed of polished stones, which were white and enormous, like prehistoric eggs. The world was so recent that many things lacked names, and in order to indicate them it was necessary to point. Every year in the month of March, a family of ragged gypsies would set up their tents near the village, bringing novelties that seemed supernatural: a magnetic ingot that dragged iron pots across clay floors, and an enormous magnifying glass that could set fire to dry straw. Aureliano watched these wonders with solemn eyes, already marked by the solitary destiny that would lead him through thirty-two lost wars and an infinity of unmade gold fishes."

Dangerous technological curses that must be destroyed by church authorities.
Boring industrial tools that have zero aesthetic or emotional significance.
Awe-inspiring supernatural wonders, blurring the boundary between everyday science and ancient magic.

q: In pragmatic psycholinguistics, why do native speakers process *"Can you pass the salt?"* as a request almost as rapidly as a direct imperative?
opts: Because all indirect speech acts are eliminated from cognitive grammar during early childhood.
Because the word 'salt' activates the physical motor reflex of the hearer's forearm automatically.
Because native speakers do not understand the modal semantics of physical capability.
Because conventionalized indirect speech acts have developed standardized pragmatic idiomaticity, bypassing extensive inferential chains in everyday context.
explanation: Conventionalized indirect requests (*Can you pass...*, *Could you open...*) are pragmatic idioms: hearers process the primary directive force directly without having to laboriously compute secondary literal meaning and Gricean implicatures from scratch.
mnemonic: Conventional indirect speech acts function as pragmatic idioms for rapid comprehension.

opts: The initial hunch held by a researcher prior to conducting any experiments.

explanation: 'Posterior probability' is the updated probability assigned to a hypothesis AFTER new data is evaluated through the likelihood function.
q:
Read the passage:
"Classical frequentist statistics defines probability strictly as the limit of relative frequency in infinite repeated trials, rejecting the notion of assigning probabilities to unique historical events or scientific hypotheses. Bayesian epistemology revolutionizes this framework by conceptualizing probability as a subjective degree of belief that is rationally updated in the light of novel empirical evidence. Governed by Bayes' theorem, an agent begins with a prior probability distribution, assesses the likelihood of observed data given competing hypotheses, and computes a posterior probability. Far from subjective whim, Bayesianism establishes a mathematically rigorous normative model for how scientific consensus should rationally converge as empirical evidence accumulates."

In Bayesian terminology, the "posterior probability" represents:
options: The initial hunch held by a researcher prior to conducting any experiments.
The probability that an experiment was performed using counterfeit laboratory equipment.
The historical date on which a scientific paper was formally published.
The revised probability of a hypothesis calculated after taking new observational evidence into account.

q:
Read the passage:
"While battery electric vehicles provide an elegant decarbonization vector for light passenger transit, heavy industrial sectors—including metallurgical steel smelting, long-haul maritime shipping, and aviation—demand energy densities far exceeding current electrochemical storage. Green hydrogen, produced via the electrolysis of water utilizing surplus renewable electricity, offers the indispensable molecular feedstock to bridge this gap. Proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzers split water into hydrogen and oxygen with zero operational carbon emissions. The primary hurdle to commercial parity remains the Levelized Cost of Hydrogen (LCOH), driven by the high capital expenditure of noble metal catalysts like iridium and platinum, alongside intermittent renewable grid capacity factors."

Why cannot battery electric storage completely replace fossil fuels in heavy industry and aviation?
opts: Batteries possess insufficient energy density by weight and volume to power energy-intensive heavy transport and steel smelting.
Electric batteries instantly explode when exposed to atmospheric humidity above sea level.
International aviation treaties legally prohibit aircraft from utilizing rechargeable lithium cells.
Battery manufacturing produces more greenhouse gas than burning coal in power plants.
explanation: The text explains heavy industry (steel, maritime shipping, aviation) demands 'energy densities far exceeding current electrochemical storage' (batteries are too heavy/bulky).
options: Batteries possess insufficient energy density by weight and volume to power energy-intensive heavy transport and steel smelting.

q: Why do Searle’s *declarations* uniquely require extralinguistic institutions (with rare exceptions like supernatural performatives)?
opts: Because changing institutional reality (e.g. marrying, declaring war, sentencing) requires socially recognized positions of authority and codified legal frameworks.
Because the English language lacks grammatical verbs capable of describing legal transactions.
Because declarations are the only speech acts that do not produce audible sound waves in physical space.
Because ancient Roman law forbade individuals from making private promises without notarization.
explanation: Except in extraordinary cases (such as supernatural decrees or naming an invented entity), declarations require an extralinguistic institution (church, law, state, sports federation) that confers the authority to alter reality through speech.
mnemonic: Declarations need extralinguistic institutions (legal, judicial, religious authority).
