Syllable-timed (Bo'g'inga asoslangan ritm — har bir bo'g'in deyarli teng vaqt oladi)

opts: Lablangan /uː/
Diftong /aɪ/
Cho'ziq /iː/
Schwa /ə/ (Neytral, kuchsiz va reduksiyaga uchragan unli tovush)
explanation: Schwa /ə/ — ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p uchraydigan tovush bo'lib, barcha urg'usiz va kuchsiz bo'g'inlardagi unlilarning reduksiyasi natijasida hosil bo'ladi. U ingliz tili ritmining yuragidir.
mnemonic: Schwa /ə/ = Urg'usiz kuchsiz bo'g'inlar qiroli; ingliz nutq ritmining asosi.

mnemonic: Mazmun differensiatsiyasi (Content) = Bitta mavzuni turli murakkablikdagi manbalar bilan berish.

q: What was the core claim of the *Performative Hypothesis* advocated in 1970s Generative Semantics (e.g., Ross, Sadock)?
opts: All human languages evolved exclusively from theatrical scripts performed in ancient amphitheatres.
Every deep semantic structure of a sentence contains an implicit matrix clause: *"I (hereby) say/request/order you that S."*
No spoken utterance can be understood unless an explicit performative verb is visibly printed on the blackboard.
Grammar and pragmatics operate in completely separate cerebral hemispheres with zero neural connection.
explanation: The Performative Hypothesis proposed that even explicit declarative sentences like *Prices are rising* have a deep syntactic/semantic representation containing a silent higher performative clause: *[I declare to you that [Prices are rising]]*.
mnemonic: Performative Hypothesis: Silent higher performative clause *[I hereby tell you that...]* in deep structure.

q: Dilnoza o'z darsini videoga olib tahlil qilganda, 45 daqiqalik darsning qariyb 35 daqiqasida faqat o'zi gapirganini (TTT — Teacher Talking Time juda yuqoriligini) ko'rdi. Jim Scrivener tavsiyalariga ko'ra, muloqotga yo'naltirilgan zamonaviy ingliz tili darsida TTT va STT (Student Talking Time) nisbati qanday bo'lishi maqsadga muvofiq?
opts: TTT minimal (taxminan 20-30%) bo'lib, darsning asosiy qismi (70-80%) o'quvchilarning faol muloqoti va amaliy faoliyatiga (STT) ajratilishi lozim
TTT kamida 90% bo'lishi shart, chunki faqat o'qituvchi to'g'ri ingliz tilini biladi
STT umuman bo'lmasligi kerak, o'quvchilar faqat darslikdan konspekt qilishlari lozim
O'qituvchi va o'quvchilar bir vaqtda baravar baqirib gapirishlari kerak
explanation: Kommunikativ metodikada (Scrivener, Harmer) o'quvchi tilni faqat o'zi gapirib va qo'llab o'rganadi. Shuning uchun o'qituvchining monologi (TTT) qisqartirilib, o'quvchilarning nutqiy faolligi (STT) 70-80% ga yetkazilishi shart.
mnemonic: Kommunikativ dars balansi: TTT 20-30% (Fasilitator) vs STT 70-80% (Faol o'quvchi).

q: Jamshid o'quvchi har bir gapni aytgandan keyin, uning aytgan gapini so'zma-so'z butun sinfga qayta takrorlash odatiga ega (Teacher Echo). Masalan: O'quvchi: "I went to Samarkand". O'qituvchi: "Yes, I went to Samarkand, very good!". Metodik jihatdan 'Teacher Echo' nima uchun zararli hisoblanadi?

U TTT ni keraksiz ravishda sun'iy oshiradi, o'quvchilarning bir-birini eshitishini to'xtatadi va ularni faqat o'qituvchining qaytarishini kutishga o'rgatib qo'yadi

q: During a lottery draw, the announcer reaches into the drum, draws the winning ticket, but collapses unconscious before reading out the number. Under Austin's framework, what type of infelicity has occurred?
opts: A perlocutionary success, because the audience felt profound dramatic entertainment.
An abuse under Condition Gamma, because the announcer had insincere feelings toward the lottery winners.
A violation of the Maxim of Relation, because fainting is irrelevant to economic taxation.
A misexecution (non-completion) under Condition B, because the conventional procedure was not executed completely.
explanation: Austin’s Condition B.2 requires that the procedure must be executed by all participants completely. Leaving an essential step uncompleted constitutes an incomplete execution (a flaw or hitches), making the performative void.
mnemonic: Incomplete execution of procedure = Austinian Misexecution / Hitch (Condition B.2).

opts: TTT minimal (taxminan 20-30%) bo'lib, darsning asosiy qismi (70-80%) o'quvchilarning faol muloqoti va amaliy faoliyatiga (STT) ajratilishi lozim
TTT kamida 90% bo'lishi shart, chunki faqat o'qituvchi to'g'ri ingliz tilini biladi
STT umuman bo'lmasligi kerak, o'quvchilar faqat darslikdan konspekt qilishlari lozim
O'qituvchi va o'quvchilar bir vaqtda baravar baqirib gapirishlari kerak
explanation: Kommunikativ metodikada (Scrivener, Harmer) o'quvchi tilni faqat o'zi gapirib va qo'llab o'rganadi. Shuning uchun o'qituvchining monologi (TTT) qisqartirilib, o'quvchilarning nutqiy faolligi (STT) 70-80% ga yetkazilishi shart.
mnemonic: Kommunikativ dars balansi: TTT 20-30% (Fasilitator) vs STT 70-80% (Faol o'quvchi).

q: Jasur o'quvchi har bir gapni aytgandan keyin, uning aytgan gapini so'zma-so'z butun sinfga qayta takrorlash odatiga ega (Teacher Echo). Masalan: O'quvchi: "I went to Samarkand". O'qituvchi: "Yes, I went to Samarkand, very good!". Metodik jihatdan 'Teacher Echo' nima uchun zararli hisoblanadi?
opts: U o'quvchilarning eshitish qobiliyatini yaxshilaydi
U TTT ni keraksiz ravishda sun'iy oshiradi, o'quvchilarning bir-birini eshitishini to'xtatadi va ularni faqat o'qituvchining qaytarishini kutishga o'rgatib qo'yadi
U dars vaqtini tejaydi
U grammatikani tezroq yodlashga yordam beradi
explanation: Teacher Echo (o'quvchining aytganini o'qituvchi qaytarishi) — darsdagi eng zararli odatlardan biri. Bu TTT ni 2 barobar ko'paytiradi va o'quvchilar bir-birlarini tinglamay, faqat o'qituvchiga qaram bo'lib qolishiga olib keladi.
mnemonic: Teacher Echo = Ortiqcha aks-sado; STT ni o'ldiradi va o'quvchini qaram qiladi.

q: O'quv modulining yakunida o'qituvchi o'quvchilarga o'zlashtirgan bilimlarini namoyish etish uchun tanlov imkoniyatini berdi: xohlovchilar rasmiy akademik insho yozadilar, xohlovchilar qisqa video-rolik tayyorlaydilar, xohlovchilar esa interaktiv veb-sayt sahifasini loyihalashtiradilar (barchasi yagona umumiy rubrika asosida baholanadi). Bu qaysi differensiatsiyadir?
opts: Mahsulotni differensiatsiyalash (Differentiating Product) — o'rganish natijasini namoyish etish formatini o'quvchining qobiliyatlari va qiziqishlariga mos ravishda tanlash imkonini berish.
Intizomiy erkinlik berish orqali darsni nazoratsiz qoldirish.
Standartlashtirilgan ta'limni buzish va qonunsizlik.
Faqat iqtidorli o'quvchilarga imtiyoz berish.
explanation: Mahsulotni differensiyalash (Product) — o'quvchi nimani o'rganganini ko'rsatuvchi yakuniy hisobot formatini tanlash erkinligidir (insho, podkast, poster, video). Bunda barcha mahsulotlar bitta umumiy sifat rubrikasiga javob berishi shart.
mnemonic: Mahsulot differensiatsiyasi (Product) = Natijani ko'rsatish formatini tanlash erkinligi.

q: Shahnoza 5-sinf o'quvchilariga topshiriq tushuntirishda juda murakkab, uzun va tushunarsiz iboralarni ishlatdi. O'qituvchi o'z nutqini o'quvchilarning yosh va til darajasiga moslashtirishi (Grading language) qanday bo'lishi kerak?
opts: Faqat o'zbek tilida gapirish
Bolalar tiliga taqlid qilib, grammatikasi buzilgan so'zlarni ishlatish
Sodda, aniq, qisqa jumlalar ishlatish, paralingvistik vositalar (imo-ishora, vizual materiallar) bilan boyitish, ammo tilning tabiiy grammatik tuzilishini buzmaslik (Roughly-tuned input)
Faqat universitet darajasidagi ilmiy iboralar bilan muloqot qilish
explanation: Teacher Talk'da 'Grading language' — bu o'quvchilar darajasiga moslab nutqni soddalashtirish (Roughly-tuned input). Bu sun'iy 'pidgin' tilda gapirish emas, balki aniq artikulyatsiya va tushunarli sintaksis qo'llashdir.
mnemonic: Grading language = Aniq, sodda va tabiiy til (Roughly-tuned input).

q: Bobur o'quvchilarga topshiriq ko'rsatmasini bergandan so'ng, ularning ko'rsatmani tushunganligini tekshirish uchun 'Do you understand?' deb so'radi. Barcha o'quvchilar bir ovozdan 'Yes' deyishdi, ammo ishni boshlaganda hamma boshqa-boshqa narsani qila boshladi. Scrivener tavsiyasiga ko'ra o'qituvchi nima qilishi kerak edi?
opts: O'quvchilarga o'z xohlagan ishini qilishga ruxsat berishi kerak edi
Topshiriqni bekor qilib, barchaga '2' baho qo'yishi kerak edi
Ko'rsatmani o'zbek tilida 5 marta baland ovozda baqirib o'qishi kerak edi
ICQs (Instruction Checking Questions — Ko'rsatmani tekshiruvchi aniq savollar) berishi kerak edi (masalan: 'Yolg'iz ishlaysizmi yoki juftlikdami?', 'Necha daqiqa vaqtingiz bor?')
explanation: 'Do you understand?' degan savol o'qituvchiga hech qanday foydali ma'lumot bermaydi (o'quvchilar uyalganidan 'Yes' deydi). Buning o'rniga aniq ICQs (Instruction Checking Questions) berilishi shart.
mnemonic: ICQs = 'Do you understand?' emas, aniq topshiriq savollari (Vaqt? Sherik? Maqsad?).

q: O'qituvchi sinf xonasini shunday tashkil etdiki, unda sokin yolg'iz ishlash burchagi, jamoaviy bahs-munozara stoli va ko'rgazmali materiallar bilan jihozlangan amaliy maydon mavjud. O'quvchilar o'zlarining ruhiy holati va vazifasiga qarab joy tanlaydilar. Bu nima deb ataladi?
opts: Sinf mebellarini qonunsiz ko'chirish intizomsizligi.
O'quv muhitini differensiatsiyalash (Differentiating Learning Environment) — xonaning jismoniy va psixologik sharoitini o'quvchilarning turli ehtiyojlariga mos moslashtirish.
Faqat san'at darslari uchun ruxsat berilgan maxsus bezatish.
O'qituvchining dars o'tishdan bosh tortishi.
explanation: O'quv muhitini differensiyalash (Learning Environment) — sinf xonasidagi yorug'lik, sokinlik, harakatlanish imkoniyati va qulaylikni har xil idrok ehtiyojiga ega o'quvchilarga moslashuvchan qilishdir.
mnemonic: Muhit differensiatsiyasi (Environment) = Xonaning jismoniy va psixologik moslashuvchanligi.

q: Nodira o'z darsini videoga olib tahlil qilganda, 45 daqiqalik darsning qariyb 35 daqiqasida faqat o'zi gapirganini (TTT — Teacher Talking Time juda yuqoriligini) ko'rdi. opts: TTT minimal (taxminan 20-30%) bo'lib, darsning asosiy qismi (70-80%) o'quvchilarning faol muloqoti va amaliy faoliyatiga (STT) ajratilishi lozim
TTT kamida 90% bo'lishi shart, chunki faqat o'qituvchi to'g'ri ingliz tilini biladi
STT umuman bo'lmasligi kerak, o'quvchilar faqat darslikdan konspekt qilishlari lozim
O'qituvchi va o'quvchilar bir vaqtda baravar baqirib gapirishlari kerak

q: Sinfda o'quv dasturidagi mavzuni allaqachon mukammal biladigan iqtidorli o'quvchi mavjud. O'qituvchi unga hamma bilan birga yana o'sha oson mashqlarni qaytadan yozdirish o'rniga, dastlabki tezkor testdan so'ng uni bu mashqlardan ozod qilib, unga mavzuni chuqurlashtiruvchi mustaqil ilmiy loyiha topshirdi. q: A reviewer writes at the end of an evaluation: *"I wholeheartedly recommend this manuscript for immediate publication without revisions."* In speech act terms, this represents:

An explicit performative declaration that prints ten thousand copies of the journal volume.
An expressive apology expressing remorse for reading the author's preliminary draft.
A directive recommendation acting simultaneously as an institutional evaluative assessment (assertive/verdictive).

The linear, uninterrupted accumulation of absolute scientific truth across generations.
Incommensurability: the impossibility of directly comparing competing paradigms due to semantic shifts in foundational concepts.
The psychological incompetence of twentieth-century theoretical physicists.
explanation: Kuhn's incommensurability thesis: rival paradigms define terms ('mass') in incompatible ways, meaning scientists in different paradigms talk past one another.

q: Jamshid guruhli topshiriq (Group work) o'tkazmoqda. Guruh a'zolaridan biri barcha ishni o'zi bajarib, qolgan 3 nafar o'quvchi shunchaki passiv tomoshabin bo'lib o'tirganini (Social loafing / Free-rider effect) ko'rdi. Ushbu muammoni bartaraf etish uchun guruh ichida qanday pedagogik mexanizm qo'llanilishi kerak?
opts: Guruh ishini butunlay bekor qilib, faqat individual test o'tkazish
Har bir o'quvchiga aniq rol va mas'uliyat taqsimlash (Facilitator/Leader, Timekeeper, Scribe/Recorder, Reporter/Presenter) va shaxsiy javobgarlik (Individual accountability) belgilash
Passiv o'tirgan o'quvchilarni sinfdan chiqarib yuborish
Barcha ishni bajargan o'quvchiga tanbeh berish
explanation: Hamkorlikda o'qitishda (Cooperative Learning - Johnson & Johnson) 'Free-rider' muammosini hal qilishning yagona yo'li — guruh rollarini (Timekeeper, Scribe, Reporter) aniq taqsimlash va shaxsiy hisobdorlikni (individual accountability) joriy qilishdir.
mnemonic: Guruh rollari: Leader + Timekeeper + Scribe + Reporter -> Shaxsiy javobgarlik.

q: Nilufar darsda 'Mingle Activity' (Erkin aylanib so'rovnoma o'tkazish / Find someone who...) tashkil etdi. O'quvchilar sinf bo'ylab o'rnilaridan turib yurishadi va kamida 5 nafar turli sinfdoshiga savol berib ma'lumot to'plashadi. Bunday mashg'ulotning asosiy afzalligi nima?
opts: O'qituvchiga dars vaqtida sinfdan chiqib ketish imkonini berish
Sinfda boshqarib bo'lmaydigan betartiblik yaratish
Harakatlanish (kinestetik faollik), qisqa vaqt ichida juda ko'p turli suhbatdoshlar bilan haqiqiy dinamik muloqot qilish va o'quvchilarning barchasini 100% gapirishga jalb etish
Faqat eng faol o'quvchilarning ovozini eshitish
explanation: Mingle activities (Find Someone Who, Market survey) — har bir o'quvchini o'rnidan turg'azib, kinestetik energiya beradi, turli sheriklar bilan tabiiy muloqot qilish imkonini yaratadi va 100% STT ni ta'minlaydi.
mnemonic: Mingle = Sinf bo'ylab erkin harakat + 100% o'quvchilar muloqoti.

q: Farhod juftlik ishlarini tashkil etishda 'Closed pairs' (yopiq juftliklar) va 'Open pairs' (ochiq juftliklar) tushunchalarini farqlamoqda. 'Open pairs' nima va u qachon qo'llaniladi?
opts: Faqat o'qituvchi bilan o'quvchi o'rtasidagi suhbat
Juftlikdagi o'quvchilar ko'zlarini yumib gaplashadilar
O'quvchilar eshikdan tashqariga chiqib muloqot qiladilar
Sinfning turli burchaklarida o'tirgan ikki o'quvchi butun sinf oldida dialog namunasini ko'rsatib beradi (Modelling); bu qolganlarga vazifani qanday bajarishni tushunishga yordam beradi
explanation: Open pairs — butun sinf eshitishi uchun ikki o'quvchining namunaviy muloqot ko'rsatib berishidir (Modelling). Closed pairs esa barcha o'quvchilarning bir vaqtda o'z sherigi bilan past ovozda muloqot qilishidir.
mnemonic: Open pairs = Namuna ko'rsatish (Modelling); Closed pairs = Barcha bir vaqtda juftlikda.

q: A certified umpire yells *"Out!"* during a cricket match. How do contemporary pragmaticians classify this utterance?
opts: An assertive declaration, because it both reports an empirical event (ball hitting stumps) and authoritatively creates the official game state.
A pure expressive conveying spontaneous jubilation for the fielding team.
A commissive promising that the dismissed batsman will receive a monetary refund.
An Austinian locutionary defect lacking syntactic verb phrases.
explanation: Searle recognized 'assertive declarations' where an authoritative official assesses a state of affairs (assertive component) and by uttering the assessment makes it an official institutional fact (declarative component).
mnemonic: Umpire call (*Out!*) = Assertive Declaration (assesses fact + enforces official status).

q:
Read the following excerpt from an epistemological critique:

"*A theoretical framework that explains every conceivable empirical outcome is not a supreme triumph of explanatory power, but a fatal scientific defect; genuine scientific claims must take empirical risks by specifying what would definitively falsify them.*"

What Popperian principle of scientific demarcation is championed here?
explanation: Karl Popper's demarcation criterion: a theory that cannot be refuted by any observation is pseudoscientific; genuine science requires falsifiability.
opts: Post-modern relativism: asserting that all beliefs are equally valid subjective perspectives.
Inductive verification: collecting millions of confirming instances to prove a universal law.
Authoritarian dogmatism: accepting established theories on the authority of academic senior faculty.
Falsifiability: the requirement that a scientific theory must make risky, testable predictions capable of refutation.

"*A theoretical framework that explains every conceivable empirical outcome is not a supreme triumph of explanatory power, but a fatal scientific defect; genuine scientific claims must take empirical risks by specifying what would definitively falsify them.*"

What Popperian principle of scientific demarcation is championed here?
mnemonic: Popperian Demarcation: A theory that explains everything explains nothing; falsifiability is essential.

q:

q: Sherzod juftlik ishlarini tashkil etishda 'Closed pairs' (yopiq juftliklar) va 'Open pairs' (ochiq juftliklar) tushunchalarini farqlamoqda. 'Open pairs' nima va u qachon qo'llaniladi?
opts: Faqat o'qituvchi bilan o'quvchi o'rtasidagi suhbat
Juftlikdagi o'quvchilar ko'zlarini yumib gaplashadilar
O'quvchilar eshikdan tashqariga chiqib muloqot qiladilar
Sinfning turli burchaklarida o'tirgan ikki o'quvchi butun sinf oldida dialog namunasini ko'rsatib beradi (Modelling); bu qolganlarga vazifani qanday bajarishni tushunishga yordam beradi
explanation: Open pairs — butun sinf eshitishi uchun ikki o'quvchining namunaviy muloqot ko'rsatib berishidir (Modelling). Closed pairs esa barcha o'quvchilarning bir vaqtda o'z sherigi bilan past ovozda muloqot qilishidir.
mnemonic: Open pairs = Namuna ko'rsatish (Modelling); Closed pairs = Barcha bir vaqtda juftlikda.

O'quvchilar dars vaqtida o'qituvchidan bemalol yashirinib uxlashi mumkin
Sinf xonasida joy tejaladi va partalar kamroq bo'ladi

mnemonic: Horseshoe (U-shape) = Yuzma-yuz muloqot + Ko'z kontakti + Oson monitoring.

q: Which pair correctly matches Searle’s speech act macro-class with its defining illocutionary point and direction of fit?
opts: Commissive: Attempt to get hearer to do something; Words-to-World.
Assertive: Commit speaker to truth of proposition; Words-to-World.
Directive: Commit speaker to future action; World-to-Words.
Declaration: Express psychological attitude; No direction of fit.
explanation: Assertives commit the speaker to truth (Words-to-World). Directives get hearer to act (World-to-Words). Commissives commit speaker to act (World-to-Words). Declarations alter reality (Dual fit). Expressives communicate psychological state (No fit).
mnemonic: Assertive = Words-to-World; Commissive/Directive = World-to-Words; Declaration = Dual.

q:
Read the passage:
"The Social Brain Hypothesis, formulated by Robin Dunbar, proposes that the extraordinary neocortical expansion observed in primates evolved primarily to navigate complex socio-ecological group dynamics rather than to solve ecological foraging problems. Maintaining social cohesion in large troops requires sophisticated mentalizing abilities, tracking shifting alliances, monitoring reputations, and mediating reciprocal altruism. Dunbar demonstrated a quantitative correlation between relative neocortex volume and mean social group size across primates, predicting an intrinsic cognitive threshold of approximately 150 individuals—'Dunbar’s number'—beyond which stable, cohesive social relationships cannot be maintained without formal hierarchical bureaucracy."

According to the Social Brain Hypothesis, what evolutionary pressure primarily drove primate neocortex expansion?
explanation: Dunbar's hypothesis explicitly states neocortex growth was driven by the cognitive demands of 'complex socio-ecological group dynamics... tracking shifting alliances, monitoring reputations, and mediating reciprocal altruism'.

explanation: The 'landscape of fear' proves predators shape ecosystems via 'non-consumptive behavioral modifications' (fear/avoidance), shifting prey habitat use, rather than just lethal kills.
opts: It demonstrates that predators regulate ecosystems through behavioral intimidation and spatial avoidance, not just direct killing.
It proves that herbivores never alter their grazing behaviors regardless of predator presence.

q:
Read the passage:
"Classical Lotka-Volterra differential equations model predator-prey dynamics as oscillating limit cycles, assuming that prey populations are limited solely by predation and predators solely by prey density. Contemporary computational ecology incorporates non-linear functional responses, spatial heterogeneity, and behavioral ecology. The concept of the 'landscape of fear' demonstrates that apex carnivores exert profound top-down ecosystem regulation not merely through direct lethal consumption, but via non-consumptive behavioral modifications. Prey species alter foraging patterns, avoiding high-risk open habitats, which cascades through lower trophic tiers to permit vegetative regeneration and enhance biodiversity."

How does the "landscape of fear" expand upon traditional Lotka-Volterra predator-prey models?
options: It demonstrates that predators regulate ecosystems through behavioral intimidation and spatial avoidance, not just direct killing.
It proves that herbivores never alter their grazing behaviors regardless of predator presence.
It asserts that predatory carnivores are terrified of herbivorous herds in open plains.
It eliminates all mathematical equations from the study of population biology.

q: In which of the following sociopragmatic contexts is a *bald on-record* strategy (without redressive action) considered most legitimate and appropriate?
opts: When an academic researcher politely queries a stranger for archival document copies.
When a junior administrative clerk requests annual leave from the chief executive officer.
When a guest asks for a second helping of caviar at a formal state diplomatic dinner.
When maximum communicative efficiency and immediate speed are demanded by a crisis or mortal emergency.
explanation: Brown and Levinson note that speakers go 'bald on-record' (e.g. *Watch out!*, *Get down!*, *Give me the fire extinguisher!*) without redress when task urgency/emergency suspends face concerns, or when the speaker holds absolute asymmetrical institutional power.
mnemonic: Bald On-Record: Emergency / high urgency trumps face considerations.

q: A senior team leader says to a colleague: *"Hey mate, could you give us a hand with these logistics charts before we head out for lunch?"* Which specific sub-strategy of positive politeness is employed?
opts: Using in-group identity markers ('mate', inclusive 'us') to establish solidarity and minimize social distance.
Impersonalizing the speaker through bureaucratic passive syntax.
Hedging epistemic possibility through Latinate conditional adverbs.
Delivering an off-record hint that implies the company is going bankrupt.
explanation: Using in-group identity markers (e.g. *mate*, *buddy*, *pal*, or the informal inclusive *us*) is a core positive politeness mechanism that frames the request as mutual cooperation between equal in-group peers.
mnemonic: Positive Politeness: In-group markers (*mate, bro, us*) cultivate solidarity.

q: Analyze the utterance: *"I know you're remarkably busy, but could I possibly trouble you for just two minutes of your time regarding the syllabus?"* What politeness mechanisms are deployed?
opts: Bald on-record strategy: commanding compliance without linguistic ornamentation.
Negative politeness strategies: acknowledging the intrusion, hedging with 'possibly', and explicitly minimizing the size of the imposition ('just two minutes').
Positive politeness strategy: treating the hearer as an intimate drinking companion.
Off-record strategy: completely concealing the fact that the speaker needs pedagogical assistance.
explanation: Negative politeness provides redressive action toward hearer's negative face: it hedges (*possibly*), apologizes/acknowledges intrusion (*I know you're remarkably busy*), and minimizes the imposition (*just two minutes*).
mnemonic: Negative Politeness: Hedging, apologizing for intruding, minimizing imposition.

q: A passenger in the backseat of a speeding taxi murmurs aloud: *"Gosh, the speed limit signs along this stretch seem remarkably small and easy to miss."* Which politeness super-strategy is illustrated?
opts: Bald on-record, because the sentence features an imperative verb ordering immediate deceleration.
Negative politeness, because the speaker addressed the driver using royal titular honorifics.
Off-record politeness, using an indirect hint to invite the driver to infer that he is driving too fast, while retaining plausible deniability.
Avoidance of the FTA, because the passenger kept complete silence throughout the journey.
explanation: Going off-record means performing the FTA indirectly (via hints, irony, or association clues) so that the speaker can maintain plausible deniability, allowing the hearer to interpret the directive freely without overt face loss.
mnemonic: Off-Record: Dropping hints with plausible deniability (no overt on-record request).

q: In Brown and Levinson's formula for calculating the weightiness of a face-threatening act ($W_x = D(S, H) + P(H, S) + R_x$), what does the variable **P(H, S)** represent?
opts: The probability of the speech act being recorded by acoustic surveillance systems.
The personal psychological patience exhibited by the Speaker during heated arguments.
The phonetic pitch frequency employed by the Hearer during formal oral interrogations.
The relative power that the Hearer possesses over the Speaker in the given sociopragmatic context.
explanation: $P(H, S)$ represents the relative power of the Hearer over the Speaker. The greater the power of the Hearer over the Speaker (e.g. judge to defendant, CEO to intern), the higher the weightiness of the FTA, demanding more redressive politeness.
mnemonic: FTA Weight = Distance (D) + Power of H over S (P) + Ranking of imposition (R).

q: According to Brown and Levinson, how does an increase in *social distance* ($D$) between speaker and hearer typically influence the choice of politeness strategy?
opts: It increases the overall weightiness ($W$), necessitating more elaborate redressive negative politeness or off-record formulations.
It reduces face sensitivity, allowing strangers to communicate exclusively via blunt bald on-record commands.
It eliminates the need for grammatical verb morphology in professional correspondence.
It forces the speaker to employ infant babble terminology regardless of topic.
explanation: High social distance ($D$, e.g. strangers or formal institutional relationships) increases the perceived threat of an FTA ($W$), which demands higher levels of redressive action, typically negative politeness or off-record hints.
mnemonic: Higher Distance ($D$) -> Greater FTA Weight -> More Negative Politeness needed.

q: Inklyuziv ta'lim metodologiyasida "Adaptatsiya" (Accommodation) bilan "Modifikatsiya" (Modification) o'rtasidagi nozik farq qaysi?

Adaptatsiya faqat o'qituvchiga, modifikatsiya faqat darslikka tegishli.
Adaptatsiya doimo bepul, modifikatsiya esa doimo pullik bo'ladi.

mnemonic: Accommodation = Maqsad bir xil, yo'li qulay; Modification = Maqsadning o'zi o'zgaradi.

q: "Moslashuvchan guruhlash" (Flexible Grouping) tamoyili darsda qanday amalga oshiriladi?

O'quvchilar yil davomida bitta qotib qolgan 'kuchli' yoki 'kuchsiz' guruhda qolmasdan, har bir dars vazifasiga qarab: goh qiziqishlari, goh o'rganish uslubi, goh aralash qobiliyatlari (heterogeneous), goh bir xil darajalari (homogeneous) bo'yicha muntazam almashib turadilar.

explanation: Moslashuvchan guruhlash (Flexible grouping) bolalarga 'yaxshi' yoki 'yomon' degan tamg'a (label) bosilishining oldini oladi. Guruhlar vazifa xarakteriga qarab dinamik ravishda muntazam o'zgarib turadi.
mnemonic: Flexible Grouping = Qotib qolgan tamg'alar yo'q; guruhlar muntazam dinamik almashadi.

q: Alohida ta'lim ehtiyojlari bo'lgan o'quvchining ota-onasi bilan o'qituvchining muloqotida qaysi tamoyil eng ustuvor hisoblanadi?

Hamkorlik va ishonch tamoyili — ota-onani bolaning muammolari bo'yicha faqat ayblash emas, balki bolaning rivojlanishidagi teng huquqli sherik sifatida qabul qilib, uning yutuqlari va o'sish dinamikasini birgalikda qo'llab-quvvatlash.

mnemonic: Inklyuziv muloqot: Ota-ona — aybdor emas, bola rivojidagi teng huquqli hamkor!

q: Why does asking a casual acquaintance for a five-dollar loan require less linguistic mitigation than asking them to borrow their newly purchased car for an interstate road trip?
opts: The noun 'car' possesses fewer phonological syllables than the compound noun 'dollar bill'.
Borrowing an expensive automobile represents a vastly higher ranking of imposition ($R_x$) in terms of material value, risk, and personal entitlement.
Automotive transport is legally prohibited under British politeness statutes.
Social distance ($D$) automatically resets to zero whenever mechanical engines are mentioned.
explanation: $R_x$ is the cultural/situational ranking of imposition — the degree to which an act impinges on goods, services, or personal autonomy. Borrowing a car is a high $R$ imposition requiring heavy redressive mitigation.
mnemonic: Ranking of Imposition ($R$): High-stakes request demands high-level redressive mitigation.

q: A library notice reads: *"Regulations prohibit the consumption of hot foodstuffs in the main reading annex."* Which negative politeness sub-strategy is exemplified?
opts: Positive politeness via jocular camaraderie and shared snacking invitations.
Bald on-record commanding with immediate physical intimidation.
Impersonalizing the speaker and hearer by removing agentive pronouns and attributing the constraint to abstract rules.
Off-record ambiguity designed to mislead foreign readers into buying pastries.
explanation: Impersonalization (e.g. *Regulations prohibit...*, *It is requested that...*) avoids direct confrontation by removing 'I' and 'you', framing the imposition as an objective, universal institutional necessity rather than personal coercion.
mnemonic: Impersonalization: Eliminating 'I' and 'you' frames imposition as an objective rule.

"While Large Language Models (LLMs) display astonishing facility with grammatical syntax and contextual text generation, their underlying architecture lacks sensorimotor grounding. By training purely on statistical correlations across textual corpora, an LLM acquires distributional semantics—mapping relationships between signifiers without ever interacting with the signified physical world. q: An advocate addresses an appellate judge: *"If Your Honor pleases, may I direct the court’s attention to paragraph 14 of our brief?"* What politeness mechanism is foregrounded?
opts: Giving deference through formal honorifics, symbolically humbling the speaker while elevating the addressee's social status.
Positive politeness, claiming shared fraternal intimacy with the presiding magistrate.
Off-record evasion, distracting the court from constitutional precedents.
Bald on-record defiance, ordering the bench to comply under statutory duress.
explanation: Giving deference (using titles like *Your Honor*, *Sir*, *Professor*) satisfies negative face by explicitly acknowledging the hearer's superior relative power ($P$) and elevated social status.
mnemonic: Giving Deference: Elevates hearer's status and humbles speaker to soften FTAs.

q: In Jenny Thomas's landmark framework for cross-cultural communication breakdowns, what constitutes a *pragmalinguistic failure*?
opts: A failure caused by fundamentally conflicting social perceptions of power, taboos, and what constitutes acceptable behavior in a culture.
A failure arising when the pragmatic force mapped onto a linguistic structure by a non-native speaker systematically differs from the force assigned by native speakers.
The complete inability of a speaker to articulate English consonants due to neurological impairment.
A typographic error produced by malfunctioning mechanical word-processing equipment.
explanation: Jenny Thomas distinguishes between pragmalinguistic failure (inappropriate linguistic encoding/transfer of formulas, e.g. using *Of course* to mean *Yes*) and sociopragmatic failure (mismatch in underlying cultural beliefs, social distance, values, and taboos).
mnemonic: Pragmalinguistic = Linguistic tool misapplied. Sociopragmatic = Cultural norm mismatch.

explanation: Fast-finishers uchun mexanik 'busy work' (ko'proq bir xil mashq berish) berish motivatsiyani o'ldiradi. Ularga oldindan puxta o'ylangan 'Anchor activities' (chuqurlashtiruvchi, ijodiy kashfiyot topshiriqlari) berilishi zarur.
mnemonic: Fast-finishers = Anchor activities (Chuqurlashtiruvchi mazmunli topshiriqlar).

q: An international graduate student innocently asks an American professor in an introductory meeting: *"How much money do you earn each month, and why are you not married yet?"* In pragmatic analysis, this miscommunication is primarily:
opts: A Gricean flout of the Maxim of Manner due to archaic vocabulary choices.
A pragmalinguistic error, because the student utilized inverted auxiliary interrogative grammar.
A sociopragmatic failure, stemming from divergent cross-cultural assessments of privacy thresholds, taboo subjects, and social distance.
An Austinian illocutionary misfire that legally annuls the student’s academic visa.
explanation: The student's grammar is flawless, but the utterance breaches cultural norms regarding appropriate topics of conversation between social distant acquaintances ($D$). This is a classic sociopragmatic failure.
mnemonic: Inappropriate personal topic across cultures = Sociopragmatic failure.

q: According to Geoffrey Leech’s Politeness Principle (1983), what is the core requirement of the **Tact Maxim**?
opts: Minimize the length of sentences; maximize the speed of physical speech.
Minimize praise of the speaker; maximize praise of the hearer.
Minimize disagreement between speaker and hearer; maximize silence.
Minimize the cost to the hearer; maximize the benefit to the hearer.
explanation: Leech's Tact Maxim (applied mainly to directives and commissives) commands: (a) Minimize cost to other; (b) Maximize benefit to other. E.g. *Have a seat and relax* (high benefit to H) is polite, whereas *Clean my desk* (high cost to H) is impolite unless mitigated.
mnemonic: Tact Maxim = Minimize cost to other; maximize benefit to other.

q: When asked what she thought of a poorly written amateur theatrical performance, a polite critic states: *"The costumes were exceptionally vibrant and inventive."* Which Leech maxim is observed here?
opts: The Tact Maxim: minimize financial expenditure by the theatre company.
The Approbation Maxim: minimize dispraise of other; maximize praise of other.
The Modesty Maxim: maximize self-denigration regarding the critic's own acting skills.
The Generosity Maxim: offer free catering to the backstage technical crew.
explanation: The Approbation Maxim dictates: minimize dispraise of other; maximize praise of other. By selectively praising the costumes instead of attacking the acting, the critic satisfies Approbation (and hedges face).
mnemonic: Approbation Maxim = Flattery/praise: Minimize dispraise of other; maximize praise of other.

opts: Negative politeness via extreme deferential distance.

q:
In an EFL staff room, an experienced teacher approaches a junior colleague:

*"Hey mate, you did an absolute masterclass with that reading workshop today! Any chance we could borrow your vocabulary worksheets for our group?"*

Which politeness strategy is exemplified by the speaker?
explanation: Positive politeness appeals to the hearer's positive face (the desire to be approved of, liked, and valued as a peer). The speaker uses an in-group marker ('mate'), enthusiastic compliments ('absolute masterclass'), and shared belonging to build camaraderie.

opts: Jismoniy, aqliy, sensor yoki ruhiy nuqsonlaridan, ijtimoiy kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, barcha bolalarning umumta'lim muassasalarida teng huquqli, kamsitishlarsiz va sifatli ta'lim olishini hamda jamiyatga to'laqonli ijtimoiy integratsiyalashuvini ta'minlash.
Barcha imkoniyati cheklangan bolalarni alohida izolyatsiya qilingan maxsus muassasalarga ko'chirish.

q: Pedagogikada "Tenglik" (Equality) bilan "Adolat" (Equity) tushunchalari o'rtasidagi tub farqni ifodalovchi eng aniq ta'rif qaysi?
opts: Tenglik faqat qizlar uchun, adolat esa faqat o'g'il bolalar uchun qo'llaniladi.

Tenglik barcha o'quvchilarga ularning ehtiyojlaridan qat'i nazar aynan bir xil resurs berishni anglatadi; Adolat esa har bir o'quvchiga uning individual ehtiyojlaridan kelib chiqib, barchasi muvaffaqiyatga erisha olishi uchun aynan unga kerakli resurs va ko'makni taqdim etishni bildiradi.
Tenglik o'qituvchilar maoshiga, adolat esa faqat maktab binosi ta'miriga tegishli.
Bu ikki tushuncha o'rtasida hech qanday farq yo'q, ikkalasi ham bir xil ma'noni bildiradi.
explanation: Mashhur ta'limiy metafora: "Tenglik — bu hammaga bir xil o'lchamdagi poyabzal berish; Adolat esa har kimga o'z oyog'iga mos o'lchamdagi poyabzal berishdir". Inklyuziya va differensiatsiya sof Adolat (Equity) tamoyiliga asoslanadi.
mnemonic: Equality = Hammaga bir xil berish; Equity = Har kimga ehtiyojiga qarab adolatli berish!

q: A concert pianist finishes a breathtaking concerto to thunderous standing ovations. When a patron exclaims, *"You are a musical titan!"*, the pianist replies, *"I was merely fortunate that the orchestra carried me through my clumsy fingering."* Which maxim governs this response?
opts: The Agreement Maxim: validate that the patron is an incompetent musicologist.

explanation: The Modesty Maxim requires speakers to minimize praise of self and maximize dispraise of self, deflecting compliments to maintain social humility.
mnemonic: Modesty Maxim = Downplay self: Minimize praise of self; maximize dispraise of self.

opts: Committing an Austinian misfire that invalidates corporate graphic design patents.
Violating the Tact Maxim by ordering Colleague A to resign from the marketing board.
Flouting the Modesty Maxim by claiming ownership of all advertising trademarks.

"Holmes leaned forward in the wicker armchair of Baker Street, his keen eyes gleaming like those of a hawk poised to strike. "You see, my dear Watson, you see everything, yet you observe nothing. "CRISPR-based homing gene drives overcome the Mendelian fifty-percent inheritance threshold by converting heterozygous alleles into homozygous copies, guaranteeing that an engineered genetic alteration is transmitted to nearly one hundred percent of offspring. Proponents envision deploying gene drives to eradicate vector-borne pathogens, such as editing Anopheles mosquitoes to induce female sterility and eliminate malaria. Bioethicists, however, urge extreme precautionary restraint: once released into wild, open ecosystems, self-sustaining gene drives are virtually irreversible. The eradication of an entire species risks triggering unpredictable ecological cascades, such as disrupting pollination networks or eliminating forage bases for insectivorous bats and amphibians."

How do CRISPR homing gene drives subvert traditional Mendelian inheritance principles?
opts: They ensure that an engineered genetic modification is inherited by nearly 100% of progeny rather than 50%.
They prevent offspring from inheriting any genetic material from the maternal parent.
They cause edited organisms to reproduce purely through asexual cloning.
They restrict gene expression exclusively to the third generation of descendants.

q: In Brown and Levinson’s model, which of the following represents the positive politeness sub-strategy of *'giving gifts to hearer'*?
opts: Delivering an Austinian performative that signs over industrial mining leases.
Physically mailing high-denomination banknotes to bribe an election official.
Offering genuine sympathy, undivided attention, understanding, and personal appreciation during a conversation.
Writing a legal promissory note backed by collateral real estate assets.
explanation: Brown and Levinson define 'gifts' broadly to include non-material communicative gifts: empathy, sympathy, active listening, admiration, and respect that satisfy the hearer's positive face desires.
mnemonic: Communicative 'gifts' = Offering sympathy, active listening, and sincere admiration.

q: Jonathan Culpeper (1996) expanded politeness theory by developing an explicit framework for *impoliteness*. How does Culpeper define *positive impoliteness*?
opts: Accidental grammatical errors committed by beginners learning a foreign language.
Polite compliments delivered with excessively cheerful intonation in kindergarten classrooms.
The refusal of an ambassador to sign an international bilateral trade agreement.
Communicative strategies deliberately designed to damage the addressee’s positive face desires (e.g. by ignoring, excluding, disassociating, or using taboo insults).
explanation: Culpeper defines positive impoliteness as strategies intentionally designed to attack the recipient's positive face: making the other feel unwanted, excluded, insulted, or unappreciated.
mnemonic: Positive Impoliteness (Culpeper) = Deliberate attacks on desire for inclusion/respect.

q: O'qituvchi darslikdagi matnlarni tahlil qilganda, barcha rahbarlar, olimlar va shifokorlar faqat erkak qahramonlar sifatida, barcha uy bekalari va farroshlar esa faqat ayollar sifatida tasvirlanganini payqadi. Gender tengligi va kasb standarti bo'yicha o'qituvchi sinfda qanday munozara tashkil qilishi maqsadga muvofiq?
opts: Darslikdagi barcha rasmlarni bo'yab tashlash.
Qiz bolalarga 'sizlarning vazifangiz faqat ovqat pishirish' deb ochiq aytish.
O'g'il bolalarga barcha fandan avtomatik a'lo baho qo'yish.

Ushbu stereotiplarni tanqidiy tahlil qilish (Gender bias analysis) uchun o'quvchilar bilan bahs o'tkazish hamda muvaffaqiyatli ayol olimlar, rahbarlar va professional soha egalari haqidagi autentik misollarni darsga qo'shimcha kiritish.
explanation: O'qituvchi darsda gender stereotiplarini mustahkamlamasligi, aksincha kasb tanlash va akademik muvaffaqiyatda qizlar va o'g'il bolalarning teng salohiyatini qo'llab-quvvatlashi shart.
mnemonic: Gender tengligi: Kasbiy imkoniyatlarda stereotiplarni sindirish va tenglikni rag'batlantirish.

opts: Eshitishida muammosi bor o'quvchini darsdan ozod qilish

Videoni o'rniga faqat qora doskadan foydalanish

q: Azamat o'quvchilarning individual ta'limiy trayektoriyasini (IEP — Individualized Education Plan) tuzishda kimlar bilan hamkorlik qilishi shart?
opts: Hech kim bilan maslahatlashmasdan faqat o'zi yolg'iz qaror qiladi
Faqat maktab qorovuli bilan
Faqat tuman maorif bo'limi inspektori bilan
Ota-ona, maktab psixologi, maxsus pedagog (defektolog/inklyuziv mutaxassis) va imkon qadar o'quvchining o'zi bilan hamkorlikda
explanation: IEP (Individualized Education Plan — Shaxsiy ta'lim rejasi) mutaxassislar jamoasi (o'qituvchi, psixolog, defektolog, ota-ona va o'quvchi) tomonidan ko'p tomonlama konsensus asosida ishlab chiqiladi.
mnemonic: IEP jamoasi = O'qituvchi + Ota-ona + Psixolog + Maxsus pedagog.

opts: 1) Axborotni taqdim etishning turli yo'llari (Multiple means of representation); 2) Harakat va fikrni ifodalashning turli usullari (Multiple means of action & expression); 3) O'quvchini jalb qilish va rag'batlantirishning xilma-xil vositalari (Multiple means of engagement)
1) Qat'iy intizom; 2) Majburiy yagona darslik; 3) Har kungi summativ test

1) O'qituvchi ma'ruzasi; 2) Yozma diktant; 3) Jismoniy jazo
explanation: UDL (Universal Design for Learning) 3 ta asosiy tamoyilga tayanadi: Axborotni ko'rsatish (Representation), O'quvchining o'zini namoyon qilishi (Action & Expression), va O'quvchini qiziqtirish (Engagement).
mnemonic: UDL Uchligi = Representation (Taqdimot) + Expression (Ifodalash) + Engagement (Qiziqtirish).

q: Rustam sinfidagi disleksiya (matn o'qishda harflarni chalkashtirish) bilan bog'liq maxsus ta'limiy ehtiyojga (SEN) ega o'quvchiga ingliz tili matnini o'zlashtirishda qanday eng samarali ko'mak bera oladi?
opts: O'quvchini butun sinf oldida doskaga chiqarib baland ovozda matn o'qitish
Shrift o'lchamini kattalashtirish, harflar orasi ochiq maxsus disleksiya shriftidan foydalanish, matnni audio bilan birga taqdim etish (audiobook sync) va vizual rasmlar bilan boyitish
O'quvchiga o'qishni taqiqlab qo'yish
O'quvchining daftariga qizil qalam bilan katta qilib '2' qo'yish
explanation: Disleksiyali o'quvchilarga matnni vizual soddalashtirish, audio-vizual sinxronlik (matnni eshitib kuzatish) va disleksiya uchun maxsus o'qilishi qulay shriftlar (OpenDyslexic) eng samarali ko'makdir.
mnemonic: Disleksiya ko'magi = Katta qulay shrift + Audio-vizual sinxronlik + Rasmlar.

q:
Read the passage:
"Holmes leaned forward in the wicker armchair of Baker Street, his keen eyes gleaming like those of a hawk poised to strike. "You see, my dear Watson, you see everything, yet you observe nothing. Consider our visitor’s left sleeve: the microscopic fraying along the inner cuff, the unmistakable reddish-brown chalk dust embedded beneath his thumb-nail, and the slight asymmetry in the wear of his boot-soles. While you saw merely an agitated country gentleman, the chalk dust locates him precisely at the brick-kilns of Reading within the last forty-eight hours, while the asymmetric leather sole betrays a recent hip injury sustained during an equestrian fall. It accentuates his predatory intellectual sharpness, intense focus, and ruthless analytical detachment.
It conveys that Holmes is nervous, terrified, and seeking an immediate escape route.

q: Which behavior exemplifies Culpeper’s concept of *negative impoliteness* in institutional interactions?
opts: Invading personal physical space, imposing severe unwarranted burdens, or aggressively encroaching on someone's autonomy without redressive mitigation.
Sending a polite birthday greeting card two days before the recipient's actual birthday.
Bowing at a forty-five-degree angle during an official diplomatic state reception in Tokyo.
Speaking with a whisper in an academic library reading hall.
explanation: Negative impoliteness is designed to attack the addressee's negative face by invading their space, scorning their freedom of movement, or brazenly imposing upon their time and personal autonomy.
mnemonic: Negative Impoliteness = Intentionally violating autonomy, space, and personal freedom.

"Holmes leaned forward in the wicker armchair of Baker Street, his keen eyes gleaming like those of a hawk poised to strike. "You see, my dear Watson, you see everything, yet you observe nothing. Consider our visitor’s left sleeve: the microscopic fraying along the inner cuff, the unmistakable reddish-brown chalk dust embedded beneath his thumb-nail, and the slight asymmetry in the wear of his boot-soles. While you saw merely an agitated country gentleman, the chalk dust locates him precisely at the brick-kilns of Reading within the last forty-eight hours, while the asymmetric leather sole betrays a recent hip injury sustained during an equestrian fall. It is an elementary problem when the mind is trained to synthesize disparate trivia into an infallible chain of causality.""

What does Holmes mean by synthesizing disparate trivia into an "infallible chain of causality"?
mnemonic: Deductive Synthesis: Uniting trivial clues into an unbroken chain of causality.

q: Dilnoza o'quvchilarga 'used to + verb' strukturasini o'rgatmoqda. "I used to live in Bukhara" gapining ma'nosini o'quvchilar to'g'ri tushunganligini tekshirish uchun Concept Checking Questions (CCQs) tuzmoqchi. Qaysi savollar zanjiri eng to'g'ri va samarali CCQ hisoblanadi?
opts: 1) Men o'tmishda Buxoroda yashaganmanmi? (Ha); 2) Men hozir Buxoroda yashaymanmi? (Yo'q); 3) Bu o'tmishdagi doimiy odat/holat bo'lganmi? (Ha)
1) Bu gapda qaysi zamon qo'llangan? 2) 'Used to' qoidasi nima?
1) Buxoroning tarixi haqida nimalarni bilasiz? 2) U yerga borganmisiz?
1) Siz bu gapni tarjima qila olasizmi? 2) Tushundingizmi?
explanation: Concept Checking Questions (CCQs) maqsadli til birligining mohiyatini (concept) ochib beruvchi qisqa, sodda, 'ha/yo'q' javobli savollardir. U grammatik terminlarni so'ramaydi, ma'noni tekshiradi.
mnemonic: CCQs = Tushunchani tekshirish: O'tmishdami? Hozir ham bormi? (Sodda Ha/Yo'q).

q:
Read the passage:
"CRISPR-based homing gene drives overcome the Mendelian fifty-percent inheritance threshold by converting heterozygous alleles into homozygous copies, guaranteeing that an engineered genetic alteration is transmitted to nearly one hundred percent of offspring. Proponents envision deploying gene drives to eradicate vector-borne pathogens, such as editing Anopheles mosquitoes to induce female sterility and eliminate malaria. Bioethicists, however, urge extreme precautionary restraint: once released into wild, open ecosystems, self-sustaining gene drives are virtually irreversible. The eradication of an entire species risks triggering unpredictable ecological cascades, such as disrupting pollination networks or eliminating forage bases for insectivorous bats and amphibians."

The word "precautionary" as used in the passage denotes an approach that:
options: Rushes unverified technologies into commercial production to maximize profits.
Relies entirely on retrospective analysis after a catastrophe has occurred.
Prohibits scientists from publishing peer-reviewed empirical research.
Advises caution and preventive safeguards when an action may cause severe, irreversible harm.

q: Jamshid Diane Larsen-Freeman tomonidan ilgari surilgan '3D Grammar Dimension' (Grammatikaning uch o'lchovli modeli)ga tayanib dars o'tmoqda. Ushbu modelga ko'ra har qanday grammatik birlik qaysi uchta o'zaro bog'liq o'lchamda o'rganilishi shart?
opts: Subject, Predicate, Object
Form (Shakl / Qanday yasaladi?), Meaning (Ma'no / Nimani bildiradi?), Use (Qo'llanish / Qachon va nega aynan shu struktura tanlanadi?)
Present, Past, Future
Phoneme, Morpheme, Grapheme
explanation: Diane Larsen-Freeman 3D Grammar modeli: 1) Form (morfologik va sintaktik shakl); 2) Meaning (semantik ma'no); 3) Use (pragmatik qo'llanish konteksti). Haqiqiy til egallash faqat shu uch o'lcham uyg'unligida sodir bo'ladi.
mnemonic: Larsen-Freeman 3D: Form (Shakl) + Meaning (Ma'no) + Use (Qo'llanish).

q: Nilufar o'quvchilarga 'She has been painting the kitchen' (Present Perfect Continuous) va 'She has painted the kitchen' (Present Perfect Simple) gaplari orasidagi aspektual farqni vizual ko'rsatish uchun doskada 'Timeline' (Vaqt chizig'i) chizdi. Ushbu ikki gap o'rtasidagi asosiy ma'no farqi nimada?
opts: Bu ikki gap mutlaqo bir xil ma'noni bildiradi, faqat sinonim hisoblanadi
Birinchi gap kelasi zamonda, ikkinchisi o'tgan zamonda

Birinchi gapda diqqat jarayonning o'ziga va uning davomiyligiga (oshxona hali to'liq bo'yalib bitmagan bo'lishi mumkin) qaratilgan; ikkinchisida esa natija va tugallanganlikka (oshxona bo'yalib bo'lingan) qaratilgan
Birinchi gap passiv, ikkinchisi aktiv nisbatda
explanation: Present Perfect Continuous aspektida asosiy e'tibor jarayon (activity/process)ning o'ziga va uning davom etayotganiga qaratiladi. Simple shaklida esa e'tibor tugallangan natija (completed product)ga qaratiladi.
mnemonic: Continuous = Jarayon va davomiylik; Simple = Tugallangan natija.

q: Farhod o'quvchilarga 'If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam' (Third Conditional) jumlasini tushuntirmoqda. Ushbu jumla uchun eng to'g'ri tuzilgan CCQ qaysi?
opts: 1) Translate this into Uzbek? 2) Which tense is used?
1) Is it a real conditional? 2) What is the auxiliary verb?
1) Do you study hard every day? 2) Do you like exams?
1) Did I study hard? (No); 2) Did I pass the exam? (No); 3) Am I talking about the past or the present? (Past); 4) Can I change the situation now? (No)
explanation: Third Conditional o'tmishdagi real bo'lmagan, amalga oshmagan voqea va afsusni bildiradi. CCQ aynan shu haqiqatni tekshirishi kerak: O'qidimi? Yo'q. O'tdimi? Yo'q. O'tmishdami? Ha.
mnemonic: Third Conditional CCQ: O'qiganmi? Yo'q. O'tganmi? Yo'q. O'tmishdagi afsus.

q: Daniel Goleman konsepsiyasiga binoan, pedagogik faoliyatda yuqori "Hissiy intellekt" (Emotional Intelligence - EQ)ga ega bo'lgan o'qituvchi sinfdagi nizoli vaziyatlarda qanday yo'l tutadi?
opts: Darhol politsiya chaqirib, butun sinfni javobgarlikka tortishni talab qiladi.
O'quvchilar bilan birga baqirib, partalarni tepadi va janjalni kuchaytiradi.

O'z emotsiyalarini (g'azab, jahl) ongli ravishda boshqara oladi, o'quvchining xatti-harakati ortidagi hissiy sabablarni (empatiya) tushunadi va vaziyatni baqir-chaqirsiz, konstruktiv muloqot bilan bartaraf etadi.
Xonadan yig'lab chiqib ketadi va dars o'tishdan bosh tortadi.
explanation: O'qituvchining yuqori EQ si — sinf boshqaruvining negizidir. O'z hislarini boshqara olish (Self-regulation) va bolaning holatini his qilish (Empathy) mojarolarni janjalsiz hal qilish imkonini beradi.
mnemonic: Pedagogik EQ = O'z jahlingni jilovlash + Bolaning hissini tushunish (Empatiya).

Mock politeness (sarcasm), wherein an insincerely polite surface form is weaponized to inflict overt face damage.

explanation: Mock politeness (sarcasm) uses surface politeness markers that are blatantly insincere in context, intensifying the sarcastic sting and causing severe face damage.
mnemonic: Mock Politeness (Culpeper) = Weaponized surface politeness used for sarcastic attack.

explanation: Cather portrays the frontier not as hostile destruction, but as an austere crucible where human resilience attains heroic dignity through communion with nature.
opts: A harmonious yet demanding kinship wherein human endurance and moral dignity derive from confronting a formidable frontier.
A bitter war of total conquest in which mechanized industry has obliterated all natural prairie flora.
An overwhelming defeat wherein human beings are rendered utterly pathetic and worthless by the landscape.
A tourist’s superficial delight in a picturesque vacation spot free from labor and hardship.
q:
Read the passage:
"Ántonia stood upon the crest of the divide at twilight, her sunburnt arms folded across her breast, gazing out across the immense undulating sea of red grass that rolled all the way to the horizon. The relentless prairie wind, smelling of dried sage and coming frost, tugged at her homespun skirt, yet she seemed rooted to the sod like one of the deep-rooted wild plum trees that withstood every winter blizzard. Behind her, the sod dugout stood dark against the fading crimson sky, a primitive monument to human endurance. In that solitary figure silhouetted against the vastness, one felt not the insignificance of humanity, but the heroic dignity of those who wrestled a living from an untamed earth."

What relationship between humanity and the natural environment is articulated in this passage?
options: A harmonious yet demanding kinship wherein human endurance and moral dignity derive from confronting a formidable frontier.
A bitter war of total conquest in which mechanized industry has obliterated all natural prairie flora.
An overwhelming defeat wherein human beings are rendered utterly pathetic and worthless by the landscape.
A tourist’s superficial delight in a picturesque vacation spot free from labor and hardship.

q: Gulbahor o'quvchilarga 'She has been painting the kitchen' (Present Perfect Continuous) va 'She has painted the kitchen' (Present Perfect Simple) gaplari orasidagi aspektual farqni vizual ko'rsatish uchun doskada 'Timeline' (Vaqt chizig'i) chizdi. opts: Bu ikki gap mutlaqo bir xil ma'noni bildiradi, faqat sinonim hisoblanadi

q: Why do academic writers frequently utilize hedging expressions such as *'The empirical findings appear to suggest that...'* rather than *'The findings prove that...'*?
opts: To obscure the fact that they never collected any scientific laboratory data.
Because academic journal software rejects all manuscripts containing fewer than four hedging modals per page.
To protect their own face against potential refutation while showing modesty and deference to alternative interpretations within the scholarly community.
Because English syntax forbids declarative clauses in published dissertations.
explanation: Hedging in academic discourse is both an epistemic qualification and a politeness strategy: it protects the author's positive face if the claim is refuted, and respects readers' negative face by not imposing conclusions dogmatically.
mnemonic: Academic Hedging = Face-saver: Shields author from error, avoids dogmatic imposition.

q: Azamat o'quvchilarga 'If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam' (Third Conditional) jumlasini tushuntirmoqda. Ushbu jumla uchun eng to'g'ri tuzilgan CCQ qaysi?

1) Is it a real conditional? 2) What is the auxiliary verb?
1) Do you study hard every day? 2) Do you like exams?

mnemonic: Third Conditional CCQ: O'qiganmi? Yo'q. O'tganmi? Yo'q. O'tmishdagi afsus.

q: Rustam Diane Larsen-Freeman tomonidan ilgari surilgan '3D Grammar Dimension' (Grammatikaning uch o'lchovli modeli)ga tayanib dars o'tmoqda. Ushbu modelga ko'ra har qanday grammatik birlik qaysi uchta o'zaro bog'liq o'lchamda o'rganilishi shart?

q: Sociopragmatic researchers (e.g. Matsumoto, Gu) critiqued Brown and Levinson's model for being overly Western and individualistic. What was their core theoretical objection?
opts: In collectivistic cultures, 'face' is anchored in group belonging, social harmony, and communal role obligations rather than individual autonomy and territorial non-imposition.
Non-Western languages possess zero lexical items corresponding to politeness or gratitude.
Brown and Levinson wrote their monograph without using standard generative syntactic tree diagrams.
Face concerns completely disappear outside the boundaries of North American and European universities.
explanation: Scholars like Yoshiko Matsumoto and Yueguo Gu argued that Brown and Levinson's notion of negative face (individualistic autonomy/non-imposition) does not fit collectivistic societies (e.g. Japan, China), where social identity is defined by communal harmony and relational place within the group.
mnemonic: Collectivist Face Critique: Face is relational harmony and group duty, not Western autonomy.

q: In Conversation Analysis (Sacks, Schegloff), how does *preference organization* correlate with face management?
opts: Preferred turns must always be spoken in a higher acoustic decibel register than dispreferred turns.
Preferred turns (e.g. accepting an invitation) are structurally brief and direct, whereas dispreferred turns (e.g. refusing) are delayed, hedged, and accompanied by accounts to mitigate face threat.
Dispreferred turns are legally prohibited in parliamentary debate proceedings.
Preference organization refers exclusively to the phonetic vowel preferences of native speakers.
explanation: Dispreferred responses (refusals, disagreements) inherently threaten face and are therefore structurally marked: they feature pauses, delay tokens (*well*, *uh*), hedges, and elaborate justifications/accounts to cushion the blow.
mnemonic: Dispreferred Turns = Structurally marked (delays, hedges, accounts) to minimize face threat.

q: A team member arrives five minutes late to an informal department brainstorm, soaking wet from sudden rain. The director grins: *"Well, did you swim across the river to join us? Come grab some hot coffee!"* What politeness mechanism is utilized?
opts: Bald on-record discipline, issuing an unmitigated reprimand for tardiness.
Negative politeness, demanding an official meteorological rainfall certification from the city council.
Joking as a positive politeness strategy, defusing embarrassment and reinforcing in-group camaraderie.
Avoidance of the FTA, pretending that no human being entered the conference room.
explanation: Brown and Levinson identify joking as a positive politeness sub-strategy: humor exploits shared background knowledge and shared relaxation, soothing anxiety and re-establishing mutual solidarity.
mnemonic: Humor / Joking = Positive Politeness (relieves tension, validates in-group bond).

q: After evaluating a disastrous institutional budget collapse, a finance director remarks: *"Our quarterly balance sheet is not looking quite as buoyant as we might have anticipated."* What off-record technique is illustrated?
opts: A positive politeness promise granting bonuses to all company shareholders.
A bald on-record command requiring immediate bankruptcy liquidation.
An Austinian misfire caused by arithmetic errors in the spreadsheet macro.
Understatement (litotes), mitigating a catastrophic situation by describing it through litotic negation to avoid crude, panic-inducing directness.
explanation: Understatement (litotes) generates an off-record meaning by saying less than what is true, softening harsh reality and shielding both the speaker's and hearers' positive face from raw shock.
mnemonic: Litotic Understatement = Off-record softening of harsh or catastrophic news.

q: A tired professor says to an inquisitive student: *"I have answered that precise dissertation question ten million times this semester."* Pragmatically, how does this overstatement function?
opts: As an off-record hyperbole, conveying exasperation and hinting that the student should consult previously distributed lecture notes.
As an empirical scientific tally recorded by classroom electronic sensors.
As an explicit performative canceling the university’s doctoral degree program.
As a negative politeness honorific praising the student’s intellectual curiosity.
explanation: Hyperbole flouts the Maxim of Quality to go off-record, dramatizing the speaker's emotional state (fatigue, frustration) to prompt the hearer to infer the underlying message: go look it up yourself.
mnemonic: Off-record hyperbole: Dramatizes emotion to indirectly urge compliance.

"Although dark matter constitutes approximately eighty-five percent of the matter in the universe, it remains completely invisible to electromagnetic detectors because it neither emits, absorbs, nor reflects photons. q:
Read the passage:
"The Sapir-Whorf hypothesis, or linguistic relativity, posits that the structural categories of a speaker's native language shape their cognitive perception and habitual categorization of reality. While extreme linguistic determinism—the notion that language strictly confines thought—has been largely discredited, modern experimental psycholinguistics validates weak relativity. q:
Read the passage:
"The Sapir-Whorf hypothesis, or linguistic relativity, posits that the structural categories of a speaker's native language shape their cognitive perception and habitual categorization of reality. While extreme linguistic determinism—the notion that language strictly confines thought—has been largely discredited, modern experimental psycholinguistics validates weak relativity. Cross-cultural studies examining color perception demonstrate that speakers of languages with discrete lexical boundaries for shades of blue (such as Russian distinguishing 'goluboy' from 'siniy') exhibit faster neural discrimination at those categorical boundaries than English speakers who subsume both under 'blue'. Far from an arbitrary naming scheme, language fine-tunes low-level sensory perceptual discrimination."

Linguistic categories interact directly with and modulate sensory cognitive processing.
Human sensory organs function completely independently of the brain.

q:
Read the passage:
"In public choice economics, regulatory capture occurs when an administrative agency created to defend public welfare becomes co-opted and dominated by the very commercial industries it is statutory mandated to oversee. Facilitated by the 'revolving door'—the routine circulation of executive personnel between corporate lobbying firms and regulatory agencies—officials internalize the commercial priorities of incumbent monopolies. Rather than enforcing stringent consumer safety or antitrust standards, the captured regulator devises onerous licensing hurdles and compliance mandates that function as anti-competitive barriers to entry, insulating established corporate conglomerates from innovative market disruptors."

A government abolishes all taxes on domestic manufacturing industries.

Regulatory agencies are completely taken over by foreign military commanders.

"In public choice economics, regulatory capture occurs when an administrative agency created to defend public welfare becomes co-opted and dominated by the very commercial industries it is statutory mandated to oversee. "The West Antarctic Ice Sheet (WAIS) is predominantly marine-based, with its bedrock grounded thousands of meters below sea level on a retrograde slope that deepens inland toward the continental interior. q:
Read the passage:
"The West Antarctic Ice Sheet (WAIS) is predominantly marine-based, with its bedrock grounded thousands of meters below sea level on a retrograde slope that deepens inland toward the continental interior. This retrograde topography subjects the ice sheet to Marine Ice Sheet Instability (MISI). Flanked by floating ice shelves that exert crucial back-stress buttressing, the grounding line—the boundary where grounded glacier transitions into floating ice—remains stable only as long as these buttresses endure. However, the intrusion of circumpolar deep water underneath ice shelves melts them from below. Once the grounding line retreats past an inward-sloping bedrock ridge, buoyancy forces trigger self-sustaining, runaway glacial retreat that is irreversible on human timescales."

The word "buttressing" in the passage is derived from architectural terminology, where it refers to:
explanation: A buttress in architecture is an exterior support providing counter-thrust; in glaciology, ice shelves provide back-stress that props up inland ice.

Painting walls with reflective white waterproofing chemical coatings.
Providing external physical structural support and resistance against outward collapse.

Read the passage:
"The astronomical surge in atopic allergies, asthma, and autoimmune diseases across post-industrial societies led David Strachan to formulate the hygiene hypothesis. Contemporary immunology refines this concept into the 'Old Friends' hypothesis: the human immune system co-evolved over evolutionary millennia alongside a diverse consortium of non-pathogenic soil saprophytes, commensal gut microbiota, and benign helminths. These organisms act as vital immunological tutors, stimulating regulatory T cells (Tregs) that produce anti-inflammatory cytokines like interleukin-10. In hyper-sanitized urban environments characterized by sterile water, cesarean deliveries, and rampant antibiotic overprescription, the uncalibrated immune system fails to develop adequate self-tolerance, mounting inappropriate hyper-inflammatory attacks against harmless environmental proteins."

Contemporary immunology refines this concept into the 'Old Friends' hypothesis: the human immune system co-evolved over evolutionary millennia alongside a diverse consortium of non-pathogenic soil saprophytes, commensal gut microbiota, and benign helminths. "Thomas Kuhn’s seminal treatise, 'The Structure of Scientific Revolutions', dismantled the positivist orthodoxy that science advances through linear, cumulative accretion of facts. Kuhn argued that scientific history is punctuated by alternating epochs: long intervals of 'normal science', where researchers conduct puzzle-solving within an unquestioned disciplinary matrix or 'paradigm', interrupted by epistemic crises. As intractable empirical anomalies accumulate beyond the paradigm's explanatory capacity, professional consensus fractures. The ensuing scientific revolution does not merely append new data; it enacts a gestalt switch, establishing an incommensurable new paradigm where familiar terms acquire radically redefined meanings, altering how practitioners perceive the world."

q: An American visiting London says to a British train conductor: *"How are you doing today?"* The conductor replies briefly: *"Fine, thanks."* If the American had instead launched into an eight-minute monologue detailing his lumbar spine surgery, what pragmatic norm would be violated?
opts: Committing a phonological assimilation error regarding alveolar fricatives.
Violating the British Railway Act of 1889 regarding ticket validation procedures.
Executing an Austinian marriage ceremony in an unauthorized railway compartment.
Treating a formulaic phatic greeting (intended solely to establish mutual goodwill) as an informative solicitous inquiry requiring literal biographical disclosure.
explanation: Formulaic greetings (*How are you?*) are phatic tokens with minimal semantic content. Treating them as substantive inquiries flouts expected conversational routines, imposing an unwanted informational burden on the hearer.
mnemonic: Phatic greetings are tokens of goodwill, NOT invitations for medical monologues.

q: In some Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cultures, a father affectionately calls his young son *'baba'* ('father') or an aunt calls her niece *'khala'* ('aunt'). In sociopragmatics, what is this phenomenon termed?
opts: Honorific inversion (or kinship role inversion), functioning as an intense positive politeness marker of tender affection and nurturing intimacy.
A cognitive linguistic disorder where elderly speakers confuse genealogical generations.
An Austinian performative that legally swaps parental custody rights.
A sociopragmatic failure that triggers immediate tribal disinheritance.
explanation: Honorific / kinship inversion (calling a child by the elder's kinship title) is a recognized sociopragmatic positive politeness device in Arabic, Turkish, and Italian dialects, expressing tender intimacy and protective affection.
mnemonic: Kinship Inversion (*calling child 'father/aunt'*) = Intimate positive politeness token.

q:
Arrange the following propositions into a logically coherent academic argument:

1. When central banks attempted to exploit this relationship during the 1970s, the outcome was 'stagflation'—the catastrophic simultaneous emergence of high inflation and high unemployment.
2. In 1958, A.W. Phillips published empirical evidence indicating an inverse statistical relationship between nominal wage inflation and unemployment rates in the United Kingdom.
3. Milton Friedman and Edmund Phelps explained this breakdown by introducing inflation expectations, arguing that workers adjust wage demands upward once inflation becomes anticipated.
4. Consequently, modern macroeconomics recognizes that the long-run Phillips curve is vertical, meaning monetary policy cannot permanently suppress unemployment below its natural rate.
5. Macroeconomic policymakers swiftly interpreted this correlation as a stable policy menu, assuming they could deliberately trade higher inflation for lower unemployment.
explanation: Sequence: Empirical discovery [2] → Policy extrapolation [5] → Empirical breakdown (1970s stagflation) [1] → Theoretical resolution (expectations hypothesis) [3] → Permanent modern consensus via 'Consequently' [4].

"Thomas Kuhn’s seminal treatise, 'The Structure of Scientific Revolutions', dismantled the positivist orthodoxy that science advances through linear, cumulative accretion of facts. Kuhn argued that scientific history is punctuated by alternating epochs: long intervals of 'normal science', where researchers conduct puzzle-solving within an unquestioned disciplinary matrix or 'paradigm', interrupted by epistemic crises. As intractable empirical anomalies accumulate beyond the paradigm's explanatory capacity, professional consensus fractures. The ensuing scientific revolution does not merely append new data; it enacts a gestalt switch, establishing an incommensurable new paradigm where familiar terms acquire radically redefined meanings, altering how practitioners perceive the world."

What causes a period of "normal science" to disintegrate into an epistemic crisis, according to Kuhn?
explanation: Normal science breaks down when 'intractable empirical anomalies accumulate beyond the paradigm's explanatory capacity', creating a crisis.
opts: A global economic recession that cuts research grants for university physics departments.
The accumulation of stubborn empirical anomalies that persistently resist explanation within the prevailing paradigm.
A royal decree issued by a monarch banning scientific laboratories.
The complete retirement of all practicing university science professors.
options: A global economic recession that cuts research grants for university physics departments.
The accumulation of stubborn empirical anomalies that persistently resist explanation within the prevailing paradigm.

q: During international joint-venture negotiations, a delegate from a high-context culture repeatedly smiles and nods saying *"Yes, we understand your proposal"* to indicate comprehension. The low-context counterpart wrongly assumes this means binding agreement. What type of failure occurred?
opts: A pure syntactic parsing error involving the irregular past participle of English verbs.
A cross-cultural pragmatic breakdown where an acknowledgment of receipt (comprehension / face-maintenance) is misinterpreted as a commissive agreement.
An Austinian misexecution due to the lack of an officially notarized wax seal.
A biological failure of auditory perception among business delegates.
explanation: In high-context cultures, nodding and saying *'Yes'* frequently serves phatic/receptive face-maintenance (showing attentive listening and comprehension), which low-context delegates easily misread as an illocutionary commitment/agreement.
mnemonic: *'Yes'* as understanding vs. *'Yes'* as agreement = Classic intercultural pragmatic trap.

q: Which sequence correctly arranges Brown and Levinson's five politeness super-strategies in order of **increasing risk to face** (from least risky to most risky for the speaker)?
opts: Positive politeness -> Bald on-record -> Don't do the FTA -> Negative politeness -> Off-record.
Bald on-record -> Positive politeness -> Negative politeness -> Off-record -> Don't do the FTA.
Don't do the FTA -> Off-record -> Negative politeness -> Positive politeness -> Bald on-record.
Off-record -> Bald on-record -> Negative politeness -> Positive politeness -> Don't do the FTA.
explanation: The hierarchy of risk to face ranges from zero risk (Don't do the FTA), to ambiguous plausible deniability (Off-record), to redressive non-imposition (Negative politeness), to redressive solidarity (Positive politeness), up to maximal face exposure/risk (Bald on-record).
mnemonic: Politeness Strategy Risk Ladder: Don't do -> Off-record -> Negative -> Positive -> Bald on-record.

q: Upon hearing that a colleague’s research grant application was rejected, a professor writes: *"I was terribly sorry to hear the disappointing news; the adjudication committee failed to appreciate the groundbreaking scope of your proposal."* Which Leech maxim is primarily observed?
opts: The Generosity Maxim: offer the colleague immediate personal funding.
The Modesty Maxim: minimize praise of self; maximize self-reproach.
The Tact Maxim: minimize financial expenditure by the research council.
The Sympathy Maxim: minimize antipathy between self and other; maximize sympathy between self and other.
explanation: Leech's Sympathy Maxim requires conversationalists to minimize antipathy and maximize sympathy (commiserations, condolences, shared grief) toward the hearer during unfortunate events.
mnemonic: Sympathy Maxim = Maximize shared commiseration and empathy during adversity.

q: Cross-cultural sociolinguists (e.g. Sifianou, Blum-Kulka) observe that certain societies (such as Mediterranean or Latin American cultures) are predominantly *'positive politeness cultures'*, whereas others (such as British or Japanese societies) are *'negative politeness cultures'*. What does this distinction signify?
opts: Positive politeness cultures prioritize warmth, solidarity, and involvement over personal space, whereas negative politeness cultures prioritize privacy, deference, and non-imposition.
Positive politeness cultures never experience interpersonal conflict or divorce.
Negative politeness cultures exclusively communicate using syntactic negation in everyday speech.
The distinction reflects the grammatical presence or absence of subjunctive mood in national languages.
explanation: In positive-politeness cultures, friendliness, closeness, and involvement are expected as baseline courtesy. In negative-politeness cultures, maintaining privacy, social distance, and respecting non-intrusion are paramount.
mnemonic: Positive Politeness culture = Solidarity & involvement; Negative Politeness culture = Deference & privacy.

q: Consider Sentence A: *"Dr. Alimov realized that the clinical data had been falsified."* and Sentence B: *"Dr. Alimov did not realize that the clinical data had been falsified."* What pragmatic property is demonstrated by the fact that both sentences convey that the data had been falsified?
opts: An Austinian locutionary defect that cancels the truth conditions of scientific reports.
Constancy under negation, which confirms that the factivity of the embedded clause is a presupposition rather than an entailment.
A Gricean flout of the Maxim of Manner due to redundant subordinate conjunctions.
A conversational implicature that can be cancelled by adding an adversative coordinating conjunction.
explanation: The core diagnostic for a presupposition is constancy under negation: while an entailment is defeated by syntactic negation, a presupposition survives negation (both *He realized that P* and *He did not realize that P* presuppose that P is true).
mnemonic: Negation Test: Presuppositions survive negation intact; entailments do not.

q: Which of the following sentences features a *factive presupposition trigger* that commits the speaker to the truth of the complement clause?
opts: "The rector alleged that the university had abolished the comparative linguistics program."
"The rector claimed that the university had abolished the comparative linguistics program."
"The rector regretted that the university had abolished the comparative linguistics program."
"The rector dreamed that the university had abolished the comparative linguistics program."
explanation: Factive verbs (e.g. *regret*, *realize*, *know*, *discover*, *be aware*) trigger the presupposition that their propositional complement is true. Non-factive verbs (*claim*, *allege*, *believe*) and counterfactive verbs (*dream*, *pretend*) do not presuppose the truth of the complement.
mnemonic: Factive Triggers (*regret, know, realize*): Complement clause is presupposed to be fact.
